```
//! Blob-side wiring for the shared British Fencing licence.
//!
//! The domain model, repository, and migration planner live in the
//! [`fencer_licence`](::fencer_licence) crate. This module is the `blob`
//! facade: it holds the collection handle usage, GET `/user/me` hydration,
//! the write path used by the v3 membership route, and the one-shot
//! per-user → shared migration.

use anyhow::Result;
use chrono::Utc;
use ids::{FencerId, TypedId, UserId};
use tracing::{info, warn};

use crate::db::DB;
use crate::v2::model::User;

pub use ::fencer_licence::{
  FencerLicenceFields, MigrationDecision, MigrationPlan, PerUserAssertion, document_id,
  plan_migration, repository,
};

/// Loads the shared membership id for `fencer_id`. `None` covers never-set,
/// explicitly cleared, and a missing document.
pub async fn get_membership_id(fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>) -> Result<Option<String>> {
  repository::get_membership_id(&DB.fencer_british_licences, fencer_id).await
}

/// Last-write-wins set or clear, recording who wrote and when. Never logs
/// the membership id itself.
pub async fn set_licence(
  fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>,
  membership_id: Option<String>,
  set_by: &TypedId<UserId>,
) -> Result<()> {
  let clearing = membership_id.is_none();
  repository::upsert(
    &DB.fencer_british_licences,
    fencer_id.clone(),
    membership_id,
    set_by.clone(),
    Utc::now(),
  )
  .await?;
  if clearing {
    info!(
      fencer_id = %fencer_id,
      set_by = %set_by,
      "Cleared shared British Fencing licence"
    );
  } else {
    info!(
      fencer_id = %fencer_id,
      set_by = %set_by,
      "Updated shared British Fencing licence"
    );
  }
  Ok(())
}

/// Overwrites each tracked fencer's `british_fencing_licence` on `user` with
/// the shared record, for the GET `/user/me` response. Does not persist;
/// the user document is no longer the source of truth.
///
/// A failure to load the shared licences degrades to `None` for every
/// tracked fencer rather than failing the request: the rest of the user
/// profile (tracked fencers, preferences, capabilities) must stay available
/// even when the licence sidecar collection is having a blip, matching how
/// `view::standings::fencer::licence_for_fencer` degrades on the read path.
pub async fn hydrate_user(user: &mut User) -> Result<()> {
  let fencer_ids: Vec<_> = user
    .fields
    .tracked_fencers
    .iter()
    .map(|tracked| tracked.fencer_id.clone())
    .collect();
  let by_fencer =
    match repository::get_membership_ids(&DB.fencer_british_licences, &fencer_ids).await {
      Ok(by_fencer) => by_fencer,
      Err(err) => {
        warn!(
          error = ?err,
          "Failed to load shared British Fencing licences; omitting from user profile"
        );
        Default::default()
      }
    };
  for tracked in &mut user.fields.tracked_fencers {
    tracked.british_fencing_licence = by_fencer.get(&tracked.fencer_id).cloned().flatten();
  }
  Ok(())
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct MigrationCounts {
  pub adopted: usize,
  pub conflicted: usize,
  pub skipped_already_shared: usize,
  pub users_stripped: usize,
}

/// Walks every user's tracked fencers and collects each historical per-user
/// licence assertion. Pure: no I/O, so it is exercised directly in tests
/// rather than only indirectly through the planner it feeds.
fn collect_assertions(users: &[User]) -> Vec<PerUserAssertion> {
  let mut assertions = Vec::new();
  for user in users {
    let user_id = TypedId::<UserId>::database(&user.id);
    for tracked in &user.fields.tracked_fencers {
      if let Some(membership_id) = &tracked.british_fencing_licence {
        assertions.push(PerUserAssertion {
          user_id: user_id.clone(),
          fencer_id: tracked.fencer_id.clone(),
          membership_id: membership_id.clone(),
        });
      }
    }
  }
  assertions
}

/// Nulls `british_fencing_licence` on every tracked fencer not in
/// `keep_fencer_ids`, returning the updated user only if that changed
/// anything. Fencers in `keep_fencer_ids` are left untouched: a conflicted
/// fencer's competing per-user assertions are the only record of the
/// conflict, and stripping them before a human reconciles it would destroy
/// that record with no way to recover it.
fn strip_licence_except(
  user: &User,
  keep_fencer_ids: &std::collections::HashSet<TypedId<FencerId>>,
) -> Option<User> {
  let mut updated = user.clone();
  let mut changed = false;
  for tracked in &mut updated.fields.tracked_fencers {
    if tracked.british_fencing_licence.is_some() && !keep_fencer_ids.contains(&tracked.fencer_id) {
      tracked.british_fencing_licence = None;
      changed = true;
    }
  }
  changed.then_some(updated)
}

/// Lifts per-user `TrackedFencer.british_fencing_licence` values onto the
/// shared collection, then strips the per-user field from every user
/// document that still carries it. Idempotent: a fencer that already has a
/// shared record is not overwritten (a live last-write-wins value wins
/// over the historical assertion). Conflicted fencers (multiple distinct
/// per-user assertions, no shared value adopted) are left unstripped so a
/// human can still see and reconcile the competing values.
pub async fn migrate_per_user_licences() -> Result<MigrationCounts> {
  let users = crate::v2::user::get_all_users().await?;
  let assertions = collect_assertions(&users);

  let plan = plan_migration(&assertions);
  let existing = repository::list_all(&DB.fencer_british_licences).await?;
  let already: std::collections::HashSet<TypedId<FencerId>> = existing
    .into_iter()
    .map(|doc| doc.fields.fencer_id)
    .collect();

  let mut counts = MigrationCounts {
    adopted: 0,
    conflicted: 0,
    skipped_already_shared: 0,
    users_stripped: 0,
  };
  let now = Utc::now();
  let mut conflicted_fencer_ids = std::collections::HashSet::new();

  for decision in &plan.decisions {
    match decision {
      MigrationDecision::Adopt {
        fencer_id,
        membership_id,
        set_by,
      } => {
        if already.contains(fencer_id) {
          counts.skipped_already_shared += 1;
          continue;
        }
        repository::upsert(
          &DB.fencer_british_licences,
          fencer_id.clone(),
          Some(membership_id.clone()),
          set_by.clone(),
          now,
        )
        .await?;
        counts.adopted += 1;
      }
      MigrationDecision::Conflict {
        fencer_id,
        distinct_count,
      } => {
        warn!(
          fencer_id = %fencer_id,
          distinct_count,
          "Skipping shared British Fencing licence migration; multiple distinct per-user assertions"
        );
        conflicted_fencer_ids.insert(fencer_id.clone());
        counts.conflicted += 1;
      }
    }
  }

  for user in &users {
    if let Some(updated) = strip_licence_except(user, &conflicted_fencer_ids) {
      DB.users.patch_document(user, &updated).await?;
      crate::v2::user::invalidate_user_cache(&user.id).await;
      counts.users_stripped += 1;
    }
  }

  info!(
    adopted = counts.adopted,
    conflicted = counts.conflicted,
    skipped_already_shared = counts.skipped_already_shared,
    users_stripped = counts.users_stripped,
    "British Fencing licence migration finished"
  );
  Ok(counts)
}

        TaskSpecBuilder::default()
          .schedule(format!("0 */{warmer_cadence_minutes} * * * *"))
          .description("Warm FencingTracker fencer strength for the upcoming schedule")
          .short_name("warm_fencer_strength")
          .task(warmer::StrengthWarmer)
          .build()?,
      )
      .await?;
    Ok(())
  }

  /// Try to find the best possible match for the given fencer search in the cache.
  async fn find_fencer_in_cache(&self, search: &FencerSearch) -> Result<Option<Fencer>> {
    if let Some(usaf_id) = &search.usaf_id {
      let result = self
        .cache
        .read()
        .await
        .evaluate(eq!(KEY_USAF_ID, usaf_id))
        .await?;
      if let Some(fencer) = result.into_iter().next() {
        return Ok(Some(fencer));
      }

      // If a USAF ID is provided, do not fall back to name-only matching in cache.
      // Name collisions are common enough that returning an arbitrary cached match can
      // mis-associate bouts to the wrong person.
      info!(
        %usaf_id,
        "USAF ID not found in ft_fencers cache; skipping name-based cache fallback"
      );
      return Ok(None);
    }
    // Try to find by name.
    if let Some(name) = &search.name {
      let result = self
        .cache
        .read()
        .await
        .evaluate(eq!(KEY_NAME, name.to_lowercase()))
        .await?;
      for r in result.iter() {
        if let Some(club) = &search.club
          && let Some(actual_club) = &r.fields.current_club_name
          && names::club_matches(club, actual_club)
        {
          return Ok(Some(r.clone()));
        }
      }

      if let Some(club) = &search.club
        && !result.is_empty()
      {
        warn!(
          %name,
          search_club = %club,
          candidate_count = result.len(),
          "Found cache results but none matched club; not returning a potentially wrong fencer"
        );
        return Ok(None);
      }

      if search.club.is_none() {
        if result.len() == 1 {
          info!("No club provided for search, but only got one result. Returning it.");
          return Ok(result.first().cloned());
        } else if !result.is_empty() {
          warn!(
            "No club provided for search, and got multiple results. Refusing to return an arbitrary potentially wrong fencer"
          );
          return Ok(None);
        }
      }
    }

    info!(?search, "Fencer not found in cache");
    Ok(None)
  }

  async fn find_and_cache_fencer(&self, search: &FencerSearch) -> Result<Option<Fencer>> {
    let mut fencer = None;

    let search = search.clone();

    // If we have a usaf_id, then look up the fencer directly in the api. This is a
    // profile lookup only (name/club/ratings/history) — no registrations needed —
    // so it goes through the long-TTL profile cache, not the composed `get_fencer`.
    if let Some(usaf_id) = &search.usaf_id {
      let usaf_id = usaf_id.parse::<u32>().unwrap();
      if let Ok(api_fencer) = api::get_fencer_profile(usaf_id, None).await {
        fencer = Some(convert_fencer(&api_fencer));
      }
    }

    // If that didn't work, then we have to use a more kludgey methods - search for the name and see if we can
    // find a fencer with a matching club.
    if fencer.is_none()
      && let Some(name) = &search.name
      && let Some(member_id) = self
        .find_fencer_by_name(name, search.club.as_deref())
        .await?
      && let Ok(api_fencer) = api::get_fencer_profile(member_id, None).await
    {
      fencer = Some(convert_fencer(&api_fencer));
    }

    if let Some(mut fencer) = fencer {
      if fencer.fields.gender.is_none() {
        fencer.fields.gender = search.gender.clone();
      }

      // if let Some(usaf_id) = &fencer.fields.id_detail.usaf_id {
      //   // // Try to find USA fencing standings for this fencer in the cache, and inject them into the object.
      //   // let standings = services.usaf.get_standing_from_cache(usaf_id).await?;
      //   // fencer.fields.standing = standings;
      // }
      self.cache.write().await.put(fencer.clone()).await?;

      return Ok(Some(fencer));
    }

    Ok(None)
  }

  // Tries to find the best possible match for the given fencer information.
  pub async fn find_fencer(
    &self,
    search: &FencerSearch,
    do_search: bool,
  ) -> Result<Option<Fencer>> {
    // First, try to find the fencer in the cache.
    if let Some(fencer) = self.find_fencer_in_cache(search).await? {
      // if let Some(usaf_id) = &fencer.fields.id_detail.usaf_id {
      //   // // Try to find USA fencing standings for this fencer in the cache, and inject them into the object.
      //   // let standings = services.usaf.get_standing_from_cache(usaf_id).await?;
      //   // fencer.fields.standing = standings;
      // }
      Ok(Some(fencer))
    } else if do_search {
      Ok(self.find_and_cache_fencer(search).await?)
    } else {
      Ok(None)
    }
  }

  /// Finds a fencer's FencingTracker membership from a name and optionally a
  /// club, via [`resolve`] — the single shared resolver.
  ///
  /// This used to be `find_fencer_impl`, a third independent matcher. It
  /// accepted a lone search hit without verifying the name at all, and broke a
  /// genuine tie by picking the only "Unattached" row. The shared resolver
  /// verifies the name on every candidate and refuses ties, so this path is now
  /// stricter — see the module docs on `resolve` for what that trades away.
  ///
  /// `FencerSearch` carries no birth year, so this caller cannot supply the
  /// resolver's strongest discriminator and leans on club alone. That is the
  /// same information it always had; the difference is that an unverifiable
  /// match is now declined rather than returned.
  async fn find_fencer_by_name(&self, name: &str, club: Option<&str>) -> Result<Option<u32>> {
    let query = resolve::FencerQuery::by_name(name).with_club(club.map(str::to_owned));
    Ok(resolve::resolve_member_id(&query).await?.member_id())
  }

  async fn get_profile_by_name(
    &self,
    name: &str,
    club: Option<&str>,
  ) -> Result<Option<model::Fencer>> {
    match self.find_fencer_by_name(name, club).await? {
      Some(member_id) => Ok(api::get_fencer_profile(member_id, None).await.ok()),
      None => Ok(None),
    }
  }
}

fn get_first_competition_year(fencer: &model::Fencer) -> Option<u16> {
  let mut first_year = 9999;
  for result in &fencer.results {
    let year = result.event.date.year();
    if year < first_year {
      first_year = year;
    }
  }
  if first_year == 9999 {
    None
  } else {
    Some(first_year as u16)
  }
}

fn merge_into(api_fencer: &model::Fencer, fencer: &mut FencerFields) {
  fencer.id_detail.usaf_id = Some(api_fencer.id.to_string());
  fencer.birth_year = api_fencer.birth_year;
  fencer.first_competition_year = get_first_competition_year(api_fencer);
  fencer.current_club_name = api_fencer.club.clone();
  fencer.country = Some(api_fencer.country.clone());
  fencer.current_ratings = convert_ratings(&api_fencer.rating_history);
}

fn convert_fencer(fencer: &model::Fencer) -> Fencer {
  let converted = FencerFields {
    id_detail: IdDetailBuilder::default()
      .usaf_id(fencer.id.to_string())
      .build()
      .unwrap(),
    name: to_usaf_style_name(&fencer.name), // Always normalize fencer names to their USAF style.
    birth_year: fencer.birth_year,
    first_competition_year: get_first_competition_year(fencer),
    country: Some(fencer.country.clone()),
    current_club_name: fencer.club.clone(),
    gender: None,
    current_ratings: convert_ratings(&fencer.rating_history),
    standing: None,
    match_stats: None,
    confirmed_usaf_registrations: vec![],
  };

  Identified::external(ExternalId::UsaFencing(fencer.id.to_string()), converted)
}

fn convert_ratings(rating_history: &[model::RatingHistory]) -> Option<Ratings> {
  if rating_history.is_empty() {
    return None;
  }

  let mut ratings = Ratings {
    foil: None,
    epee: None,
    sabre: None,
  };

  for rating in rating_history.iter().rev() {
    match rating.rating.weapon.unwrap() {
      Weapon::Foil => ratings.foil = Some(convert_rating(&rating.rating, rating.date)),
      Weapon::Epee => ratings.epee = Some(convert_rating(&rating.rating, rating.date)),
      Weapon::Sabre => ratings.sabre = Some(convert_rating(&rating.rating, rating.date)),
      _ => {}
    }
  }

  Some(ratings)
}

use model_common::{self, Weapon};

fn convert_rating(rating: &model_common::FencerRating, obtained: NaiveDate) -> Rating {
  Rating {
    classification: rating.category.to_string(),
    year_obtained: rating.year,
    date_obtained: obtained,
  }
}

/// Converts parsed FT event results into deduplicated bout conversion inputs.
/// FT result pages list every bout from both fencers' perspectives; this removes
/// mirrored duplicates while preserving score parity.
pub fn build_event_bout_conversion_inputs(
  event_results: &EventResults,
) -> Vec<EventBoutConversionInput> {
  let mut dedupe = HashSet::new();
  let mut inputs = Vec::new();

  for entrant in &event_results.entrants {
    for bout in &entrant.bouts {
      let key = canonical_bout_key(
        bout.stage,
        entrant.usaf_id,
        bout.opponent_usaf_id,
        &entrant.name,
        &bout.opponent_name,
        bout.score_for,
        bout.score_against,
      );

      if dedupe.insert(key) {
        inputs.push(EventBoutConversionInput {
          stage: bout.stage,
          left_usaf_id: entrant.usaf_id,
          left_name: entrant.name.clone(),
          right_usaf_id: bout.opponent_usaf_id,
          right_name: bout.opponent_name.clone(),
          left_score: bout.score_for,
          right_score: bout.score_against,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  inputs
}

fn canonical_bout_key(
  stage: crate::fencingtracker::model::EventBoutStage,
  left_id: u32,
  right_id: Option<u32>,
  left_name: &str,
  right_name: &str,
  left_score: u8,
  right_score: u8,
) -> String {
  if let Some(right_id) = right_id {
    if left_id <= right_id {
      return format!(
        "{:?}|{}|{}|{}:{}",
        stage, left_id, right_id, left_score, right_score
      );
    }
    return format!(
      "{:?}|{}|{}|{}:{}",
      stage, right_id, left_id, right_score, left_score
    );
  }

  let left_key = normalize_name_key(left_name);
  let right_key = normalize_name_key(right_name);
  if left_key <= right_key {
    format!(
      "{:?}|{}|{}|{}:{}",
      stage, left_key, right_key, left_score, right_score
    )
  } else {
    format!(
      "{:?}|{}|{}|{}:{}",
      stage, right_key, left_key, right_score, left_score
    )
  }
}

mod sync {
  use super::*;
  use crate::db::DB;
  use crate::notification::{fencer_club_changed, fencer_rating_changed, post};

  pub struct SyncFencerInfo;
  #[async_trait]
  impl Task for SyncFencerInfo {
    async fn execute(&self) -> Result<()> {
      // This scheduled sync is background egress: any FencingTracker fetch it
      // makes is attributed to the background source and subject to the
      // background request budget, keeping it separable from serving traffic.
      egress::as_background(self.sync()).await
    }
  }

  impl SyncFencerInfo {
    async fn sync(&self) -> Result<()> {
      let mut fencers = DB.fencers.list_documents().await?;

      for f in fencers.iter_mut() {
        let profile = if let Some(usaf_id) = &f.fields.id_detail.usaf_id {
          Some(api::get_fencer_profile(usaf_id.parse().unwrap(), None).await?)
        } else if f.fields.country != Some("GB".to_string()) {
          warn!(
            fencer_name = %f.fields.name,
            "Profile does not have a USAF ID"
          );
          FencingTrackerClient::get()
            .await
            .get_profile_by_name(&f.fields.name, f.fields.current_club_name.as_deref())
            .await?
        } else {
          None
        };

        if let Some(profile) = profile {
          let mut notifications = Vec::new();
          let original = f.clone();
          merge_into(&profile, &mut f.fields);

          if f.fields.current_club_name != original.fields.current_club_name {
            notifications.push(fencer_club_changed(f)?);
          }

          if f.fields.current_ratings != original.fields.current_ratings {
            notifications.append(&mut fencer_rating_changed(
              f,
              &original.fields.current_ratings,
            )?);
          }

          if !notifications.is_empty() {
            info!(
              fencer_name = %f.fields.name,
              ?notifications,
              "Sending notifications"
            );

            if let Err(e) = post(notifications).await {
              error!(error = ?e, "Failed to send notifications");
            }
          }

          DB.fencers.patch_document(&original, f).await?;
        } else {
          warn!(
            fencer_name = %f.fields.name,
            "Unable to find FencingTracker profile"
          )
        }
      }

      Ok(())
    }
  }

  // SyncRegistrations and RepairRecentRegistrationsDryRun tasks have been removed.
  // Registration syncing is now handled on-demand via the /v3/view/fencer/{id}/registrations API,
  // and result syncing uses connected fencers from user.trackedFencers.
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
  use crate::fencingtracker::model::{

  #[test]
  fn build_event_bout_conversion_inputs_deduplicates_mirrored_rows() {
    let parsed = EventResults {
      event_id: 123,
      entrants: vec![
        EventResultsEntrant {
          usaf_id: 111,
          name: "DOE JANE".to_string(),
          bouts: vec![
            EventBoutResult {
              stage: EventBoutStage::Pool,
              elimination_round_of: None,
              opponent_name: "SMITH JOHN".to_string(),
              opponent_usaf_id: Some(222),
              score_for: 5,
              score_against: 3,
            },
            EventBoutResult {
              stage: EventBoutStage::DirectElimination,
              elimination_round_of: Some(16),
              opponent_name: "SMITH JOHN".to_string(),
              opponent_usaf_id: Some(222),
              score_for: 15,
              score_against: 14,
            },
          ],
        },
        EventResultsEntrant {
          usaf_id: 222,
          name: "SMITH JOHN".to_string(),
          bouts: vec![
            EventBoutResult {
              stage: EventBoutStage::Pool,
              elimination_round_of: None,
              opponent_name: "DOE JANE".to_string(),
              opponent_usaf_id: Some(111),
              score_for: 3,
              score_against: 5,
            },
            EventBoutResult {
              stage: EventBoutStage::DirectElimination,
              elimination_round_of: Some(16),
              opponent_name: "DOE JANE".to_string(),
              opponent_usaf_id: Some(111),
              score_for: 14,
              score_against: 15,
            },
          ],
        },
      ],
      parse_failures: 0,
    };

    let converted = build_event_bout_conversion_inputs(&parsed);
    assert_eq!(converted.len(), 2);
    assert!(
      converted
        .iter()
        .any(|bout| bout.stage == EventBoutStage::Pool
          && bout.left_usaf_id == 111
          && bout.right_usaf_id == Some(222)
          && bout.left_score == 5
          && bout.right_score == 3)
    );
    assert!(
      converted
        .iter()
        .any(|bout| bout.stage == EventBoutStage::DirectElimination
          && bout.left_usaf_id == 111
          && bout.right_usaf_id == Some(222)
          && bout.left_score == 15
          && bout.right_score == 14)
    );
  }

  #[tokio::test]
  #[ignore = "Hits live FencingTracker and requires full runtime config"]
  async fn find_fencers() -> Result<()> {
    let cache = InMemoryCache;
    let client = FencingTrackerClient::new(&cache);

    // An unambiguous name resolves with or without a club.
    assert_matches!(
      client
        .find_fencer_by_name("DUFF Caitlin", Some("Halberstadt Fencers' Club"))
        .await?,
      Some(100344622)
    );
    assert_matches!(
      client.find_fencer_by_name("DUFF Caitlin", None).await?,
      Some(100344622)
    );

    // A name with several holders resolves only when a club separates them...
    assert_matches!(
      client
        .find_fencer_by_name("WANG David", Some("Bay Area Fencing Club"))
        .await?,
      Some(100335535)
    );

    // ...and is refused outright when nothing does. This assertion used to read
    // `Some(100332472)` with the comment "essentially arbitrary": the old
    // matcher broke the tie by picking a candidate. Returning an arbitrary
    // member id for a name shared by several fencers is how one fencer's
    // ratings and results end up attached to another, so the shared resolver
    // declines instead.
    assert_matches!(client.find_fencer_by_name("WANG David", None).await?, None);

    // A club nobody in the result set belongs to is not a licence to guess
    // either. The club is a tie-break, so this falls back to the same refusal.
    assert_matches!(
      client
        .find_fencer_by_name("WANG David", Some("Academy of Totally Imaginary Fencers"))
        .await?,
      None
    );

    Ok(())
  }

  async fn seed_cached_fencer(
    client: &FencingTrackerClient,
    usaf_id: &str,
    name: &str,
    club: Option<&str>,
  ) -> Result<()> {
    let mut builder = FencerFieldsBuilder::default();
    builder.name(name.to_string()).id_detail(
      IdDetailBuilder::default()
        .usaf_id(usaf_id.to_string())
        .build()?,
    );
    if let Some(club) = club {
      builder.current_club_name(club.to_string());
    }
    let fencer = Identified::usaf_id(usaf_id, builder.build()?);
    client.cache.write().await.put(fencer).await?;
    Ok(())
  }

  #[tokio::test]

// `fencingtracker` crate so changes to the FencingTracker fetch layer don't

use crate::fencingtracker::model::{EventBoutConversionInput, EventResults};

use crate::v2::model::{Fencer, FencerFields, Rating, Ratings};
use cache::{Cache, CacheCollection, RedisCache};
use tasks::{Task, TaskManager, TaskSpecBuilder};
use tokio::sync::OnceCell;

use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use chrono::{Datelike, NaiveDate};
use ids::{ExternalId, IdDetailBuilder, Identified};
use itertools::Itertools;

use util::{eq, to_ftl_style_name, to_usaf_style_name};

static FENCING_TRACKER_CLIENT: OnceCell<FencingTrackerClient> = OnceCell::const_new();

pub struct FencingTrackerClient {
  cache: RwLock<CacheCollection<FencerFields>>,
}

pub const KEY_NAME: &str = "name";
pub const KEY_CLUB: &str = "club";
pub const KEY_USAF_ID: &str = "usaf_id";

impl FencingTrackerClient {
  fn new(cache: &impl Cache) -> Self {
    let mut cache = cache.collection("ft_fencers");
    cache.add_indexer(KEY_NAME, |f: &Fencer| {
      vec![
        f.fields.name.clone(),
        f.fields.name.to_lowercase().clone(),
        to_usaf_style_name(&f.fields.name).to_lowercase().clone(),
        to_ftl_style_name(&f.fields.name).to_lowercase().clone(),
      ]
    });
    cache.add_indexer(KEY_CLUB, |f: &Fencer| {
      f.fields.current_club_name.clone().into_iter().collect_vec()
    });
    cache.add_indexer(KEY_USAF_ID, |f: &Fencer| {
      f.fields.id_detail.usaf_id.clone().into_iter().collect_vec()
    });

    Self {
      cache: RwLock::new(cache),
    }
  }

  /// Returns the global FencingTrackerClient singleton.
  pub async fn get() -> &'static FencingTrackerClient {
    FENCING_TRACKER_CLIENT
      .get_or_init(|| async { FencingTrackerClient::new(RedisCache::get().await) })
      .await
  }

  pub async fn register_tasks(&self) -> Result<()> {
    let manager = TaskManager::get().await;
    manager
      .add_task(
        TaskSpecBuilder::default()
          .schedule("0 30 5 * * Wed")
          .description("Sync fencer info from FencingTracker")
          .short_name("sync_fencers")
          .task(sync::SyncFencerInfo)
          .build()?,
      )
      .await?;
    // Background strength warmer (recommendation-cache population, Task 2). Runs
    // every `flunge_config::WARMER_CADENCE_SECONDS` deriving a prioritized fencer
    // working set; its draining step is config-gated (off by default). See
    // `warmer` for the full shape.
    let warmer_cadence_minutes = flunge_config::WARMER_CADENCE_SECONDS / 60;
    manager
      .add_task(
        TaskSpecBuilder::default()
          .schedule(format!("0 */{warmer_cadence_minutes} * * * *"))
          .description("Warm FencingTracker fencer strength for the upcoming schedule")
          .short_name("warm_fencer_strength")
          .task(warmer::StrengthWarmer)
          .build()?,
      )
      .await?;
    Ok(())
  }

  /// Try to find the best possible match for the given fencer search in the cache.
  async fn find_fencer_in_cache(&self, search: &FencerSearch) -> Result<Option<Fencer>> {
    if let Some(usaf_id) = &search.usaf_id {
      let result = self
        .cache
        .read()
        .await
        .evaluate(eq!(KEY_USAF_ID, usaf_id))
        .await?;
      if let Some(fencer) = result.into_iter().next() {
        return Ok(Some(fencer));
      }

      // If a USAF ID is provided, do not fall back to name-only matching in cache.
      // Name collisions are common enough that returning an arbitrary cached match can
      // mis-associate bouts to the wrong person.
      info!(
        %usaf_id,
        "USAF ID not found in ft_fencers cache; skipping name-based cache fallback"
      );
      return Ok(None);
    }
    // Try to find by name.
    if let Some(name) = &search.name {
      let result = self
        .cache
        .read()
        .await
        .evaluate(eq!(KEY_NAME, name.to_lowercase()))
        .await?;
      for r in result.iter() {
        if let Some(club) = &search.club
          && let Some(actual_club) = &r.fields.current_club_name
          && names::club_matches(club, actual_club)
        {
          return Ok(Some(r.clone()));
        }
      }

      if let Some(club) = &search.club
        && !result.is_empty()
      {
        warn!(
          %name,
          search_club = %club,
          candidate_count = result.len(),
          "Found cache results but none matched club; not returning a potentially wrong fencer"
        );
        return Ok(None);
      }

      if search.club.is_none() {
        if result.len() == 1 {
          info!("No club provided for search, but only got one result. Returning it.");
          return Ok(result.first().cloned());
        } else if !result.is_empty() {
          warn!(
            "No club provided for search, and got multiple results. Refusing to return an arbitrary potentially wrong fencer"
          );
          return Ok(None);
        }
      }
    }

    info!(?search, "Fencer not found in cache");
    Ok(None)
  }

  async fn find_and_cache_fencer(&self, search: &FencerSearch) -> Result<Option<Fencer>> {
    let mut fencer = None;

    let search = search.clone();

    // If we have a usaf_id, then look up the fencer directly in the api. This is a
    // profile lookup only (name/club/ratings/history) — no registrations needed —
    // so it goes through the long-TTL profile cache, not the composed `get_fencer`.
    if let Some(usaf_id) = &search.usaf_id {
      let usaf_id = usaf_id.parse::<u32>().unwrap();
      if let Ok(api_fencer) = api::get_fencer_profile(usaf_id, None).await {
        fencer = Some(convert_fencer(&api_fencer));
      }
    }

    // If that didn't work, then we have to use a more kludgey methods - search for the name and see if we can
    // find a fencer with a matching club.
    if fencer.is_none()
      && let Some(name) = &search.name
      && let Some(member_id) = self
        .find_fencer_by_name(name, search.club.as_deref())
        .await?
      && let Ok(api_fencer) = api::get_fencer_profile(member_id, None).await
    {
      fencer = Some(convert_fencer(&api_fencer));
    }

    if let Some(mut fencer) = fencer {
      if fencer.fields.gender.is_none() {
        fencer.fields.gender = search.gender.clone();
      }

      // if let Some(usaf_id) = &fencer.fields.id_detail.usaf_id {
      //   // // Try to find USA fencing standings for this fencer in the cache, and inject them into the object.
      //   // let standings = services.usaf.get_standing_from_cache(usaf_id).await?;
      //   // fencer.fields.standing = standings;
      // }
      self.cache.write().await.put(fencer.clone()).await?;

      return Ok(Some(fencer));
    }

    Ok(None)
  }

  // Tries to find the best possible match for the given fencer information.
  pub async fn find_fencer(
    &self,
    search: &FencerSearch,
    do_search: bool,
  ) -> Result<Option<Fencer>> {
    // First, try to find the fencer in the cache.
    if let Some(fencer) = self.find_fencer_in_cache(search).await? {
      // if let Some(usaf_id) = &fencer.fields.id_detail.usaf_id {
      //   // // Try to find USA fencing standings for this fencer in the cache, and inject them into the object.
      //   // let standings = services.usaf.get_standing_from_cache(usaf_id).await?;
      //   // fencer.fields.standing = standings;
      // }
      Ok(Some(fencer))
    } else if do_search {
      Ok(self.find_and_cache_fencer(search).await?)
    } else {
      Ok(None)
    }
  }

  /// Finds a fencer's FencingTracker membership from a name and optionally a
  /// club, via [`resolve`] — the single shared resolver.
  ///
  /// This used to be `find_fencer_impl`, a third independent matcher. It
  /// accepted a lone search hit without verifying the name at all, and broke a
  /// genuine tie by picking the only "Unattached" row. The shared resolver
  /// verifies the name on every candidate and refuses ties, so this path is now
  /// stricter — see the module docs on `resolve` for what that trades away.
  ///
  /// `FencerSearch` carries no birth year, so this caller cannot supply the
  /// resolver's strongest discriminator and leans on club alone. That is the
  /// same information it always had; the difference is that an unverifiable
  /// match is now declined rather than returned.
  async fn find_fencer_by_name(&self, name: &str, club: Option<&str>) -> Result<Option<u32>> {
    let query = resolve::FencerQuery::by_name(name).with_club(club.map(str::to_owned));
    Ok(resolve::resolve_member_id(&query).await?.member_id())
  }

  async fn get_profile_by_name(
    &self,
    name: &str,
    club: Option<&str>,
  ) -> Result<Option<model::Fencer>> {
    match self.find_fencer_by_name(name, club).await? {
      Some(member_id) => Ok(api::get_fencer_profile(member_id, None).await.ok()),
      None => Ok(None),
    }
  }
}

fn get_first_competition_year(fencer: &model::Fencer) -> Option<u16> {
  let mut first_year = 9999;
  for result in &fencer.results {
    let year = result.event.date.year();
    if year < first_year {
      first_year = year;
    }
  }
  if first_year == 9999 {
    None
  } else {
    Some(first_year as u16)
  }
}

pub(crate) fn merge_into(api_fencer: &model::Fencer, fencer: &mut FencerFields) {
  fencer.id_detail.usaf_id = Some(api_fencer.id.to_string());
  fencer.birth_year = api_fencer.birth_year;
  fencer.first_competition_year = get_first_competition_year(api_fencer);
  fencer.current_club_name = api_fencer.club.clone();
  fencer.country = Some(api_fencer.country.clone());
  fencer.current_ratings = convert_ratings(&api_fencer.rating_history);
}

fn convert_fencer(fencer: &model::Fencer) -> Fencer {
  let converted = FencerFields {
    id_detail: IdDetailBuilder::default()
      .usaf_id(fencer.id.to_string())
      .build()
      .unwrap(),
    name: to_usaf_style_name(&fencer.name), // Always normalize fencer names to their USAF style.
    birth_year: fencer.birth_year,
    first_competition_year: get_first_competition_year(fencer),
    country: Some(fencer.country.clone()),
    current_club_name: fencer.club.clone(),
    gender: None,
    current_ratings: convert_ratings(&fencer.rating_history),
    standing: None,
    match_stats: None,
    confirmed_usaf_registrations: vec![],
  };

  Identified::external(ExternalId::UsaFencing(fencer.id.to_string()), converted)
}

fn convert_ratings(rating_history: &[model::RatingHistory]) -> Option<Ratings> {
  if rating_history.is_empty() {
    return None;
  }

  let mut ratings = Ratings {
    foil: None,
    epee: None,
    sabre: None,
  };

  for rating in rating_history.iter().rev() {
    match rating.rating.weapon.unwrap() {
      Weapon::Foil => ratings.foil = Some(convert_rating(&rating.rating, rating.date)),
      Weapon::Epee => ratings.epee = Some(convert_rating(&rating.rating, rating.date)),
      Weapon::Sabre => ratings.sabre = Some(convert_rating(&rating.rating, rating.date)),
      _ => {}
    }
  }

  Some(ratings)
}

use model_common::{self, Weapon};

fn convert_rating(rating: &model_common::FencerRating, obtained: NaiveDate) -> Rating {
  Rating {
    classification: rating.category.to_string(),
    year_obtained: rating.year,
    date_obtained: obtained,
  }
}

/// Converts parsed FT event results into deduplicated bout conversion inputs.
/// FT result pages list every bout from both fencers' perspectives; this removes
/// mirrored duplicates while preserving score parity.
pub fn build_event_bout_conversion_inputs(
  event_results: &EventResults,
) -> Vec<EventBoutConversionInput> {
  let mut dedupe = HashSet::new();
  let mut inputs = Vec::new();

  for entrant in &event_results.entrants {
    for bout in &entrant.bouts {
      let key = canonical_bout_key(
        bout.stage,
        entrant.usaf_id,
        bout.opponent_usaf_id,
        &entrant.name,
        &bout.opponent_name,
        bout.score_for,
        bout.score_against,
      );

      if dedupe.insert(key) {
        inputs.push(EventBoutConversionInput {
          stage: bout.stage,
          left_usaf_id: entrant.usaf_id,
          left_name: entrant.name.clone(),
          right_usaf_id: bout.opponent_usaf_id,
          right_name: bout.opponent_name.clone(),
          left_score: bout.score_for,
          right_score: bout.score_against,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  inputs
}

fn canonical_bout_key(
  stage: crate::fencingtracker::model::EventBoutStage,
  left_id: u32,
  right_id: Option<u32>,
  left_name: &str,
  right_name: &str,
  left_score: u8,
  right_score: u8,
) -> String {
  if let Some(right_id) = right_id {
    if left_id <= right_id {
      return format!(
        "{:?}|{}|{}|{}:{}",
        stage, left_id, right_id, left_score, right_score
      );
    }
    return format!(
      "{:?}|{}|{}|{}:{}",
      stage, right_id, left_id, right_score, left_score
    );
  }

  let left_key = normalize_name_key(left_name);
  let right_key = normalize_name_key(right_name);
  if left_key <= right_key {
    format!(
      "{:?}|{}|{}|{}:{}",
      stage, left_key, right_key, left_score, right_score
    )
  } else {
    format!(
      "{:?}|{}|{}|{}:{}",
      stage, right_key, left_key, right_score, left_score
    )
  }
}

mod sync {
  use super::*;
  use crate::db::DB;
  use crate::notification::{fencer_club_changed, fencer_rating_changed, post};

  pub struct SyncFencerInfo;
  #[async_trait]
  impl Task for SyncFencerInfo {
    async fn execute(&self) -> Result<()> {
      // This scheduled sync is background egress: any FencingTracker fetch it
      // makes is attributed to the background source and subject to the
      // background request budget, keeping it separable from serving traffic.
      egress::as_background(self.sync()).await
    }
  }

  impl SyncFencerInfo {
    async fn sync(&self) -> Result<()> {
      let mut fencers = DB.fencers.list_documents().await?;

      for f in fencers.iter_mut() {
        let profile = if let Some(usaf_id) = &f.fields.id_detail.usaf_id {
          Some(api::get_fencer_profile(usaf_id.parse().unwrap(), None).await?)
        } else if f.fields.country != Some("GB".to_string()) {
          warn!(
            fencer_name = %f.fields.name,
            "Profile does not have a USAF ID"
          );
          FencingTrackerClient::get()
            .await
            .get_profile_by_name(&f.fields.name, f.fields.current_club_name.as_deref())
            .await?
        } else {
          None
        };

        if let Some(profile) = profile {
          let mut notifications = Vec::new();
          let original = f.clone();
          merge_into(&profile, &mut f.fields);

          if f.fields.current_club_name != original.fields.current_club_name {
            notifications.push(fencer_club_changed(f)?);
          }

          if f.fields.current_ratings != original.fields.current_ratings {
            notifications.append(&mut fencer_rating_changed(
              f,
              &original.fields.current_ratings,
            )?);
          }

          if !notifications.is_empty() {
            info!(
              fencer_name = %f.fields.name,
              ?notifications,
              "Sending notifications"
            );

            if let Err(e) = post(notifications).await {
              error!(error = ?e, "Failed to send notifications");
            }
          }

          DB.fencers.patch_document(&original, f).await?;
        } else {
          warn!(
            fencer_name = %f.fields.name,
            "Unable to find FencingTracker profile"
          )
        }
      }

      Ok(())
    }
  }

  // SyncRegistrations and RepairRecentRegistrationsDryRun tasks have been removed.
  // Registration syncing is now handled on-demand via the /v3/view/fencer/{id}/registrations API,
  // and result syncing uses connected fencers from user.trackedFencers.
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
  use crate::fencingtracker::model::{
    EventBoutResult, EventBoutStage, EventResults, EventResultsEntrant,
  };
  use crate::v2::fencer::FencerSearchBuilder;
  use crate::v2::model::FencerFieldsBuilder;
  use cache::InMemoryCache;

  use super::*;
  use assert_matches::assert_matches;

  #[test]
  fn build_event_bout_conversion_inputs_deduplicates_mirrored_rows() {
    let parsed = EventResults {
      event_id: 123,
      entrants: vec![
        EventResultsEntrant {
          usaf_id: 111,
          name: "DOE JANE".to_string(),
          bouts: vec![
            EventBoutResult {
              stage: EventBoutStage::Pool,
              elimination_round_of: None,
              opponent_name: "SMITH JOHN".to_string(),
              opponent_usaf_id: Some(222),
              score_for: 5,
              score_against: 3,
            },
            EventBoutResult {
              stage: EventBoutStage::DirectElimination,
              elimination_round_of: Some(16),
              opponent_name: "SMITH JOHN".to_string(),
              opponent_usaf_id: Some(222),
              score_for: 15,
              score_against: 14,
            },
          ],
        },
        EventResultsEntrant {
          usaf_id: 222,
          name: "SMITH JOHN".to_string(),
          bouts: vec![
            EventBoutResult {
              stage: EventBoutStage::Pool,
              elimination_round_of: None,
              opponent_name: "DOE JANE".to_string(),
              opponent_usaf_id: Some(111),
              score_for: 3,
              score_against: 5,
            },
            EventBoutResult {
              stage: EventBoutStage::DirectElimination,
              elimination_round_of: Some(16),
              opponent_name: "DOE JANE".to_string(),
              opponent_usaf_id: Some(111),
              score_for: 14,
              score_against: 15,
            },
          ],
        },
      ],
      parse_failures: 0,
    };

    let converted = build_event_bout_conversion_inputs(&parsed);
    assert_eq!(converted.len(), 2);
    assert!(
      converted
        .iter()
        .any(|bout| bout.stage == EventBoutStage::Pool
          && bout.left_usaf_id == 111
          && bout.right_usaf_id == Some(222)
          && bout.left_score == 5
          && bout.right_score == 3)
    );
    assert!(
      converted
        .iter()
        .any(|bout| bout.stage == EventBoutStage::DirectElimination
          && bout.left_usaf_id == 111
          && bout.right_usaf_id == Some(222)
          && bout.left_score == 15
          && bout.right_score == 14)
    );
  }

  #[tokio::test]
  #[ignore = "Hits live FencingTracker and requires full runtime config"]
  async fn find_fencers() -> Result<()> {
    let cache = InMemoryCache;
    let client = FencingTrackerClient::new(&cache);

    // An unambiguous name resolves with or without a club.
    assert_matches!(
      client
        .find_fencer_by_name("DUFF Caitlin", Some("Halberstadt Fencers' Club"))
        .await?,
      Some(100344622)
    );
    assert_matches!(
      client.find_fencer_by_name("DUFF Caitlin", None).await?,
      Some(100344622)
    );

    // A name with several holders resolves only when a club separates them...
    assert_matches!(
      client
        .find_fencer_by_name("WANG David", Some("Bay Area Fencing Club"))
        .await?,
      Some(100335535)
    );

    // ...and is refused outright when nothing does. This assertion used to read
    // `Some(100332472)` with the comment "essentially arbitrary": the old
    // matcher broke the tie by picking a candidate. Returning an arbitrary
    // member id for a name shared by several fencers is how one fencer's
    // ratings and results end up attached to another, so the shared resolver
    // declines instead.
    assert_matches!(client.find_fencer_by_name("WANG David", None).await?, None);

    // A club nobody in the result set belongs to is not a licence to guess
    // either. The club is a tie-break, so this falls back to the same refusal.
    assert_matches!(
      client
        .find_fencer_by_name("WANG David", Some("Academy of Totally Imaginary Fencers"))
        .await?,
      None
    );

    Ok(())
  }

  async fn seed_cached_fencer(
    client: &FencingTrackerClient,
    usaf_id: &str,
    name: &str,
    club: Option<&str>,
  ) -> Result<()> {
    let mut builder = FencerFieldsBuilder::default();
    builder.name(name.to_string()).id_detail(
      IdDetailBuilder::default()
        .usaf_id(usaf_id.to_string())
        .build()?,
    );
    if let Some(club) = club {
      builder.current_club_name(club.to_string());
    }
    let fencer = Identified::usaf_id(usaf_id, builder.build()?);
    client.cache.write().await.put(fencer).await?;
    Ok(())
  }

  #[tokio::test]
  async fn find_fencer_with_usaf_id_prefers_id_match_over_name_collisions() -> Result<()> {
    let cache = InMemoryCache;
    let client = FencingTrackerClient::new(&cache);

    seed_cached_fencer(
      &client,
      "100286745",
      "Li, Sonia",
      Some("Bergen Fencing Club"),
    )
    .await?;
    seed_cached_fencer(
      &client,
      "100314522",
      "Li, Sonia",
      Some("Advance Fencing And Fitness Academy"),
    )
    .await?;

    let search = FencerSearchBuilder::default()
      .usaf_id("100314522".to_string())
      .name("LI Sonia".to_string())
      .club(Some("Advance Fencing And Fitness Academy".to_string()))
      .build()?;

    let result = client.find_fencer(&search, false).await?;
    assert_eq!(
      result.and_then(|f| f.fields.current_club_name),
      Some("Advance Fencing And Fitness Academy".to_string())
    );
    Ok(())
  }

  #[tokio::test]
  async fn find_fencer_does_not_fallback_to_name_when_usaf_id_misses_cache() -> Result<()> {
    let cache = InMemoryCache;
    let client = FencingTrackerClient::new(&cache);

    // Seed cache with a different "Sonia Li" profile.
    let wrong_fencer = Identified::usaf_id(
      "100286745",
      FencerFieldsBuilder::default()
        .name("Li, Sonia".to_string())
        .current_club_name("Unrelated Club".to_string())
        .build()?,
    );
    client.cache.write().await.put(wrong_fencer).await?;

    let search = FencerSearch {
      usaf_id: Some("100314522".to_string()),
      name: Some("LI Sonia".to_string()),
      club: Some("Advance Fencing And Fitness Academy".to_string()),
      gender: None,
    };

    let result = client.find_fencer(&search, false).await?;
    assert!(result.is_none());

    Ok(())
  }

  #[tokio::test]
  async fn find_fencer_with_club_rejects_name_match_when_club_mismatches() -> Result<()> {
    let cache = InMemoryCache;
    let client = FencingTrackerClient::new(&cache);

    seed_cached_fencer(
      &client,
      "100286745",
      "Li, Sonia",
      Some("Bergen Fencing Club"),
    )
    .await?;

    let search = FencerSearchBuilder::default()
      .name("LI Sonia".to_string())
      .club(Some("Advance Fencing And Fitness Academy".to_string()))
      .build()?;

    let result = client.find_fencer(&search, false).await?;
    assert!(result.is_none());
    Ok(())
  }

  #[tokio::test]
  async fn find_fencer_matches_cached_club_by_abbreviation() -> Result<()> {
    let cache = InMemoryCache;
    let client = FencingTrackerClient::new(&cache);

    let fencer = Identified::usaf_id(
      "100314522",
      FencerFieldsBuilder::default()
        .name("Li, Sonia".to_string())
        .current_club_name("Advance Fencing And Fitness Academy".to_string())
        .build()?,
    );
    client.cache.write().await.put(fencer).await?;

    let search = FencerSearch {
      usaf_id: None,
      name: Some("LI Sonia".to_string()),
      club: Some("AFFA".to_string()),
      gender: None,
    };

    let result = client.find_fencer(&search, false).await?;
    assert_eq!(result.map(|f| f.fields.name), Some("Li, Sonia".to_string()));

    Ok(())
  }

  #[tokio::test]
  async fn find_fencer_no_club_returns_none_when_multiple_name_matches() -> Result<()> {
    let cache = InMemoryCache;
    let client = FencingTrackerClient::new(&cache);

    seed_cached_fencer(
      &client,
      "100286745",
      "Li, Sonia",
      Some("Bergen Fencing Club"),
    )
    .await?;
    seed_cached_fencer(
      &client,
      "100314522",
      "Li, Sonia",
      Some("Advance Fencing And Fitness Academy"),

    .await?;

    let search = FencerSearchBuilder::default()
      .name("LI Sonia".to_string())
      .build()?;
    let result = client.find_fencer(&search, false).await?;
    assert!(result.is_none());
    Ok(())
  }

  #[tokio::test]
  async fn find_fencer_no_club_returns_match_when_unique_name_match() -> Result<()> {
    let cache = InMemoryCache;
    let client = FencingTrackerClient::new(&cache);

    seed_cached_fencer(
      &client,
      "100344622",
      "Duff, Caitlin",
      Some("Globus Fencing Academy"),

    .await?;

    );
    Ok(())
  }

  fn sample_api_fencer() -> model::Fencer {
    model::Fencer {
      id: 100344622,
      name: "DOE JANE".to_string(),
      country: "USA".to_string(),
      club: Some("New Club".to_string()),
      birth_year: Some(2010),
      registrations: vec![],
      rating_history: vec![],
      results: vec![],
    }
  }

  #[test]
  fn fencer_fields_json_has_no_british_fencing_licence() {
    let fields = FencerFieldsBuilder::default()
      .name("Doe, Jane".to_string())
      .build()
      .unwrap();
    let json = serde_json::to_value(&fields).unwrap();
    assert!(
      json.get("britishFencingLicence").is_none(),
      "the shared licence must not live on scraper-owned FencerFields"
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn fencer_refresh_merge_does_not_patch_a_licence_path() {
    // SyncFencerInfo clones the stored fencer, merge_into's scraper fields,
    // then patch_document. The shared licence is a sidecar record
    // (`bfl-{fencer_id}` in `fencer_british_licences`), so this mutation
    // must not emit a patch op that could clear it — and FencerFields
    // must not grow a licence key that merge_into would default to None.
    let original =
      crate::v2::testing::test_fencer("abc", "Doe, Jane", Some("100344622"), Some("Old Club"));
    let mut refreshed = original.clone();
    merge_into(&sample_api_fencer(), &mut refreshed.fields);

    let patch = json_patch::diff(
      &serde_json::to_value(&original).unwrap(),
      &serde_json::to_value(&refreshed).unwrap(),
    );
    for op in patch.0.iter() {
      let path = match op {
        json_patch::PatchOperation::Add(op) => op.path.as_str(),
        json_patch::PatchOperation::Remove(op) => op.path.as_str(),
        json_patch::PatchOperation::Replace(op) => op.path.as_str(),
        json_patch::PatchOperation::Move(op) => op.path.as_str(),
        json_patch::PatchOperation::Copy(op) => op.path.as_str(),
        json_patch::PatchOperation::Test(op) => op.path.as_str(),
      };
      let lower = path.to_ascii_lowercase();
      assert!(
        !lower.contains("licence")
          && !lower.contains("license")
          && !path.contains("britishFencing"),
        "fencer refresh must not patch a licence path, got {path}"
      );
    }

    let after = serde_json::to_value(&refreshed.fields).unwrap();
    assert!(after.get("britishFencingLicence").is_none());
    assert_ne!(
      crate::fencer_licence::document_id(&ids::TypedId::<ids::FencerId>::usaf("100344622")),
      original.id,
      "licence sidecar id must not collide with the fencer document id"
    );
  }
}

**Before (merge base)** (`backend/blob/src/share/view.rs` @ `9806138106ee6c5da6840b58b468bbc4f3e0b8af`):

```
//! Anonymous, read-only share-view API: `GET /api/v3/share/results/view`,
//! `GET /api/v3/share/results/view/events/{tournament_id}/{event_id}`, and
//! `GET /api/v3/share/results/view/standings`. See
//! `docs/design-docs/private-results-share-links.md` and, for the standings
//! route specifically,
//! `docs/design-docs/british-fencing-rankings-as-a-standings-source.md`.
//!
//! Every failure mode — missing header, unknown token, revoked, expired, or
//! the owner document gone — collapses to the same generic 404
//! ([`unavailable`]). That is a deliberate anti-enumeration property (see
//! the design doc's Revocation section), not an oversight: do not add a
//! response that distinguishes any of those causes.
//!
//! These handlers never read `Authorization` or any other identity header.
//! Video visibility comes **only** from the share link's owner id, resolved
//! via [`share::resolve_live_link`] and threaded into
//! [`results::get_event`] as `viewer_user_id` — never from whoever is making
//! the anonymous request, signed in or not. That is what makes "a logged-in
//! recipient does not get their own private videos mixed in" true by
//! construction rather than by a check that could be forgotten.

use axum::Json;
use axum::extract::{Path, Request};
use axum::http::{HeaderMap, HeaderValue, StatusCode, header};
use axum::middleware::{self, Next};
use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Response};
use routez::RoutezRouter;
use serde::Serialize;
use tracing::{error, warn};

use ids::{Identified, ResultsShareLinkId, TypedId};

use crate::share::{self, ResultsShareLinkFields};
use crate::view::fencer::fetch_db_fencer_fields;
use crate::view::ids::parse_typed_id;
use crate::view::results::{self, Event, Tournament};
use crate::view::standings::fencer as standings_fencer;

use super::rate_limit;

/// Header carrying the share-link bearer token. Never placed in a URI or
/// query string — see the design doc's Hardening / Logging section. Also
/// referenced by `crate::cors` so it stays in CORS's `allow_headers` (a
/// browser strips any header not listed there from a cross-origin request).
pub(crate) const SHARE_TOKEN_HEADER: &str = "x-flunge-share-token";

/// Router for the anonymous share-view routes, mounted at `/share` alongside
/// (but not gated by) the authenticated owner router in [`super::api`].
/// Every response — success or failure — carries `Cache-Control: private,
/// no-store`: these are authenticated-equivalent payloads served anonymously
/// and must never be stored by a shared cache.
pub fn router() -> RoutezRouter {
  let router = RoutezRouter::new()
    .route_get("/results/view", get_share_results_view)
    .route_get(
      "/results/view/events/{tournament_id}/{event_id}",
      get_share_event_view,
    )
    .route_get("/results/view/standings", get_share_standings_view)
    .route_get(
      "/results/view/standings/{standing_key}/composition",
      get_share_standing_composition_view,
    )
    .merge(super::plan_view::router());

  let (inner, routes) = router.finish();
  RoutezRouter::from_parts(
    inner.layer(middleware::from_fn(no_store_middleware)),
    routes,
  )
}

pub(super) async fn no_store_middleware(request: Request, next: Next) -> Response {
  let mut response = next.run(request).await;
  response.headers_mut().insert(
    header::CACHE_CONTROL,
    HeaderValue::from_static("private, no-store"),
  );
  response
}

/// The generic "this link isn't available" response — same body and status
/// for missing header / unknown / revoked / expired / owner-gone alike.
pub(super) fn unavailable() -> Response {
  (StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "Share link not found").into_response()
}

pub(super) fn too_many_requests() -> Response {
  (StatusCode::TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, "Too many requests").into_response()
}

pub(super) fn internal_error() -> Response {
  (
    StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
    "An internal error occurred",
  )
    .into_response()
}

/// Extracts the bearer token from [`SHARE_TOKEN_HEADER`]. `None` on a
/// missing, non-UTF-8, or empty header — all treated identically by the
/// caller (see the module doc).
pub(super) fn share_token(headers: &HeaderMap) -> Option<&str> {
  headers
    .get(SHARE_TOKEN_HEADER)?
    .to_str()
    .ok()
    .filter(|token| !token.is_empty())
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct ShareResultsViewResponse {
  fencer_id: String,
  fencer_name: String,
  created_at: String,
  expires_at: String,
  tournaments: Vec<Tournament>,
}

async fn get_share_results_view(headers: HeaderMap) -> Response {
  if !rate_limit::allow(&headers) {
    return too_many_requests();
  }

  let Some(token) = share_token(&headers) else {
    return unavailable();
  };

  let link = match share::resolve_live_link(token).await {
    Ok(Some(link)) => link,
    Ok(None) => return unavailable(),
    Err(err) => {
      error!(error = ?err, "failed to resolve share link for results view");
      return internal_error();
    }
  };

  render_results_view(link).await
}

async fn render_results_view(link: Identified<ResultsShareLinkFields>) -> Response {
  let rsl_id = TypedId::<ResultsShareLinkId>::database(&link.id);
  let fencer_id = link.fields.fencer_id.clone();

  let fencer_name = match fetch_db_fencer_fields(&fencer_id).await {
    Ok(Some(fields)) => fields.name,
    Ok(None) => {
      warn!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, "share link's connected fencer no longer exists");
      return unavailable();
    }
    Err(err) => {
      error!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, error = ?err, "failed to load fencer for share view");
      return internal_error();
    }
  };

  let tournaments = match results::get_tournaments(fencer_id.clone()).await {
    Ok(tournaments) => tournaments,
    Err(
      err @ (results::ResultsError::NotFound(_)
      | results::ResultsError::InvalidId(..)
      | results::ResultsError::FencerNotFound),
    ) => {
      warn!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, error = ?err, "share view tournaments were not found");
      return unavailable();
    }
    Err(err) => {
      error!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, error = ?err, "failed to load tournaments for share view");
      return internal_error();
    }
  };

  Json(ShareResultsViewResponse {
    fencer_id: fencer_id.to_string(),
    fencer_name,
    created_at: link.fields.created_at.to_rfc3339(),
    expires_at: link.fields.expires_at.to_rfc3339(),
    tournaments,
  })
  .into_response()
}

async fn get_share_event_view(
  headers: HeaderMap,
  Path((tournament_id, event_id)): Path<(String, String)>,
) -> Response {
  if !rate_limit::allow(&headers) {
    return too_many_requests();
  }

  let Some(token) = share_token(&headers) else {
    return unavailable();
  };

  let Ok(tournament_id) = parse_typed_id(&tournament_id, "tournament") else {
    return unavailable();
  };
  let Ok(event_id) = parse_typed_id(&event_id, "event") else {
    return unavailable();
  };

  let link = match share::resolve_live_link(token).await {
    Ok(Some(link)) => link,
    Ok(None) => return unavailable(),
    Err(err) => {
      error!(error = ?err, "failed to resolve share link for event view");
      return internal_error();
    }
  };

  render_event_view(link, tournament_id, event_id).await
}

async fn render_event_view(
  link: Identified<ResultsShareLinkFields>,
  tournament_id: TypedId<ids::TournamentId>,
  event_id: TypedId<ids::EventId>,
) -> Response {
  let rsl_id = TypedId::<ResultsShareLinkId>::database(&link.id);
  let owner_user_id = link.fields.owner_user_id.clone();
  let fencer_id = link.fields.fencer_id.clone();

  match results::get_event(fencer_id, tournament_id, event_id, Some(owner_user_id)).await {
    Ok(event) => share_event_response(event),
    Err(
      err @ (results::ResultsError::NotFound(_)
      | results::ResultsError::InvalidId(..)
      | results::ResultsError::FencerNotFound),
    ) => {
      warn!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, error = ?err, "share view event was not found");
      unavailable()
    }
    Err(err) => {
      error!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, error = ?err, "failed to load event for share view");
      internal_error()
    }
  }
}

fn share_event_response(event: Event) -> Response {
  Json(event).into_response()
}

/// Owner-scoped standings for a live share link: the internal standings
/// assembly entry point (`standings_fencer::get_fencer_standings`), reused
/// exactly as the owner's own `/view/standings/fencer/{fencer_id}` route
/// uses it, but resolving the British Fencing licence from the link's own
/// `owner_user_id` and bound `fencer_id` instead of a Clerk session. No
/// `fencer_id` path segment -- a link can only ever answer for the one
/// fencer it is bound to -- and no `Authorization`/identity header is ever
/// read here, so a signed-in recipient's own session cannot substitute a
/// different fencer or licence (see the module doc's "ignore-recipient-auth"
/// guarantee). Inherits the generic-404, no-store, and rate-limit
/// guarantees the same way every other handler in this module does.
async fn get_share_standings_view(headers: HeaderMap) -> Response {
  if !rate_limit::allow(&headers) {
    return too_many_requests();
  }

  let Some(token) = share_token(&headers) else {
    return unavailable();
  };

  let resolution = match share::resolve_live_link_with_owner(token).await {
    Ok(Some(resolution)) => resolution,
    Ok(None) => return unavailable(),
    Err(err) => {
      error!(error = ?err, "failed to resolve share link for standings view");
      return internal_error();
    }
  };

  render_standings_view(resolution).await
}

async fn render_standings_view(resolution: share::ResolvedResultsShareLink) -> Response {
  let link = resolution.link;
  let rsl_id = TypedId::<ResultsShareLinkId>::database(&link.id);
  let fencer_id = link.fields.fencer_id.clone();

  let british_licence =
    standings_fencer::licence_for_fencer(&resolution.owner.fields.tracked_fencers, &fencer_id);

  match standings_fencer::get_fencer_standings(fencer_id, british_licence.as_deref()).await {
    // Same payload as the owner handler: attach movement, then drop
    // unsubstantiated summaries. A Redis miss omits `movement` rather than
    // failing the share page.
    Ok(response) => Json(standings_fencer::standings_view_payload(response).await).into_response(),
    Err(err) => {
      error!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, error = ?err, "failed to load standings for share view");
      internal_error()
    }
  }
}

/// Composition for the exact fencer bound to a live results-share link. The
/// fencer id and British licence are both resolved from the link and owner;
/// neither may be supplied by the recipient.
async fn get_share_standing_composition_view(
  headers: HeaderMap,
  Path(raw_standing_key): Path<String>,
) -> Response {
  if !rate_limit::allow(&headers) {
    return too_many_requests();
  }

  let Some(token) = share_token(&headers) else {
    return unavailable();
  };
  let Ok(standing_key) = standings_fencer::parse_standing_key(&raw_standing_key) else {
    return unavailable();
  };

  let resolution = match share::resolve_live_link_with_owner(token).await {
    Ok(Some(resolution)) => resolution,
    Ok(None) => return unavailable(),
    Err(err) => {
      error!(error = ?err, "failed to resolve share link for standings composition");
      return internal_error();
    }
  };

  render_standing_composition_view(resolution, standing_key).await
}

async fn render_standing_composition_view(
  resolution: share::ResolvedResultsShareLink,
  standing_key: TypedId<ids::StandingId>,
) -> Response {
  let link = resolution.link;
  let rsl_id = TypedId::<ResultsShareLinkId>::database(&link.id);
  let fencer_id = link.fields.fencer_id.clone();
  let british_licence =
    standings_fencer::licence_for_fencer(&resolution.owner.fields.tracked_fencers, &fencer_id);

  match standings_fencer::get_standing_composition(
    fencer_id,
    standing_key,
    british_licence.as_deref(),
  )
  .await
  {
    Ok(response) => Json(response).into_response(),
    Err(
      err @ (crate::view::standings::StandingsError::InvalidStandingKey(_)
      | crate::view::standings::StandingsError::StandingNotFound(_)),
    ) => {
      warn!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, error = ?err, "share view standing composition was not found");
      unavailable()
    }
    Err(err) => {
      error!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, error = ?err, "failed to load share view standing composition");
      internal_error()
    }
  }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
  use super::*;
  use axum::body::Body;
  use axum::http::HeaderValue;
  use tower::ServiceExt;

  fn headers_with_token(value: &str) -> HeaderMap {
    let mut headers = HeaderMap::new();
    headers.insert(SHARE_TOKEN_HEADER, HeaderValue::from_str(value).unwrap());
    headers
  }

  #[test]
  fn share_token_reads_the_configured_header() {
    let headers = headers_with_token("abc123");
    assert_eq!(share_token(&headers), Some("abc123"));
  }

  #[test]
  fn share_token_is_none_when_header_missing() {
    assert_eq!(share_token(&HeaderMap::new()), None);
  }

  #[test]
  fn share_token_is_none_when_header_empty() {
    let headers = headers_with_token("");
    assert_eq!(share_token(&headers), None);
  }

  #[tokio::test]
  async fn missing_token_header_is_a_404() {
    let response = get_share_results_view(HeaderMap::new()).await;
    assert_eq!(response.status(), StatusCode::NOT_FOUND);
  }

  #[tokio::test]
  async fn tokenless_route_response_has_no_store_cache_control() {
    let (router, _) = router().finish();
    let response = router
      .oneshot(
        axum::http::Request::builder()
          .uri("/results/view")
          .header("x-forwarded-for", "198.51.100.1")
          .body(Body::empty())
          .unwrap(),
      )
      .await
      .unwrap();

    assert_eq!(response.status(), StatusCode::NOT_FOUND);
    assert_eq!(
      response.headers().get(header::CACHE_CONTROL).unwrap(),
      "private, no-store"
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn router_registers_the_standings_view_route() {
    assert!(router().routes().iter().any(|route| {
      route.method == axum::http::Method::GET && route.path == "/results/view/standings"
    }));
  }

  #[test]
  fn router_registers_the_standings_composition_view_route() {
    assert!(router().routes().iter().any(|route| {
      route.method == axum::http::Method::GET
        && route.path == "/results/view/standings/{standing_key}/composition"
    }));
  }

  #[tokio::test]
  async fn standings_view_missing_token_header_is_a_generic_404() {
    let response = get_share_standings_view(HeaderMap::new()).await;
    assert_eq!(response.status(), StatusCode::NOT_FOUND);
  }

  #[tokio::test]
  async fn standings_composition_view_missing_token_header_is_a_generic_404() {
    let response =
      get_share_standing_composition_view(HeaderMap::new(), Path("s.d.gb-CDTWS".to_string())).await;
    assert_eq!(response.status(), StatusCode::NOT_FOUND);
  }

  #[tokio::test]
  async fn standings_view_tokenless_route_response_has_no_store_cache_control() {
    let (router, _) = router().finish();
    let response = router
