```
//! Anonymous, read-only share-view API: `GET /api/v3/share/results/view`,
//! `GET /api/v3/share/results/view/events/{tournament_id}/{event_id}`, and
//! `GET /api/v3/share/results/view/standings`. See
//! `docs/design-docs/private-results-share-links.md` and, for the standings
//! route specifically,
//! `docs/design-docs/british-fencing-rankings-as-a-standings-source.md`.
//!
//! Every failure mode — missing header, unknown token, revoked, expired, or
//! the owner document gone — collapses to the same generic 404
//! ([`unavailable`]). That is a deliberate anti-enumeration property (see
//! the design doc's Revocation section), not an oversight: do not add a
//! response that distinguishes any of those causes.
//!
//! These handlers never read `Authorization` or any other identity header.
//! Video visibility comes **only** from the share link's owner id, resolved
//! via [`share::resolve_live_link`] and threaded into
//! [`results::get_event`] as `viewer_user_id` — never from whoever is making
//! the anonymous request, signed in or not. That is what makes "a logged-in
//! recipient does not get their own private videos mixed in" true by
//! construction rather than by a check that could be forgotten.

use axum::Json;
use axum::extract::{Path, Request};
use axum::http::{HeaderMap, HeaderValue, StatusCode, header};
use axum::middleware::{self, Next};
use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Response};
use routez::RoutezRouter;
use serde::Serialize;
use tracing::{error, warn};

use ids::{Identified, ResultsShareLinkId, TypedId};

use crate::share::{self, ResultsShareLinkFields};
use crate::view::fencer::fetch_db_fencer_fields;
use crate::view::ids::parse_typed_id;
use crate::view::results::{self, Event, Tournament};
use crate::view::standings::fencer as standings_fencer;

use super::rate_limit;

/// Header carrying the share-link bearer token. Never placed in a URI or
/// query string — see the design doc's Hardening / Logging section. Also
/// referenced by `crate::cors` so it stays in CORS's `allow_headers` (a
/// browser strips any header not listed there from a cross-origin request).
pub(crate) const SHARE_TOKEN_HEADER: &str = "x-flunge-share-token";

/// Router for the anonymous share-view routes, mounted at `/share` alongside
/// (but not gated by) the authenticated owner router in [`super::api`].
/// Every response — success or failure — carries `Cache-Control: private,
/// no-store`: these are authenticated-equivalent payloads served anonymously
/// and must never be stored by a shared cache.
pub fn router() -> RoutezRouter {
  let router = RoutezRouter::new()
    .route_get("/results/view", get_share_results_view)
    .route_get(
      "/results/view/events/{tournament_id}/{event_id}",
      get_share_event_view,
    )
    .route_get("/results/view/standings", get_share_standings_view)
    .route_get(
      "/results/view/standings/{standing_key}/composition",
      get_share_standing_composition_view,
    )
    .merge(super::plan_view::router());

  let (inner, routes) = router.finish();
  RoutezRouter::from_parts(
    inner.layer(middleware::from_fn(no_store_middleware)),
    routes,
  )
}

pub(super) async fn no_store_middleware(request: Request, next: Next) -> Response {
  let mut response = next.run(request).await;
  response.headers_mut().insert(
    header::CACHE_CONTROL,
    HeaderValue::from_static("private, no-store"),
  );
  response
}

/// The generic "this link isn't available" response — same body and status
/// for missing header / unknown / revoked / expired / owner-gone alike.
pub(super) fn unavailable() -> Response {
  (StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "Share link not found").into_response()
}

pub(super) fn too_many_requests() -> Response {
  (StatusCode::TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, "Too many requests").into_response()
}

pub(super) fn internal_error() -> Response {
  (
    StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
    "An internal error occurred",
  )
    .into_response()
}

/// Extracts the bearer token from [`SHARE_TOKEN_HEADER`]. `None` on a
/// missing, non-UTF-8, or empty header — all treated identically by the
/// caller (see the module doc).
pub(super) fn share_token(headers: &HeaderMap) -> Option<&str> {
  headers
    .get(SHARE_TOKEN_HEADER)?
    .to_str()
    .ok()
    .filter(|token| !token.is_empty())
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct ShareResultsViewResponse {
  fencer_id: String,
  fencer_name: String,
  created_at: String,
  expires_at: String,
  tournaments: Vec<Tournament>,
}

async fn get_share_results_view(headers: HeaderMap) -> Response {
  if !rate_limit::allow(&headers) {
    return too_many_requests();
  }

  let Some(token) = share_token(&headers) else {
    return unavailable();
  };

  let link = match share::resolve_live_link(token).await {
    Ok(Some(link)) => link,
    Ok(None) => return unavailable(),
    Err(err) => {
      error!(error = ?err, "failed to resolve share link for results view");
      return internal_error();
    }
  };

  render_results_view(link).await
}

async fn render_results_view(link: Identified<ResultsShareLinkFields>) -> Response {
  let rsl_id = TypedId::<ResultsShareLinkId>::database(&link.id);
  let fencer_id = link.fields.fencer_id.clone();

  let fencer_name = match fetch_db_fencer_fields(&fencer_id).await {
    Ok(Some(fields)) => fields.name,
    Ok(None) => {
      warn!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, "share link's connected fencer no longer exists");
      return unavailable();
    }
    Err(err) => {
      error!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, error = ?err, "failed to load fencer for share view");
      return internal_error();
    }
  };

  let tournaments = match results::get_tournaments(fencer_id.clone()).await {
    Ok(tournaments) => tournaments,
    Err(
      err @ (results::ResultsError::NotFound(_)
      | results::ResultsError::InvalidId(..)
      | results::ResultsError::FencerNotFound),
    ) => {
      warn!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, error = ?err, "share view tournaments were not found");
      return unavailable();
    }
    Err(err) => {
      error!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, error = ?err, "failed to load tournaments for share view");
      return internal_error();
    }
  };

  Json(ShareResultsViewResponse {
    fencer_id: fencer_id.to_string(),
    fencer_name,
    created_at: link.fields.created_at.to_rfc3339(),
    expires_at: link.fields.expires_at.to_rfc3339(),
    tournaments,
  })
  .into_response()
}

async fn get_share_event_view(
  headers: HeaderMap,
  Path((tournament_id, event_id)): Path<(String, String)>,
) -> Response {
  if !rate_limit::allow(&headers) {
    return too_many_requests();
  }

  let Some(token) = share_token(&headers) else {
    return unavailable();
  };

  let Ok(tournament_id) = parse_typed_id(&tournament_id, "tournament") else {
    return unavailable();
  };
  let Ok(event_id) = parse_typed_id(&event_id, "event") else {
    return unavailable();
  };

  let link = match share::resolve_live_link(token).await {
    Ok(Some(link)) => link,
    Ok(None) => return unavailable(),
    Err(err) => {
      error!(error = ?err, "failed to resolve share link for event view");
      return internal_error();
    }
  };

  render_event_view(link, tournament_id, event_id).await
}

async fn render_event_view(
  link: Identified<ResultsShareLinkFields>,
  tournament_id: TypedId<ids::TournamentId>,
  event_id: TypedId<ids::EventId>,
) -> Response {
  let rsl_id = TypedId::<ResultsShareLinkId>::database(&link.id);
  let owner_user_id = link.fields.owner_user_id.clone();
  let fencer_id = link.fields.fencer_id.clone();

  match results::get_event(fencer_id, tournament_id, event_id, Some(owner_user_id)).await {
    Ok(event) => share_event_response(event),
    Err(
      err @ (results::ResultsError::NotFound(_)
      | results::ResultsError::InvalidId(..)
      | results::ResultsError::FencerNotFound),
    ) => {
      warn!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, error = ?err, "share view event was not found");
      unavailable()
    }
    Err(err) => {
      error!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, error = ?err, "failed to load event for share view");
      internal_error()
    }
  }
}

fn share_event_response(event: Event) -> Response {
  Json(event).into_response()
}

/// Owner-scoped standings for a live share link: the internal standings
/// assembly entry point (`standings_fencer::get_fencer_standings`), reused
/// exactly as the owner's own `/view/standings/fencer/{fencer_id}` route
/// uses it, but resolving the British Fencing licence from the link's own
/// `owner_user_id` and bound `fencer_id` instead of a Clerk session. No
/// `fencer_id` path segment -- a link can only ever answer for the one
/// fencer it is bound to -- and no `Authorization`/identity header is ever
/// read here, so a signed-in recipient's own session cannot substitute a
/// different fencer or licence (see the module doc's "ignore-recipient-auth"
/// guarantee). Inherits the generic-404, no-store, and rate-limit
/// guarantees the same way every other handler in this module does.
async fn get_share_standings_view(headers: HeaderMap) -> Response {
  if !rate_limit::allow(&headers) {
    return too_many_requests();
  }

  let Some(token) = share_token(&headers) else {
    return unavailable();
  };

  let resolution = match share::resolve_live_link_with_owner(token).await {
    Ok(Some(resolution)) => resolution,
    Ok(None) => return unavailable(),
    Err(err) => {
      error!(error = ?err, "failed to resolve share link for standings view");
      return internal_error();
    }
  };

  render_standings_view(resolution).await
}

async fn render_standings_view(resolution: share::ResolvedResultsShareLink) -> Response {
  let link = resolution.link;
  let rsl_id = TypedId::<ResultsShareLinkId>::database(&link.id);
  let fencer_id = link.fields.fencer_id.clone();

  let british_licence =
    standings_fencer::licence_for_fencer(&resolution.owner.fields.tracked_fencers, &fencer_id)
      .await;

  match standings_fencer::get_fencer_standings(fencer_id, british_licence.as_deref()).await {
    // Same payload as the owner handler: attach movement, then drop
    // unsubstantiated summaries. A Redis miss omits `movement` rather than
    // failing the share page.
    Ok(response) => Json(standings_fencer::standings_view_payload(response).await).into_response(),
    Err(err) => {
      error!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, error = ?err, "failed to load standings for share view");
      internal_error()
    }
  }
}

/// Composition for the exact fencer bound to a live results-share link. The
/// fencer id and British licence are both resolved from the link and owner;
/// neither may be supplied by the recipient.
async fn get_share_standing_composition_view(
  headers: HeaderMap,
  Path(raw_standing_key): Path<String>,
) -> Response {
  if !rate_limit::allow(&headers) {
    return too_many_requests();
  }

  let Some(token) = share_token(&headers) else {
    return unavailable();
  };
  let Ok(standing_key) = standings_fencer::parse_standing_key(&raw_standing_key) else {
    return unavailable();
  };

  let resolution = match share::resolve_live_link_with_owner(token).await {
    Ok(Some(resolution)) => resolution,
    Ok(None) => return unavailable(),
    Err(err) => {
      error!(error = ?err, "failed to resolve share link for standings composition");
      return internal_error();
    }
  };

  render_standing_composition_view(resolution, standing_key).await
}

async fn render_standing_composition_view(
  resolution: share::ResolvedResultsShareLink,
  standing_key: TypedId<ids::StandingId>,
) -> Response {
  let link = resolution.link;
  let rsl_id = TypedId::<ResultsShareLinkId>::database(&link.id);
  let fencer_id = link.fields.fencer_id.clone();
  let british_licence =
    standings_fencer::licence_for_fencer(&resolution.owner.fields.tracked_fencers, &fencer_id)
      .await;

  match standings_fencer::get_standing_composition(
    fencer_id,
    standing_key,
    british_licence.as_deref(),
  )
  .await
  {
    Ok(response) => Json(response).into_response(),
    Err(
      err @ (crate::view::standings::StandingsError::InvalidStandingKey(_)
      | crate::view::standings::StandingsError::StandingNotFound(_)),
    ) => {
      warn!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, error = ?err, "share view standing composition was not found");
      unavailable()
    }
    Err(err) => {
      error!(rsl_id = %rsl_id, error = ?err, "failed to load share view standing composition");
      internal_error()
    }
  }
}
```

```
//! Per-run capture: walk tracked fencers, snapshot each standing, write
//! movement, then the receipt.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use flunge_config::CONF;
use ids::{FencerId, TypedId};
use model_common::RecognizedClassifier;
use standings_history::{
  CompositionCapture, NotCapturedReason, ReceiptOutcome, SnapshotRunReceiptFields,
  SourceObservation, StandingSnapshotFields, StandingSnapshotProjection, compute_movement,
  generate_snapshot_id, repository,
};
use standings_index::RankingScope;
use tracing::{info, warn};

use crate::db::DB;
use crate::v2::user::get_all_connected_fencer_ids_and_licences;
use crate::view::standings::british_rankings_enabled;
use crate::view::standings::fencer::{
  FencerStandingItem, composition_route, get_fencer_standings, resolve_composition_body,
};

use super::composition::{composition_capture_from_body, skip_live_composition};
use super::state::{
  CaptureCounts, HistoryRunState, note_snapshot_bounds, read_run_state, slot_run_id,
  write_movement, write_run_state,
};

pub struct CaptureOutcome {
  pub run_id: String,
  pub counts: CaptureCounts,
}

pub async fn capture_run(explicit_run_id: Option<String>) -> Result<CaptureOutcome> {
  let now = Utc::now();
  let run_id = match explicit_run_id {
    Some(id) => id,
    None => slot_run_id(now)?,
  };
  let started = Instant::now();
  let deadline = started + Duration::from_secs(CONF.standings_history.max_run_seconds);
  let ttl = document_ttl_seconds();
  let capture_live = CONF.standings_history.capture_live_compositions;
  let cooldown_active = standings_index::refresh_cooldown_is_active(now)
    .await
    .unwrap_or_else(|error| {
      warn!(
        error = ?error,
        "Failed to read standings refresh cooldown; treating it as inactive"
      );
      false
    });

  let mut state = read_run_state().await.unwrap_or_default();
  state.last_attempt_at = Some(now);
  state.last_attempt_run_id = Some(run_id.clone());
  write_run_state(&state).await?;

  let (connected_fencer_ids, licence_pairs) = get_all_connected_fencer_ids_and_licences()
    .await
    .context("enumerating connected fencers and British Fencing licence assertions")?;
  let mut fencer_ids: Vec<u32> = connected_fencer_ids.into_iter().collect();
  fencer_ids.sort_unstable();

  let licence_assertions = group_licence_assertions(licence_pairs);

  let british_rankings_enabled = british_rankings_enabled().await.unwrap_or_else(|error| {
    warn!(
      error = ?error,
      "Failed to read British rankings runtime flag; treating standings history capture as British-disabled this run"
    );
    false
  });
  if !british_rankings_enabled {
    warn!(
      run_id = %run_id,
      "British rankings runtime flag (standings.british_rankings_enabled) is disabled; \
       this capture run will write no British (gb-) snapshots -- every tracked fencer with a \
       British licence will read as unranked rather than uncaptured until it is re-enabled"
    );
  }

  info!(
    run_id = %run_id,
    fencer_count = fencer_ids.len(),
    capture_live,
    cooldown_active,
    british_rankings_enabled,
    "Starting standings history capture"
  );

  let mut counts = CaptureCounts {
    british_rankings_flag_disabled: !british_rankings_enabled,
    ..CaptureCounts::default()
  };
  let mut last_live_fetch = Instant::now()
    .checked_sub(Duration::from_secs(3600))
    .unwrap_or_else(Instant::now);
  let mut attempted = 0usize;

  for usaf_id in &fencer_ids {
    if Instant::now() >= deadline {
      break;
    }
    attempted += 1;
    let fencer_id = TypedId::<FencerId>::usaf(&usaf_id.to_string());
    let british_licence = if british_rankings_enabled {
      resolve_fencer_british_licence(*usaf_id, &licence_assertions, &mut counts)
    } else {
      None
    };
    match capture_one_fencer(FencerCaptureParams {
      fencer_id: &fencer_id,
      run_id: &run_id,
      ttl,
      capture_live,
      cooldown_active,
      deadline,
      last_live_fetch: &mut last_live_fetch,
      counts: &mut counts,
      state: &mut state,
      british_licence,
    })
    .await
    {
      Ok(FencerCaptureResult::Succeeded) => {
        counts.fencers_attempted += 1;
        counts.fencers_succeeded += 1;
      }
      Ok(FencerCaptureResult::Failed) => {
        counts.fencers_attempted += 1;
        counts.fencers_failed += 1;
      }
      Err(error) => {
        counts.fencers_attempted += 1;
        counts.fencers_failed += 1;
        warn!(
          fencer_id = %fencer_id,
          run_id = %run_id,
          error = ?error,
          "Standings history capture failed for fencer"
        );
        if let Err(receipt_error) =
          upsert_failed_receipt(&fencer_id, &run_id, ttl, &error.to_string()).await
        {
          warn!(
            fencer_id = %fencer_id,
            error = ?receipt_error,
            "Failed to write standings history failure receipt"
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  counts.fencers_unattempted = (fencer_ids.len() - attempted) as u32;
  state.last_run_counts = Some(counts.clone());
  if counts.is_complete() {
    state.last_success_at = Some(Utc::now());
    state.last_failure_at = None;
    state.last_failure_reason = None;
  } else {
    state.last_failure_at = Some(Utc::now());
    state.last_failure_reason = Some(counts.summary());
  }
  write_run_state(&state).await?;

  Ok(CaptureOutcome { run_id, counts })
}

enum FencerCaptureResult {
  Succeeded,
  Failed,
}

struct FencerCaptureParams<'a> {
  fencer_id: &'a TypedId<FencerId>,
  run_id: &'a str,
  ttl: i64,
  capture_live: bool,
  cooldown_active: bool,
  deadline: Instant,
  last_live_fetch: &'a mut Instant,
  counts: &'a mut CaptureCounts,
  state: &'a mut HistoryRunState,
  /// This fencer's single unambiguous British Fencing licence, or `None`
  /// when nobody asserts one or households disagree -- see
  /// [`resolve_british_licence`]. `get_fencer_standings`/
  /// `resolve_composition_body` already omit British items on `None`
  /// regardless of the reason, so no separate USA-only path is needed here.
  british_licence: Option<String>,
}

async fn capture_one_fencer(params: FencerCaptureParams<'_>) -> Result<FencerCaptureResult> {
  let FencerCaptureParams {
    fencer_id,
    run_id,
    ttl,
    capture_live,
    cooldown_active,
    deadline,
    last_live_fetch,
    counts,
    state,
    british_licence,
  } = params;
  let response = match get_fencer_standings(fencer_id.clone(), british_licence.as_deref()).await {
    Ok(response) => response,
    Err(error) => {
      upsert_failed_receipt(fencer_id, run_id, ttl, &error.to_string()).await?;
      return Ok(FencerCaptureResult::Failed);
    }
  };
  if british_licence.is_some()
    && response
      .standings
      .iter()
      .any(|standing| standing.scope == RankingScope::British)
  {
    counts.british_captured += 1;
  }

  let captured_at = Utc::now();
  let mut written: Vec<StandingSnapshotFields> = Vec::with_capacity(response.standings.len());
  let mut standing_keys: Vec<String> = Vec::with_capacity(response.standings.len());
  let mut budget_exhausted = Instant::now() >= deadline;

  for standing in &response.standings {
    let composition = if budget_exhausted || Instant::now() >= deadline {
      budget_exhausted = true;
      CompositionCapture::NotCaptured {
        reason: NotCapturedReason::RunTimeBudgetExhausted,
      }
    } else {
      resolve_standing_composition(
        fencer_id,
        standing,
        capture_live,
        cooldown_active,
        last_live_fetch,
        british_licence.as_deref(),
      )
      .await
    };
    counts.record_composition(&composition);

    let fields = StandingSnapshotFields {
      schema_version: standings_history::model::SCHEMA_VERSION,
      fencer_id: fencer_id.to_string(),
      standing_key: standing.key.to_string(),
      run_id: run_id.to_string(),
      captured_at,
      scope: scope_wire(standing.scope),
      region_id: standing.region_id,
      classifier_code: standing.classifier.code.clone(),
      rank: standing.rank.clone(),
      points: standing.points,
      entrants: standing.entrants,
      source: source_observation(standing).await,
      composition,
      ttl,
    };
    repository::upsert_snapshot(&DB.standings_history_snapshots, fields.clone()).await?;
    note_snapshot_bounds(state, captured_at);
    standing_keys.push(standing.key.to_string());
    written.push(fields);
  }

  write_fencer_movement(
    fencer_id,
    run_id,
    captured_at,
    ttl,
    &written,
    &standing_keys,
  )
  .await?;

  repository::upsert_receipt(
    &DB.standings_history_receipts,
    SnapshotRunReceiptFields {
      fencer_id: fencer_id.to_string(),
      run_id: run_id.to_string(),
      captured_at,
      outcome: ReceiptOutcome::Succeeded { standing_keys },
      ttl,
    },
  )
  .await?;

  Ok(FencerCaptureResult::Succeeded)
}

async fn resolve_standing_composition(
  fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>,
  standing: &FencerStandingItem,
  capture_live: bool,
  cooldown_active: bool,
  last_live_fetch: &mut Instant,
  british_licence: Option<&str>,
) -> CompositionCapture {
  let route = composition_route(standing.scope, standing.classifier.category);
  if let Some(reason) = skip_live_composition(route, capture_live, cooldown_active) {
    return CompositionCapture::NotCaptured { reason };
  }
  if super::composition::is_live_composition(route) {
    pace_live_fetch(last_live_fetch).await;
  }
  composition_capture_from_body(
    resolve_composition_body(fencer_id, standing, british_licence).await,
  )
}

async fn pace_live_fetch(last_live_fetch: &mut Instant) {
  let spacing = Duration::from_millis(CONF.standings_history.upstream_delay_ms);
  let elapsed = last_live_fetch.elapsed();
  if elapsed < spacing {
    tokio::time::sleep(spacing - elapsed).await;
  }
  *last_live_fetch = Instant::now();
}

async fn source_observation(standing: &FencerStandingItem) -> SourceObservation {
  match standing.scope {
    RankingScope::Unified => {
      let freshness = standing.unified.as_ref().map(|meta| &meta.freshness);
      SourceObservation {
        source_updated_at: freshness
          .and_then(|f| f.source_updated_at)
          .and_then(unix_opt),
        list_refreshed_at: freshness.and_then(|f| f.fetched_at).and_then(unix_opt),
        stale: freshness.and_then(|f| f.is_stale).unwrap_or(false),
      }
    }
    RankingScope::National | RankingScope::Regional => national_regional_source(standing).await,
    RankingScope::British => SourceObservation {
      source_updated_at: standing
        .british
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|f| f.source_updated_at)
        .and_then(unix_opt),
      list_refreshed_at: standing
        .british
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|f| f.fetched_at)
        .and_then(unix_opt),
      stale: standing
        .british
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|f| f.is_stale)
        .unwrap_or(false),
    },
  }
}

async fn national_regional_source(standing: &FencerStandingItem) -> SourceObservation {
  let Some(classifier) = RecognizedClassifier::from_code(&standing.classifier.code) else {
    return SourceObservation {
      source_updated_at: None,
      list_refreshed_at: None,
      stale: false,
    };
  };
  let regional_shared = standing.scope == RankingScope::Regional
    && standings_index::is_regional_shared_category(standing.classifier.category);
  let usa_region = if regional_shared {
    None
  } else {
    standing.region_id
  };
  let list_refreshed_at =
    match standings_index::job_last_refreshed_at(usa_region, regional_shared, classifier).await {
      Ok(at) => at,
      Err(error) => {
        warn!(
          standing_key = %standing.key,
          error = ?error,
          "Failed to look up standings job last-refreshed time"
        );
        None
      }
    };
  let stale = list_refreshed_at.is_some_and(|at| {
    Utc::now() - at > chrono::Duration::hours(i64::from(CONF.standings_history.stale_after_hours))
  });
  SourceObservation {
    source_updated_at: None,
    list_refreshed_at,
    stale,
  }
}

async fn write_fencer_movement(
  fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>,
  run_id: &str,
  captured_at: DateTime<Utc>,
  ttl: i64,
  written: &[StandingSnapshotFields],
  standing_keys: &[String],
) -> Result<()> {
  let since =
    captured_at - chrono::Duration::days(i64::from(CONF.standings_history.movement_window_days));
  let mut snapshots = repository::list_snapshots_in_window(
    &DB.standings_history_snapshots,
    &fencer_id.to_string(),
    since,
  )
  .await?;
  for fields in written {
    let projection = projection_from_fields(fields);
    snapshots.retain(|existing| {
      existing.standing_key != projection.standing_key || existing.run_id != projection.run_id
    });
    snapshots.push(projection);
  }

  let mut receipts: Vec<SnapshotRunReceiptFields> = repository::list_receipts_in_window(
    &DB.standings_history_receipts,
    &fencer_id.to_string(),
    since,
  )
  .await?
  .into_iter()
  .map(|doc| doc.fields)
  .collect();
  receipts.retain(|receipt| receipt.run_id != run_id);
  receipts.push(SnapshotRunReceiptFields {
    fencer_id: fencer_id.to_string(),
    run_id: run_id.to_string(),
    captured_at,
    outcome: ReceiptOutcome::Succeeded {
      standing_keys: standing_keys.to_vec(),
    },
    ttl,
  });

  let summaries = compute_movement(&snapshots, &receipts, captured_at);
  write_movement(&fencer_id.to_string(), &summaries).await
}

fn projection_from_fields(fields: &StandingSnapshotFields) -> StandingSnapshotProjection {
  let (composition_state, composition_reason) = match &fields.composition {
    CompositionCapture::Complete { .. } => (Some("complete".to_string()), None),
    CompositionCapture::Unavailable { reason } => {
      (Some("unavailable".to_string()), Some(reason.clone()))
    }
    CompositionCapture::NotCaptured { reason } => (
      Some("notCaptured".to_string()),
      Some(
        serde_json::to_value(reason)
          .ok()
          .and_then(|v| v.as_str().map(str::to_string))
          .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("{reason:?}")),
      ),
    ),
  };
  StandingSnapshotProjection {
    id: generate_snapshot_id(&fields.fencer_id, &fields.standing_key, &fields.run_id),
    fencer_id: fields.fencer_id.clone(),
    standing_key: fields.standing_key.clone(),
    run_id: fields.run_id.clone(),
    captured_at: fields.captured_at,
    scope: fields.scope.clone(),
    region_id: fields.region_id,
    classifier_code: fields.classifier_code.clone(),
    rank: fields.rank.clone(),
    points: fields.points,
    entrants: fields.entrants,
    source: fields.source.clone(),
    composition_state,
    composition_reason,
  }
}

async fn upsert_failed_receipt(
  fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>,
  run_id: &str,
  ttl: i64,
  error: &str,
) -> Result<()> {
  repository::upsert_receipt(
    &DB.standings_history_receipts,
    SnapshotRunReceiptFields {
      fencer_id: fencer_id.to_string(),
      run_id: run_id.to_string(),
      captured_at: Utc::now(),
      outcome: ReceiptOutcome::Failed {
        error: error.to_string(),
      },
      ttl,
    },
  )
  .await?;
  Ok(())
}

fn document_ttl_seconds() -> i64 {
  ttl_seconds(CONF.standings_history.retention_days)
}

fn ttl_seconds(retention_days: u32) -> i64 {
  i64::from(retention_days) * 86_400
}

fn scope_wire(scope: RankingScope) -> String {
  match serde_json::to_value(scope) {
    Ok(serde_json::Value::String(s)) => s,
    _ => format!("{scope:?}").to_lowercase(),
  }
}

fn unix_opt(secs: i64) -> Option<DateTime<Utc>> {
  DateTime::from_timestamp(secs, 0)
}

/// Groups `(usaf id, licence)` pairs by fencer, so [`resolve_british_licence`]
/// can be applied per fencer without re-scanning the whole population.
fn group_licence_assertions(pairs: Vec<(u32, String)>) -> HashMap<u32, Vec<String>> {
  let mut grouped: HashMap<u32, Vec<String>> = HashMap::new();
  for (usaf_id, licence) in pairs {
    grouped.entry(usaf_id).or_default().push(licence);
  }
  grouped
}

#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum BritishLicenceResolution {
  /// Nobody tracking this fencer has asserted a British Fencing licence.
  None,
  /// Every household asserting a licence for this fencer agrees on it.
  Licence(String),
  /// Two or more households assert *different* licences for this fencer.
  /// We refuse rather than guess: picking one licence would silently
  /// promote one household's assertion into a fact every other viewer
  /// sees -- see
  /// docs/design-docs/british-fencing-rankings-as-a-standings-source.md,
  /// Alternative C (rejected).
  Ambiguous { distinct_count: usize },
}

/// Pure refusal rule for British capture identity ambiguity. A licence is
/// one household's private assertion, not a global fact (see
/// [`crate::v2::user::get_all_connected_fencer_licences`]), so storage --
/// which has no owner dimension -- cannot safely hold two different
/// assertions for the same fencer. Dedupes first so two households
/// asserting the *same* licence collapse to one rather than reading as
/// disagreement. Split out from the capture loop so this is unit-testable
/// without a live Redis/Cosmos connection -- see `fencer.rs`'s
/// `select_british_row` for the same shape.
fn resolve_british_licence(licences: &[String]) -> BritishLicenceResolution {
  let mut distinct: Vec<&str> = licences.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();
  distinct.sort_unstable();
  distinct.dedup();
  match distinct.as_slice() {
    [] => BritishLicenceResolution::None,
    [only] => BritishLicenceResolution::Licence((*only).to_string()),
    many => BritishLicenceResolution::Ambiguous {
      distinct_count: many.len(),
    },
  }
}

/// Resolves one fencer's British licence for this run, recording the
/// ambiguous case in `counts` and logging it at `warn` -- fencer id and
/// distinct-licence count only, never the licence values themselves (the
/// membership id is deliberately never serialized -- see the design doc's
/// "Where the membership id lives"). USA scopes are unaffected by the
/// result either way: `get_fencer_standings`/`resolve_composition_body`
/// already omit British items on `None` regardless of why.
fn resolve_fencer_british_licence(
  usaf_id: u32,
  licence_assertions: &HashMap<u32, Vec<String>>,
  counts: &mut CaptureCounts,
) -> Option<String> {
  let licences = licence_assertions
    .get(&usaf_id)
    .map(Vec::as_slice)
    .unwrap_or(&[]);
  match resolve_british_licence(licences) {
    BritishLicenceResolution::None => None,
    BritishLicenceResolution::Licence(licence) => Some(licence),
    BritishLicenceResolution::Ambiguous { distinct_count } => {
      warn!(
        usaf_id,
        distinct_licence_count = distinct_count,
        "Multiple households assert different British Fencing licences for this fencer; \
         refusing to capture a British standings snapshot for it this run"
      );
      counts.british_licence_ambiguous += 1;
      None
    }
  }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
  use super::*;
  use standings_history::NotCapturedReason;

  #[test]
  fn document_ttl_is_retention_days_in_seconds() {
    assert_eq!(ttl_seconds(730), 63_072_000);
    assert_eq!(ttl_seconds(0), 0);
  }

  #[test]
  fn scope_wire_is_camel_case() {
    assert_eq!(scope_wire(RankingScope::National), "national");
    assert_eq!(scope_wire(RankingScope::Regional), "regional");
    assert_eq!(scope_wire(RankingScope::Unified), "unified");
    assert_eq!(scope_wire(RankingScope::British), "british");
  }

  #[test]
  fn capture_counts_complete_only_when_nothing_failed_or_was_skipped() {
    let mut counts = CaptureCounts::default();
    assert!(counts.is_complete());
    counts.fencers_unattempted = 1;
    assert!(!counts.is_complete());
    counts.fencers_unattempted = 0;
    counts.fencers_failed = 1;
    assert!(!counts.is_complete());
  }

  #[test]
  fn capture_counts_tally_composition_states() {
    let mut counts = CaptureCounts::default();
    counts.record_composition(&CompositionCapture::Unavailable {
      reason: "didNotReconcile".to_string(),
    });
    counts.record_composition(&CompositionCapture::NotCaptured {
      reason: NotCapturedReason::RunTimeBudgetExhausted,

    assert_eq!(counts.compositions_not_captured, 1);
```

```
//! Per-run capture: walk tracked fencers, snapshot each standing, write
//! movement, then the receipt.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use flunge_config::CONF;
use ids::{FencerId, TypedId};
use model_common::RecognizedClassifier;
use standings_history::{
  CompositionCapture, NotCapturedReason, ReceiptOutcome, SnapshotRunReceiptFields,
  SourceObservation, StandingSnapshotFields, StandingSnapshotProjection, compute_movement,
  generate_snapshot_id, repository,
};
use standings_index::RankingScope;
use tracing::{info, warn};

use crate::db::DB;
use crate::v2::user::get_all_connected_fencer_ids_and_licences;
use crate::view::standings::british_rankings_enabled;
use crate::view::standings::fencer::{
  FencerStandingItem, composition_route, get_fencer_standings, resolve_composition_body,
};

use super::composition::{composition_capture_from_body, skip_live_composition};
use super::state::{
  CaptureCounts, HistoryRunState, note_snapshot_bounds, read_run_state, slot_run_id,
  write_movement, write_run_state,
};

pub struct CaptureOutcome {
  pub run_id: String,
  pub counts: CaptureCounts,
}

pub async fn capture_run(explicit_run_id: Option<String>) -> Result<CaptureOutcome> {
  let now = Utc::now();
  let run_id = match explicit_run_id {
    Some(id) => id,
    None => slot_run_id(now)?,
  };
  let started = Instant::now();
  let deadline = started + Duration::from_secs(CONF.standings_history.max_run_seconds);
  let ttl = document_ttl_seconds();
  let capture_live = CONF.standings_history.capture_live_compositions;
  let cooldown_active = standings_index::refresh_cooldown_is_active(now)
    .await
    .unwrap_or_else(|error| {
      warn!(
        error = ?error,
        "Failed to read standings refresh cooldown; treating it as inactive"
      );
      false
    });

  let mut state = read_run_state().await.unwrap_or_default();
  state.last_attempt_at = Some(now);
  state.last_attempt_run_id = Some(run_id.clone());
  write_run_state(&state).await?;

  let (connected_fencer_ids, licence_pairs) = get_all_connected_fencer_ids_and_licences()
    .await
    .context("enumerating connected fencers and British Fencing licences")?;
  let mut fencer_ids: Vec<u32> = connected_fencer_ids.into_iter().collect();
  fencer_ids.sort_unstable();

  let licence_by_usaf: HashMap<u32, String> = licence_pairs.into_iter().collect();

  let british_rankings_enabled = british_rankings_enabled().await.unwrap_or_else(|error| {
    warn!(
      error = ?error,
      "Failed to read British rankings runtime flag; treating standings history capture as British-disabled this run"
    );
    false
  });
  if !british_rankings_enabled {
    warn!(
      run_id = %run_id,
      "British rankings runtime flag (standings.british_rankings_enabled) is disabled; \
       this capture run will write no British (gb-) snapshots -- every tracked fencer with a \
       British licence will read as unranked rather than uncaptured until it is re-enabled"
    );
  }

  info!(
    run_id = %run_id,
    fencer_count = fencer_ids.len(),
    capture_live,
    cooldown_active,
    british_rankings_enabled,
    "Starting standings history capture"
  );

  let mut counts = CaptureCounts {
    british_rankings_flag_disabled: !british_rankings_enabled,
    ..CaptureCounts::default()
  };
  let mut last_live_fetch = Instant::now()
    .checked_sub(Duration::from_secs(3600))
    .unwrap_or_else(Instant::now);
  let mut attempted = 0usize;

  for usaf_id in &fencer_ids {
    if Instant::now() >= deadline {
      break;
    }
    attempted += 1;
    let fencer_id = TypedId::<FencerId>::usaf(&usaf_id.to_string());
    let british_licence = if british_rankings_enabled {
      licence_by_usaf.get(usaf_id).cloned()
    } else {
      None
    };
    match capture_one_fencer(FencerCaptureParams {
      fencer_id: &fencer_id,
      run_id: &run_id,
      ttl,
      capture_live,
      cooldown_active,
      deadline,
      last_live_fetch: &mut last_live_fetch,
      counts: &mut counts,
      state: &mut state,
      british_licence,
    })
    .await
    {
      Ok(FencerCaptureResult::Succeeded) => {
        counts.fencers_attempted += 1;
        counts.fencers_succeeded += 1;
      }
      Ok(FencerCaptureResult::Failed) => {
        counts.fencers_attempted += 1;
        counts.fencers_failed += 1;
      }
      Err(error) => {
        counts.fencers_attempted += 1;
        counts.fencers_failed += 1;
        warn!(
          fencer_id = %fencer_id,
          run_id = %run_id,
          error = ?error,
          "Standings history capture failed for fencer"
        );
        if let Err(receipt_error) =
          upsert_failed_receipt(&fencer_id, &run_id, ttl, &error.to_string()).await
        {
          warn!(
            fencer_id = %fencer_id,
            error = ?receipt_error,
            "Failed to write standings history failure receipt"
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  counts.fencers_unattempted = (fencer_ids.len() - attempted) as u32;
  state.last_run_counts = Some(counts.clone());
  if counts.is_complete() {
    state.last_success_at = Some(Utc::now());
    state.last_failure_at = None;
    state.last_failure_reason = None;
  } else {
    state.last_failure_at = Some(Utc::now());
    state.last_failure_reason = Some(counts.summary());
  }
  write_run_state(&state).await?;

  Ok(CaptureOutcome { run_id, counts })
}

enum FencerCaptureResult {
  Succeeded,
  Failed,
}

struct FencerCaptureParams<'a> {
  fencer_id: &'a TypedId<FencerId>,
  run_id: &'a str,
  ttl: i64,
  capture_live: bool,
  cooldown_active: bool,
  deadline: Instant,
  last_live_fetch: &'a mut Instant,
  counts: &'a mut CaptureCounts,
  state: &'a mut HistoryRunState,
  /// This fencer's shared British Fencing licence, or `None` when none is
  /// set. `get_fencer_standings` / `resolve_composition_body` already omit
  /// British items on `None`, so no separate USA-only path is needed here.
  british_licence: Option<String>,
}

async fn capture_one_fencer(params: FencerCaptureParams<'_>) -> Result<FencerCaptureResult> {
  let FencerCaptureParams {
    fencer_id,
    run_id,
    ttl,
    capture_live,
    cooldown_active,
    deadline,
    last_live_fetch,
    counts,
    state,
    british_licence,
  } = params;
  let response = match get_fencer_standings(fencer_id.clone(), british_licence.as_deref()).await {
    Ok(response) => response,
    Err(error) => {
      upsert_failed_receipt(fencer_id, run_id, ttl, &error.to_string()).await?;
      return Ok(FencerCaptureResult::Failed);
    }
  };
  if british_licence.is_some()
    && response
      .standings
      .iter()
      .any(|standing| standing.scope == RankingScope::British)
  {
    counts.british_captured += 1;
  }

  let captured_at = Utc::now();
  let mut written: Vec<StandingSnapshotFields> = Vec::with_capacity(response.standings.len());
  let mut standing_keys: Vec<String> = Vec::with_capacity(response.standings.len());
  let mut budget_exhausted = Instant::now() >= deadline;

  for standing in &response.standings {
    let composition = if budget_exhausted || Instant::now() >= deadline {
      budget_exhausted = true;
      CompositionCapture::NotCaptured {
        reason: NotCapturedReason::RunTimeBudgetExhausted,
      }
    } else {
      resolve_standing_composition(
        fencer_id,
        standing,
        capture_live,
        cooldown_active,
        last_live_fetch,
        british_licence.as_deref(),
      )
      .await
    };
    counts.record_composition(&composition);

    let fields = StandingSnapshotFields {
      schema_version: standings_history::model::SCHEMA_VERSION,
      fencer_id: fencer_id.to_string(),
      standing_key: standing.key.to_string(),
      run_id: run_id.to_string(),
      captured_at,
      scope: scope_wire(standing.scope),
      region_id: standing.region_id,
      classifier_code: standing.classifier.code.clone(),
      rank: standing.rank.clone(),
      points: standing.points,
      entrants: standing.entrants,
      source: source_observation(standing).await,
      composition,
      ttl,
    };
    repository::upsert_snapshot(&DB.standings_history_snapshots, fields.clone()).await?;
    note_snapshot_bounds(state, captured_at);
    standing_keys.push(standing.key.to_string());
    written.push(fields);
  }

  write_fencer_movement(
    fencer_id,
    run_id,
    captured_at,
    ttl,
    &written,
    &standing_keys,
  )
  .await?;

  repository::upsert_receipt(
    &DB.standings_history_receipts,
    SnapshotRunReceiptFields {
      fencer_id: fencer_id.to_string(),
      run_id: run_id.to_string(),
      captured_at,
      outcome: ReceiptOutcome::Succeeded { standing_keys },
      ttl,
    },
  )
  .await?;

  Ok(FencerCaptureResult::Succeeded)
}

async fn resolve_standing_composition(
  fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>,
  standing: &FencerStandingItem,
  capture_live: bool,
  cooldown_active: bool,
  last_live_fetch: &mut Instant,
  british_licence: Option<&str>,
) -> CompositionCapture {
  let route = composition_route(standing.scope, standing.classifier.category);
  if let Some(reason) = skip_live_composition(route, capture_live, cooldown_active) {
    return CompositionCapture::NotCaptured { reason };
  }
  if super::composition::is_live_composition(route) {
    pace_live_fetch(last_live_fetch).await;
  }
  composition_capture_from_body(
    resolve_composition_body(fencer_id, standing, british_licence).await,
  )
}

async fn pace_live_fetch(last_live_fetch: &mut Instant) {
  let spacing = Duration::from_millis(CONF.standings_history.upstream_delay_ms);
  let elapsed = last_live_fetch.elapsed();
  if elapsed < spacing {
    tokio::time::sleep(spacing - elapsed).await;
  }
  *last_live_fetch = Instant::now();
}

async fn source_observation(standing: &FencerStandingItem) -> SourceObservation {
  match standing.scope {
    RankingScope::Unified => {
      let freshness = standing.unified.as_ref().map(|meta| &meta.freshness);
      SourceObservation {
        source_updated_at: freshness
          .and_then(|f| f.source_updated_at)
          .and_then(unix_opt),
        list_refreshed_at: freshness.and_then(|f| f.fetched_at).and_then(unix_opt),
        stale: freshness.and_then(|f| f.is_stale).unwrap_or(false),
      }
    }
    RankingScope::National | RankingScope::Regional => national_regional_source(standing).await,
    RankingScope::British => SourceObservation {
      source_updated_at: standing
        .british
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|f| f.source_updated_at)
        .and_then(unix_opt),
      list_refreshed_at: standing
        .british
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|f| f.fetched_at)
        .and_then(unix_opt),
      stale: standing
        .british
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|f| f.is_stale)
        .unwrap_or(false),
    },
  }
}

async fn national_regional_source(standing: &FencerStandingItem) -> SourceObservation {
  let Some(classifier) = RecognizedClassifier::from_code(&standing.classifier.code) else {
    return SourceObservation {
      source_updated_at: None,
      list_refreshed_at: None,
      stale: false,
    };
  };
  let regional_shared = standing.scope == RankingScope::Regional
    && standings_index::is_regional_shared_category(standing.classifier.category);
  let usa_region = if regional_shared {
    None
  } else {
    standing.region_id
  };
  let list_refreshed_at =
    match standings_index::job_last_refreshed_at(usa_region, regional_shared, classifier).await {
      Ok(at) => at,
      Err(error) => {
        warn!(
          standing_key = %standing.key,
          error = ?error,
          "Failed to look up standings job last-refreshed time"
        );
        None
      }
    };
  let stale = list_refreshed_at.is_some_and(|at| {
    Utc::now() - at > chrono::Duration::hours(i64::from(CONF.standings_history.stale_after_hours))
  });
  SourceObservation {
    source_updated_at: None,
    list_refreshed_at,
    stale,
  }
}

async fn write_fencer_movement(
  fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>,
  run_id: &str,
  captured_at: DateTime<Utc>,
  ttl: i64,
  written: &[StandingSnapshotFields],
  standing_keys: &[String],
) -> Result<()> {
  let since =
    captured_at - chrono::Duration::days(i64::from(CONF.standings_history.movement_window_days));
  let mut snapshots = repository::list_snapshots_in_window(
    &DB.standings_history_snapshots,
    &fencer_id.to_string(),
    since,
  )
  .await?;
  for fields in written {
    let projection = projection_from_fields(fields);
    snapshots.retain(|existing| {
      existing.standing_key != projection.standing_key || existing.run_id != projection.run_id
    });
    snapshots.push(projection);
  }

  let mut receipts: Vec<SnapshotRunReceiptFields> = repository::list_receipts_in_window(
    &DB.standings_history_receipts,
    &fencer_id.to_string(),
    since,
  )
  .await?
  .into_iter()
  .map(|doc| doc.fields)
  .collect();
  receipts.retain(|receipt| receipt.run_id != run_id);
  receipts.push(SnapshotRunReceiptFields {
    fencer_id: fencer_id.to_string(),
    run_id: run_id.to_string(),
    captured_at,
    outcome: ReceiptOutcome::Succeeded {
      standing_keys: standing_keys.to_vec(),
    },
    ttl,
  });

  let summaries = compute_movement(&snapshots, &receipts, captured_at);
  write_movement(&fencer_id.to_string(), &summaries).await
}

fn projection_from_fields(fields: &StandingSnapshotFields) -> StandingSnapshotProjection {
  let (composition_state, composition_reason) = match &fields.composition {
    CompositionCapture::Complete { .. } => (Some("complete".to_string()), None),
    CompositionCapture::Unavailable { reason } => {
      (Some("unavailable".to_string()), Some(reason.clone()))
    }
    CompositionCapture::NotCaptured { reason } => (
      Some("notCaptured".to_string()),
      Some(
        serde_json::to_value(reason)
          .ok()
          .and_then(|v| v.as_str().map(str::to_string))
          .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("{reason:?}")),
      ),
    ),
  };
  StandingSnapshotProjection {
    id: generate_snapshot_id(&fields.fencer_id, &fields.standing_key, &fields.run_id),
    fencer_id: fields.fencer_id.clone(),
    standing_key: fields.standing_key.clone(),
    run_id: fields.run_id.clone(),
    captured_at: fields.captured_at,
    scope: fields.scope.clone(),
    region_id: fields.region_id,
    classifier_code: fields.classifier_code.clone(),
    rank: fields.rank.clone(),
    points: fields.points,
    entrants: fields.entrants,
    source: fields.source.clone(),
    composition_state,
    composition_reason,
  }
}

async fn upsert_failed_receipt(
  fencer_id: &TypedId<FencerId>,
  run_id: &str,
  ttl: i64,
  error: &str,
) -> Result<()> {
  repository::upsert_receipt(
    &DB.standings_history_receipts,
    SnapshotRunReceiptFields {
      fencer_id: fencer_id.to_string(),
      run_id: run_id.to_string(),
      captured_at: Utc::now(),
      outcome: ReceiptOutcome::Failed {
        error: error.to_string(),
      },
      ttl,
    },
  )
  .await?;
  Ok(())
}

fn document_ttl_seconds() -> i64 {
  ttl_seconds(CONF.standings_history.retention_days)
}

fn ttl_seconds(retention_days: u32) -> i64 {
  i64::from(retention_days) * 86_400
}

fn scope_wire(scope: RankingScope) -> String {
  match serde_json::to_value(scope) {
    Ok(serde_json::Value::String(s)) => s,
    _ => format!("{scope:?}").to_lowercase(),
  }
}

fn unix_opt(secs: i64) -> Option<DateTime<Utc>> {
  DateTime::from_timestamp(secs, 0)
}

    assert_eq!(counts.compositions_unavailable, 1);

  }
```

```
//! Redis run-state, the cluster-wide snapshot lock, and the movement hash
//! the capture task writes after each fencer.

use std::collections::HashMap;

use anyhow::{Result, anyhow};
use cache::{Cache, RedisCache};
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use cron_schedule::previous_execution_time;
use redis::AsyncCommands;
use redis::aio::MultiplexedConnection;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use standings_history::MovementSummary;
use tracing::warn;
use uuid::Uuid;

use super::SCHEDULE;

pub const LOCK_KEY: &str = "standings:history:v1:snapshot-lock";
pub const RUN_STATE_KEY: &str = "standings:history:v1:run-state";
pub const MOVEMENT_HASH_KEY: &str = "standings:history:v1:movement";

/// Persisted at [`RUN_STATE_KEY`] so a process restart does not lose the
/// last capture outcome. Task history is in-memory only.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct HistoryRunState {
  pub last_attempt_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
  pub last_attempt_run_id: Option<String>,
  pub last_success_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
  pub last_failure_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
  pub last_failure_reason: Option<String>,
  pub last_run_counts: Option<CaptureCounts>,
  /// Oldest snapshot `capturedAt` observed by a capture run. Kept in Redis
  /// rather than queried from Cosmos: the query builder has no `ORDER BY` /
  /// `MIN`, and a container scan is not an admin-status cost we want.
  pub oldest_snapshot_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
  pub newest_snapshot_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct CaptureCounts {
  pub fencers_attempted: u32,
  pub fencers_succeeded: u32,
  pub fencers_failed: u32,
  pub fencers_unattempted: u32,
  pub compositions_complete: u32,
  pub compositions_unavailable: u32,
  pub compositions_not_captured: u32,
  /// Fencers whose British Fencing licence resolved to a single,
  /// unambiguous value this run and so had British items requested for
  /// them (a request that can still yield zero British standing items, the
  /// same "not on that table" degrade every other read of `british_standing_items`
  /// makes).
  pub british_captured: u32,
  /// Fencers refused this run because two or more households asserted
  /// *different* British Fencing licences for them -- see
  /// `capture::resolve_british_licence`. Never accompanied by which
  /// licences disagreed.
  pub british_licence_ambiguous: u32,
  /// True when `standings.british_rankings_enabled` was off at the start of
  /// this run, so every British snapshot was skipped regardless of licence
  /// resolution. Recorded so this state is distinguishable from "nobody
  /// tracked a British licence" without grepping logs.
  pub british_rankings_flag_disabled: bool,
}

impl CaptureCounts {
  pub fn summary(&self) -> String {
    format!(
      "fencers attempted={} succeeded={} failed={} unattempted={}; compositions complete={} unavailable={} notCaptured={}; british captured={} licenceAmbiguous={} flagDisabled={}",
      self.fencers_attempted,
      self.fencers_succeeded,
      self.fencers_failed,
      self.fencers_unattempted,
      self.compositions_complete,
      self.compositions_unavailable,
      self.compositions_not_captured,
      self.british_captured,
      self.british_licence_ambiguous,
      self.british_rankings_flag_disabled
    )
  }

  pub fn is_complete(&self) -> bool {
    self.fencers_failed == 0 && self.fencers_unattempted == 0
  }

  pub fn record_composition(&mut self, capture: &standings_history::CompositionCapture) {
    match capture {
      standings_history::CompositionCapture::Complete { .. } => self.compositions_complete += 1,
      standings_history::CompositionCapture::Unavailable { .. } => {
        self.compositions_unavailable += 1
      }
      standings_history::CompositionCapture::NotCaptured { .. } => {
        self.compositions_not_captured += 1
      }
    }
  }
}

pub async fn redis_connection() -> Result<MultiplexedConnection> {
  RedisCache::get()
    .await
    .get_connection()
    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("Redis connection not available for standings history capture"))
}

pub async fn try_acquire_snapshot_lock(token: &str, ttl_seconds: u64) -> Result<bool> {
  let mut conn = redis_connection().await?;
  Ok(cache::try_acquire_token_lock(&mut conn, LOCK_KEY, token, ttl_seconds).await?)
}

pub async fn release_snapshot_lock(token: &str) -> Result<()> {
  let mut conn = redis_connection().await?;
  let released = cache::release_token_lock(&mut conn, LOCK_KEY, token).await?;
  if !released {
    warn!(
      "Standings history snapshot lock was no longer owned when releasing it — \
       the run likely outlived the lock TTL; another replica may now hold it"
    );
  }
  Ok(())
}

pub fn new_lock_token() -> String {
  Uuid::new_v4().to_string()
}

pub async fn read_run_state() -> Result<HistoryRunState> {
  let mut conn = redis_connection().await?;
  let payload: Option<Vec<u8>> = conn.get(RUN_STATE_KEY).await?;
  match payload {
    Some(bytes) => Ok(serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)?),
    None => Ok(HistoryRunState::default()),
  }
}

pub async fn write_run_state(state: &HistoryRunState) -> Result<()> {
  let mut conn = redis_connection().await?;
  let payload = serde_json::to_vec(state)?;
  conn.set::<_, _, ()>(RUN_STATE_KEY, payload).await?;
  Ok(())
}

pub async fn write_movement(
  fencer_id: &str,
  summaries: &HashMap<String, MovementSummary>,
) -> Result<()> {
  let mut conn = redis_connection().await?;
  let payload = serde_json::to_string(summaries)?;
  conn
    .hset::<_, _, _, ()>(MOVEMENT_HASH_KEY, fencer_id, payload)
    .await?;
  Ok(())
}

/// Reads the card movement summaries for exactly one fencer. The read path is
/// intentionally one Redis hash lookup; a cache miss means no history yet.
pub async fn read_movement(fencer_id: &str) -> Result<HashMap<String, MovementSummary>> {
  let mut conn = redis_connection().await?;
  let payload: Option<String> = conn.hget(MOVEMENT_HASH_KEY, fencer_id).await?;
  match payload {
    Some(payload) => Ok(serde_json::from_str(&payload)?),
    None => Ok(HashMap::new()),
  }
}

pub fn slot_run_id(now: DateTime<Utc>) -> Result<String> {
  let slot = previous_execution_time(SCHEDULE, now).ok_or_else(|| {
    anyhow!("standings history schedule {SCHEDULE:?} has no previous execution time")
  })?;
  Ok(slot_run_id_from(slot))
}

pub fn slot_run_id_from(slot: DateTime<Utc>) -> String {
  slot.date_naive().to_string()
}

/// `runId` must be `YYYY-MM-DD`, a Mon/Thu 07:30 UTC slot, and not later
/// than the most recent scheduled slot at `now`.
pub fn validate_run_id_at(run_id: &str, now: DateTime<Utc>) -> Result<(), String> {
  let date = chrono::NaiveDate::parse_from_str(run_id, "%Y-%m-%d")
    .map_err(|_| "runId must be YYYY-MM-DD".to_string())?;
  let slot_time = date
    .and_hms_opt(7, 30, 0)
    .map(|t| t.and_utc())
    .ok_or_else(|| "runId is not a valid date".to_string())?;
  let Some(prev) = previous_execution_time(SCHEDULE, slot_time + chrono::Duration::seconds(1))
  else {
    return Err("standings history schedule could not be parsed".to_string());
  };
  if prev != slot_time {
    return Err(format!(
      "runId {run_id} is not a scheduled Monday/Thursday 07:30 UTC slot"
    ));
  }
  let latest = previous_execution_time(SCHEDULE, now)
    .ok_or_else(|| "standings history schedule could not be parsed".to_string())?;
  if slot_time > latest {
    return Err(format!(
      "runId {run_id} is later than the most recent slot {}",
      slot_run_id_from(latest)
    ));
  }
  Ok(())
}

pub fn validate_run_id(run_id: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
  validate_run_id_at(run_id, Utc::now())
}

/// True when no capture attempt has been recorded at or after the most
/// recent scheduled slot. A recorded failure for that slot is not a miss:
/// retrying it on every replica start would re-spend the run budget.
pub fn missed_scheduled_slot(state: &HistoryRunState, now: DateTime<Utc>) -> bool {
  let Some(slot) = previous_execution_time(SCHEDULE, now) else {
    return false;
  };
  let slot_id = slot_run_id_from(slot);
  if state.last_attempt_run_id.as_deref() == Some(slot_id.as_str()) {
    return false;
  }
  let last_outcome = [
    state.last_success_at,
    state.last_failure_at,
    state.last_attempt_at,
  ]
  .into_iter()
  .flatten()
  .max();
  match last_outcome {
    None => true,
    Some(at) => at < slot,
  }
}

pub fn note_snapshot_bounds(state: &mut HistoryRunState, captured_at: DateTime<Utc>) {
  match state.oldest_snapshot_at {
    Some(oldest) if captured_at >= oldest => {}
    _ => state.oldest_snapshot_at = Some(captured_at),
  }
  match state.newest_snapshot_at {
    Some(newest) if captured_at <= newest => {}
    _ => state.newest_snapshot_at = Some(captured_at),
  }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
  use super::*;
  use chrono::TimeZone;

  fn utc(year: i32, month: u32, day: u32, hour: u32, min: u32, sec: u32) -> DateTime<Utc> {
    Utc
      .with_ymd_and_hms(year, month, day, hour, min, sec)
      .unwrap()
  }

  #[test]
  fn schedule_fires_monday_and_thursday_at_0730_utc() {
    // 2026-09-03 is a Thursday; 2026-09-07 is a Monday.
    assert_eq!(
      previous_execution_time(SCHEDULE, utc(2026, 9, 3, 7, 30, 1)),
      Some(utc(2026, 9, 3, 7, 30, 0))
    );
    assert_eq!(
      previous_execution_time(SCHEDULE, utc(2026, 9, 4, 12, 0, 0)),
      Some(utc(2026, 9, 3, 7, 30, 0))
    );
    assert_eq!(
      previous_execution_time(SCHEDULE, utc(2026, 9, 7, 7, 31, 0)),
      Some(utc(2026, 9, 7, 7, 30, 0))
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn slot_run_id_is_the_utc_date_of_the_most_recent_slot() {
    assert_eq!(
      slot_run_id(utc(2026, 9, 3, 15, 0, 0)).unwrap(),
      "2026-09-03"
    );
    assert_eq!(slot_run_id(utc(2026, 9, 4, 1, 0, 0)).unwrap(), "2026-09-03");
    assert_eq!(
      slot_run_id(utc(2026, 9, 7, 7, 31, 0)).unwrap(),
      "2026-09-07"
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn validate_run_id_rejects_malformed_future_and_non_slot_dates() {
    let now = utc(2026, 9, 3, 15, 0, 0);
    assert!(validate_run_id_at("2026-09-03", now).is_ok());
    assert!(validate_run_id_at("2026-08-31", now).is_ok());
    assert_eq!(
      validate_run_id_at("not-a-date", now).unwrap_err(),
      "runId must be YYYY-MM-DD"
    );
    assert!(
      validate_run_id_at("2026-09-02", now)
        .unwrap_err()
        .contains("not a scheduled")
    );
    assert!(
      validate_run_id_at("2026-09-07", now)
        .unwrap_err()
        .contains("later than the most recent slot")
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn missed_scheduled_slot_is_true_when_nothing_has_run_since_the_slot() {
    let now = utc(2026, 9, 3, 8, 0, 0);
    assert!(missed_scheduled_slot(&HistoryRunState::default(), now));

    let attempted_this_slot = HistoryRunState {
      last_attempt_at: Some(utc(2026, 9, 3, 7, 31, 0)),
      last_attempt_run_id: Some("2026-09-03".to_string()),
      last_failure_at: Some(utc(2026, 9, 3, 7, 31, 0)),
      last_failure_reason: Some("boom".to_string()),
      ..HistoryRunState::default()
    };
    assert!(!missed_scheduled_slot(&attempted_this_slot, now));

    let last_week = HistoryRunState {
      last_attempt_at: Some(utc(2026, 8, 31, 7, 31, 0)),
      last_attempt_run_id: Some("2026-08-31".to_string()),
      last_success_at: Some(utc(2026, 8, 31, 7, 31, 0)),
      ..HistoryRunState::default()
    };
    assert!(missed_scheduled_slot(&last_week, now));
  }

  #[test]
  fn run_state_serializes_camel_case_keys() {
    let state = HistoryRunState {
      last_attempt_at: Some(utc(2026, 9, 3, 7, 31, 0)),
      last_attempt_run_id: Some("2026-09-03".to_string()),
```

```
/// `runId` must be `YYYY-MM-DD`, a Mon/Thu 07:30 UTC slot, and not later
/// than the most recent scheduled slot at `now`.
pub fn validate_run_id_at(run_id: &str, now: DateTime<Utc>) -> Result<(), String> {
  let date = chrono::NaiveDate::parse_from_str(run_id, "%Y-%m-%d")
    .map_err(|_| "runId must be YYYY-MM-DD".to_string())?;
  let slot_time = date
    .and_hms_opt(7, 30, 0)
    .map(|t| t.and_utc())
    .ok_or_else(|| "runId is not a valid date".to_string())?;
  let Some(prev) = previous_execution_time(SCHEDULE, slot_time + chrono::Duration::seconds(1))
  else {
    return Err("standings history schedule could not be parsed".to_string());
  };
  if prev != slot_time {
    return Err(format!(
      "runId {run_id} is not a scheduled Monday/Thursday 07:30 UTC slot"
    ));
  }
  let latest = previous_execution_time(SCHEDULE, now)
    .ok_or_else(|| "standings history schedule could not be parsed".to_string())?;
  if slot_time > latest {
    return Err(format!(
      "runId {run_id} is later than the most recent slot {}",
      slot_run_id_from(latest)
    ));
  }
  Ok(())
}

pub fn validate_run_id(run_id: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
  validate_run_id_at(run_id, Utc::now())
}

/// True when no capture attempt has been recorded at or after the most
/// recent scheduled slot. A recorded failure for that slot is not a miss:
/// retrying it on every replica start would re-spend the run budget.
pub fn missed_scheduled_slot(state: &HistoryRunState, now: DateTime<Utc>) -> bool {
  let Some(slot) = previous_execution_time(SCHEDULE, now) else {
    return false;
  };
  let slot_id = slot_run_id_from(slot);
  if state.last_attempt_run_id.as_deref() == Some(slot_id.as_str()) {
    return false;
  }
  let last_outcome = [
    state.last_success_at,
    state.last_failure_at,
    state.last_attempt_at,
  ]
  .into_iter()
  .flatten()
  .max();
  match last_outcome {
    None => true,
    Some(at) => at < slot,
  }
}

pub fn note_snapshot_bounds(state: &mut HistoryRunState, captured_at: DateTime<Utc>) {
  match state.oldest_snapshot_at {
    Some(oldest) if captured_at >= oldest => {}
    _ => state.oldest_snapshot_at = Some(captured_at),
  }
  match state.newest_snapshot_at {
    Some(newest) if captured_at <= newest => {}
    _ => state.newest_snapshot_at = Some(captured_at),
  }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
  use super::*;
  use chrono::TimeZone;

  fn utc(year: i32, month: u32, day: u32, hour: u32, min: u32, sec: u32) -> DateTime<Utc> {
    Utc
      .with_ymd_and_hms(year, month, day, hour, min, sec)
      .unwrap()
  }

  #[test]
  fn schedule_fires_monday_and_thursday_at_0730_utc() {
    // 2026-09-03 is a Thursday; 2026-09-07 is a Monday.
    assert_eq!(
      previous_execution_time(SCHEDULE, utc(2026, 9, 3, 7, 30, 1)),
      Some(utc(2026, 9, 3, 7, 30, 0))
    );
    assert_eq!(
      previous_execution_time(SCHEDULE, utc(2026, 9, 4, 12, 0, 0)),
      Some(utc(2026, 9, 3, 7, 30, 0))
    );
    assert_eq!(
      previous_execution_time(SCHEDULE, utc(2026, 9, 7, 7, 31, 0)),
      Some(utc(2026, 9, 7, 7, 30, 0))
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn slot_run_id_is_the_utc_date_of_the_most_recent_slot() {
    assert_eq!(
      slot_run_id(utc(2026, 9, 3, 15, 0, 0)).unwrap(),
      "2026-09-03"
    );
    assert_eq!(slot_run_id(utc(2026, 9, 4, 1, 0, 0)).unwrap(), "2026-09-03");
    assert_eq!(
      slot_run_id(utc(2026, 9, 7, 7, 31, 0)).unwrap(),
      "2026-09-07"
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn validate_run_id_rejects_malformed_future_and_non_slot_dates() {
    let now = utc(2026, 9, 3, 15, 0, 0);
    assert!(validate_run_id_at("2026-09-03", now).is_ok());
    assert!(validate_run_id_at("2026-08-31", now).is_ok());
    assert_eq!(
      validate_run_id_at("not-a-date", now).unwrap_err(),
      "runId must be YYYY-MM-DD"
    );
    assert!(
      validate_run_id_at("2026-09-02", now)
        .unwrap_err()
        .contains("not a scheduled")
    );
    assert!(
      validate_run_id_at("2026-09-07", now)
        .unwrap_err()
        .contains("later than the most recent slot")
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn missed_scheduled_slot_is_true_when_nothing_has_run_since_the_slot() {
    let now = utc(2026, 9, 3, 8, 0, 0);
    assert!(missed_scheduled_slot(&HistoryRunState::default(), now));

    let attempted_this_slot = HistoryRunState {
      last_attempt_at: Some(utc(2026, 9, 3, 7, 31, 0)),
      last_attempt_run_id: Some("2026-09-03".to_string()),
      last_failure_at: Some(utc(2026, 9, 3, 7, 31, 0)),
      last_failure_reason: Some("boom".to_string()),
      ..HistoryRunState::default()
    };
    assert!(!missed_scheduled_slot(&attempted_this_slot, now));

    let last_week = HistoryRunState {
      last_attempt_at: Some(utc(2026, 8, 31, 7, 31, 0)),
      last_attempt_run_id: Some("2026-08-31".to_string()),
      last_success_at: Some(utc(2026, 8, 31, 7, 31, 0)),
      ..HistoryRunState::default()
    };
    assert!(missed_scheduled_slot(&last_week, now));
  }

  #[test]
  fn run_state_serializes_camel_case_keys() {
    let state = HistoryRunState {
      last_attempt_at: Some(utc(2026, 9, 3, 7, 31, 0)),
      last_attempt_run_id: Some("2026-09-03".to_string()),
      last_success_at: Some(utc(2026, 9, 3, 7, 31, 0)),
      last_failure_at: None,
      last_failure_reason: None,
      last_run_counts: Some(CaptureCounts {
        fencers_attempted: 2,
        fencers_succeeded: 2,
        ..CaptureCounts::default()
      }),
      oldest_snapshot_at: Some(utc(2026, 9, 3, 7, 31, 0)),
      newest_snapshot_at: Some(utc(2026, 9, 3, 7, 31, 0)),
    };
    let value = serde_json::to_value(&state).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(value["lastAttemptRunId"], "2026-09-03");
    assert_eq!(value["lastRunCounts"]["fencersAttempted"], 2);
    assert_eq!(value["lastRunCounts"]["fencersSucceeded"], 2);
    assert!(value.get("last_attempt_run_id").is_none());
    assert!(value["lastRunCounts"].get("fencers_attempted").is_none());
  }

  #[test]
  fn summary_includes_british_capture_fields() {
    let counts = CaptureCounts {
      british_captured: 3,
      british_rankings_flag_disabled: true,
      ..CaptureCounts::default()
    };
    assert!(
      counts
        .summary()
        .contains("british captured=3 flagDisabled=true")
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn capture_counts_serializes_british_fields_as_camel_case() {
    let counts = CaptureCounts {
      british_captured: 3,
      british_rankings_flag_disabled: true,

    assert_eq!(value["britishRankingsFlagDisabled"], true);
    assert!(value.get("british_captured").is_none());
    assert!(value.get("britishLicenceAmbiguous").is_none());
    assert!(value.get("british_rankings_flag_disabled").is_none());
  }
}
```

```diff
  }
```

```
impl TournamentFields {
  pub fn in_date_range(&self, start: NaiveDate, end: NaiveDate) -> bool {
    if let (Some(my_start), Some(my_end)) = (self.start_date, self.end_date) {
      return my_start >= start && my_end <= end;
    }
    false
  }

  pub fn starts_after(&self, start: NaiveDate) -> bool {
    if let Some(my_start) = self.start_date {
      return my_start >= start;
    }
    false
  }

  fn get_timeline_time(&self, kind: TimelineKind) -> Option<DateTime<Utc>> {
    self
      .timeline
      .iter()
      .find(|tl| tl.kind == kind)
      .map(|tl| tl.date)
  }

  /// Returns true if now is >= the registration open date for this tournament,
  /// based on its timeline.
  pub fn is_registration_open(&self, now: DateTime<Utc>) -> bool {
    let open_date = self.get_timeline_time(TimelineKind::RegistrationOpens);
    open_date.map(|d| now >= d).unwrap_or_default()
  }

  /// The timestamp registration opened for this tournament, per its cached
  /// timeline, or `None` if that timeline entry hasn't been observed.
  pub fn registration_opened_at(&self) -> Option<DateTime<Utc>> {
    self.get_timeline_time(TimelineKind::RegistrationOpens)
  }

  pub fn get_weapons(&self) -> Vec<String> {
    self
      .events
      .iter()
      .filter_map(|e| e.fields.classifier.get_weapon())
      .map(|w| w.to_string())
      .collect_vec()
  }

  pub fn get_classifiers(&self) -> HashSet<EventClassifier> {
    self
      .events
      .iter()
      .map(|e| e.fields.classifier.clone())
      .collect::<HashSet<_>>()
  }

  pub fn find_event(&self, classifier: &EventClassifier) -> Option<&Event> {
    self
      .events
      .iter()
      .find(|e| e.fields.classifier == *classifier)
  }

  pub fn get_event(&self, event_id: &str) -> Option<&Event> {
    self.events.iter().find(|e| e.id == event_id)
  }
}

#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct EventFields {
  pub id_detail: Option<IdDetail>,
  /// The category of this event
  pub classifier: EventClassifier,
  #[builder(default)]
  pub date: Option<NaiveDate>,
  #[builder(default)]
  pub matches: Option<Vec<Match>>,
  #[builder(default)]

  /// The id of the timezone the event occurs in (e.g. "America/Los_Angeles"). You can
  /// use this along with the date + start_time to get the actual start time of the event.
  #[builder(default)]

}

impl HasIdDetail for EventFields {
  fn id_detail(&self) -> &IdDetail {
    self.id_detail.as_ref().unwrap_or(&DEFAULT_ID_DETAIL)
  }
}

impl EventFields {
  /// Gets the start of this event as a NaiveDateTime. If there's no start time yet, this
  /// will return None.
  pub fn get_start(&self) -> Option<NaiveDateTime> {
    if let (Some(start_date), Some(start_time)) = (self.date, self.start_time) {
      Some(NaiveDateTime::new(start_date, start_time))
    } else {
      None
    }
  }

  pub fn set_ftl_id(&mut self, id: &str) {
    match self.id_detail {
      None => {
        self.id_detail = Some(
          IdDetailBuilder::default()
            .ftl_id(Some(id.to_string()))
            .build()
            .unwrap(),
        )
      }
      Some(ref mut id_detail) => {
        id_detail.ftl_id = Some(id.to_string());
      }
    }
  }

  fn has_match(&self, other: &Match) -> bool {
    if let Some(matches) = &self.matches {
      for m in matches {
        if m.left == other.left && m.right == other.right && m.stage == other.stage {
          return true;
        }
      }
    }
    false
  }

  /// Adds a match, but only if it's not already present, based on the left & right participant and
  /// stage.
  pub fn add_match(&mut self, m: Match) {
    if self.has_match(&m) {
      return;
    }
    match self.matches {
      None => {
        self.matches = Some(vec![m]);
      }
      Some(ref mut matches) => {
        matches.push(m);
      }
    }
  }
}

mod model_behavior_tests {

  use crate::usafencing::model::{TimelineItem, TimelineKind};
  use chrono::{DateTime, NaiveDate, NaiveTime, Utc};
  use ids::Identified;
  use model_common::{EventCategory, EventGender, RecognizedClassifier, Weapon};

  fn test_event(classifier: EventClassifier, id: &str) -> Event {
    let fields = EventFieldsBuilder::default()
      .id_detail(None)
      .classifier(classifier)
      .build()
      .unwrap();

  }

  fn test_match() -> Match {
    Match {
      stage: Stage::Pool(PoolDetails { sequence: 1 }),
      left: Participant {
        seed: Some(1),
        individual: Some(Individual {
          fencer: MatchFencer::FencerId("left-id".to_string()),
          score: Some(5),
          outcome: Some(MatchOutcome::Win),
        }),
        is_bye: false,
      },
      right: Participant {
        seed: Some(2),
        individual: Some(Individual {
          fencer: MatchFencer::FencerId("right-id".to_string()),
          score: Some(3),
          outcome: Some(MatchOutcome::Lose),
        }),
        is_bye: false,
      },
      video_link: None,
    }
  }

  #[test]
  fn tournament_date_range_methods_require_dates() {
    let with_dates = TournamentFieldsBuilder::default()
      .id_detail(IdDetailBuilder::default().build().unwrap())
      .name("Tournament".to_string())
      .start_date(Some(NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 3, 1).unwrap()))
      .end_date(Some(NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 3, 3).unwrap()))
      .build()
      .unwrap();
    let without_dates = TournamentFieldsBuilder::default()
      .id_detail(IdDetailBuilder::default().build().unwrap())
      .name("Tournament".to_string())
      .build()
      .unwrap();

    assert!(with_dates.in_date_range(
      NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 2, 28).unwrap(),
      NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 3, 5).unwrap()
    ));
    assert!(with_dates.starts_after(NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 2, 28).unwrap()));
    assert!(!without_dates.in_date_range(
      NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 2, 28).unwrap(),
      NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 3, 5).unwrap()
    ));
    assert!(!without_dates.starts_after(NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 2, 28).unwrap()));
  }

  #[test]
  fn tournament_registration_open_uses_timeline_registration_open_event() {
    let open_date = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339("2026-01-10T12:00:00Z")
      .unwrap()
      .with_timezone(&Utc);
    let before = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339("2026-01-10T11:59:59Z")
      .unwrap()
      .with_timezone(&Utc);
    let after = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339("2026-01-10T12:00:01Z")
      .unwrap()
      .with_timezone(&Utc);

    let tournament = TournamentFieldsBuilder::default()
      .id_detail(IdDetailBuilder::default().build().unwrap())
      .name("Tournament".to_string())
      .timeline(vec![TimelineItem {
        kind: TimelineKind::RegistrationOpens,
        date: open_date,
      }])
      .build()
      .unwrap();

    assert!(!tournament.is_registration_open(before));
    assert!(tournament.is_registration_open(after));
  }

  #[test]
  fn tournament_event_lookup_and_classifier_aggregation_work() {
    let recognized = EventClassifier::Recognized(RecognizedClassifier {
      weapon: Weapon::Foil,
      gender: EventGender::Mens,
      category: EventCategory::Junior,
      team: false,
    });
    let unrecognized = EventClassifier::Unrecognized("OPEN".to_string());

    let event1 = test_event(recognized.clone(), "event-1");
    let event2 = test_event(unrecognized.clone(), "event-2");

    let tournament = TournamentFieldsBuilder::default()
      .id_detail(IdDetailBuilder::default().build().unwrap())
      .name("Tournament".to_string())
      .events(vec![event1.clone(), event2.clone()])
      .build()
      .unwrap();

    assert_eq!(tournament.get_weapons(), vec!["Foil".to_string()]);
    assert!(tournament.get_classifiers().contains(&recognized));
    assert!(tournament.get_classifiers().contains(&unrecognized));
    assert_eq!(
      tournament.find_event(&recognized).map(|e| e.id.clone()),
      Some(event1.id)
    );
    assert_eq!(
      tournament.get_event("event-2").map(|e| e.id.clone()),
      Some(event2.id)
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn event_fields_get_start_combines_date_and_time() {
    let fields = EventFieldsBuilder::default()
      .id_detail(None)
      .classifier(EventClassifier::Unrecognized("OPEN".to_string()))
      .date(Some(NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 4, 3).unwrap()))
      .start_time(Some(NaiveTime::from_hms_opt(9, 30, 0).unwrap()))
      .build()
      .unwrap();

    assert_eq!(
      fields.get_start(),
      Some(
        NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 4, 3)
          .unwrap()
          .and_hms_opt(9, 30, 0)
          .unwrap()
      )
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn event_fields_add_match_deduplicates_same_match() {
    let mut fields = EventFieldsBuilder::default()
      .id_detail(None)
      .classifier(EventClassifier::Unrecognized("OPEN".to_string()))
      .build()
      .unwrap();
    let m = test_match();

    fields.add_match(m.clone());
    fields.add_match(m);

    assert_eq!(fields.matches.as_ref().map(|ms| ms.len()), Some(1));
  }

  #[test]
  fn event_fields_set_ftl_id_creates_or_updates_id_detail() {

    );

    assert_eq!(
      fields.id_detail.as_ref().and_then(|d| d.ftl_id.clone()),
      Some("ftl-2".to_string())
    );
  }

  }

/// Rollout configuration for a single capability.
#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct CapabilityRollout {
  /// The capability this configuration applies to.
  pub capability: UserCapability,

  /// Percentage of users to roll out to (0-100).
  /// Uses a hash of user ID for consistent assignment.
  #[serde(default)]
  pub rollout_percentage: u8,

  /// Groups that always get this capability.
  #[serde(default)]
  pub enabled_groups: Vec<String>,

  /// Groups that never get this capability (overrides percentage rollout).
  #[serde(default)]
  pub disabled_groups: Vec<String>,

  /// If true, capability is enabled for all users (overrides percentage).
  #[serde(default)]
  pub enabled_for_all: bool,
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ServiceConnection {
  GoogleCalendar,
  YouTubeUpload,
  YouTubeMetadata,
  Unknown,
}

impl From<&str> for ServiceConnection {
  fn from(value: &str) -> Self {
    match value {
      "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.events.owned" => Self::GoogleCalendar,
      "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.upload" => Self::YouTubeUpload,
      "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube" => Self::YouTubeMetadata,
      _ => Self::Unknown,
    }
  }
}

impl UserFields {
  pub fn get_notification_emails(&self) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut result = vec![];
    result.push(self.primary_user.email.clone());
    for o in &self.observers {
      result.push(o.email.clone());
    }
    result
  }
}
```
