/// A tracked fencer reference. All tracked fencers use USAF IDs in view format (f.u.xxx).
#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct TrackedFencer {
  pub fencer_id: ViewTypedId<FencerId>,
  #[serde(default)]
  pub results_backfill: ResultsBackfillStatus,
  /// British Fencing membership id (their "Licence"), joined against the
  /// British Fencing live-ranking tables' `Licence` column. Optional; most
  /// tracked fencers will never have one. See
  /// docs/design-docs/british-fencing-rankings-as-a-standings-source.md,
  /// "Where the membership id lives".
  #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
  pub british_fencing_licence: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Default, Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub enum ResultsBackfillState {
  #[default]
  LegacyComplete,
  BlockedOnCapability,
  Queued,
  Running,
  Complete,
  Failed,
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct ResultsBackfillStatus {
  pub state: ResultsBackfillState,
  pub requested_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
  pub started_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
  pub completed_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
  pub attempts: u32,
  pub events_total: Option<u32>,
  pub events_processed: u32,
  pub bouts_upserted: u32,
  pub unresolved_event_ids: u32,
  pub last_error: Option<String>,
}

impl Default for ResultsBackfillStatus {
  fn default() -> Self {
    Self {
      state: ResultsBackfillState::LegacyComplete,
      requested_at: None,
      started_at: None,
      completed_at: None,
      attempts: 0,
      events_total: None,
      events_processed: 0,
      bouts_upserted: 0,
      unresolved_event_ids: 0,
      last_error: None,
    }
  }
}

impl ResultsBackfillStatus {
  pub fn blocked_on_capability() -> Self {
    Self {
      state: ResultsBackfillState::BlockedOnCapability,
      ..Default::default()
    }
  }

  pub fn queued(requested_at: DateTime<Utc>) -> Self {
    Self {
      state: ResultsBackfillState::Queued,
      requested_at: Some(requested_at),
      ..Default::default()
    }
  }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tracked_fencer_tests {
  use super::*;

  #[test]
  fn test_deserialize_usaf_id() {
    let json = r#"{"fencerId": "f.u.12345678"}"#;
    let tf: TrackedFencer = serde_json::from_str(json).unwrap();
    assert!(tf.fencer_id.is_usaf());
    assert_eq!(tf.fencer_id.as_str(), "12345678");
    assert_eq!(tf.fencer_id.to_view_string(), "f.u.12345678");
    assert_eq!(
      tf.results_backfill.state,
      ResultsBackfillState::LegacyComplete
    );
    assert_eq!(tf.british_fencing_licence, None);
  }

  #[test]
  fn test_british_fencing_licence_round_trips_and_is_omitted_when_absent() {
    let json = r#"{"fencerId": "f.u.12345678"}"#;
    let tf: TrackedFencer = serde_json::from_str(json).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tf.british_fencing_licence, None);
    let serialized = serde_json::to_string(&tf).unwrap();
    assert!(!serialized.contains("britishFencingLicence"));

    let json = r#"{"fencerId": "f.u.12345678", "britishFencingLicence": "142013"}"#;
    let tf: TrackedFencer = serde_json::from_str(json).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tf.british_fencing_licence, Some("142013".to_string()));
    let serialized = serde_json::to_string(&tf).unwrap();
    assert!(serialized.contains(r#""britishFencingLicence":"142013""#));
  }

  #[test]
  fn test_deserialize_with_backfill_status() {
    let json = r#"{
      "fencerId": "f.u.12345678",
      "resultsBackfill": {
        "state": "queued",
        "attempts": 1,
        "eventsProcessed": 2,
        "boutsUpserted": 3,
        "unresolvedEventIds": 4
      }
    }"#;
    let tf: TrackedFencer = serde_json::from_str(json).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tf.results_backfill.state, ResultsBackfillState::Queued);
    assert_eq!(tf.results_backfill.attempts, 1);
    assert_eq!(tf.results_backfill.events_processed, 2);
    assert_eq!(tf.results_backfill.bouts_upserted, 3);
    assert_eq!(tf.results_backfill.unresolved_event_ids, 4);
  }

  #[test]
  fn test_deserialize_with_blocked_state() {
    let json = r#"{
      "fencerId": "f.u.12345678",
      "resultsBackfill": {
        "state": "blockedOnCapability",
        "attempts": 0,
        "eventsProcessed": 0,
        "boutsUpserted": 0,
        "unresolvedEventIds": 0
      }
    }"#;
    let tf: TrackedFencer = serde_json::from_str(json).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
      tf.results_backfill.state,
      ResultsBackfillState::BlockedOnCapability
    );
  }
}

#[derive(Default, Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq, Display)]
pub enum NotificationPriority {
  /// A notification that you'd want the user to see immediately, generally
  /// would be implemented using a push notification or similar.
  VeryHigh,
  // A notification that you'd want the user to see soon, generally
  // would be implemented using a WhatsApp message.
  High,
  // A notification that you'd want to push to the user, but not in an interruptive
  // way. Generally uses email.
  Medium,
  // A notification that the user can see when they go to notifications.
  #[default]
  Low,
}

fn null_as_default<'de, D, T>(deserializer: D) -> Result<T, D::Error>
where
  T: Default + Deserialize<'de>,
  D: serde::Deserializer<'de>,
{
  let opt = Option::deserialize(deserializer)?;
  Ok(opt.unwrap_or_default())
}

pub type Tournament = Identified<TournamentFields>;

pub fn transient_fencer(fields: FencerFields) -> Identified<FencerFields> {
  Identified::external(
    ExternalId::Transient(TransientFencerInfo {
      name: fields.name.clone(),
      club: fields
        .current_club_name
        .as_ref()
        .unwrap_or(&"".to_string())
        .clone(),
      year: fields.birth_year,
    }),
    fields,
  )
}

#[derive(Serialize, Clone, Debug, Deserialize, Hash, PartialEq, Eq, Builder)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct TournamentFields {
  pub id_detail: IdDetail,
  pub name: String,

  #[builder(setter(into), default)]
  pub start_date: Option<NaiveDate>,

  #[builder(setter(into), default)]
  pub end_date: Option<NaiveDate>,

  #[builder(setter(into), default)]
  pub city: Option<String>,

  #[builder(setter(into), default)]
  pub country: Option<String>,

  #[builder(setter(into), default)]
  pub address: Option<String>,

  #[builder(setter(into), default)]
  pub r#type: Option<String>,

  #[builder(setter(into), default)]
  #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
  pub events: Vec<Event>,

  #[builder(setter(into), default)]
  pub usa_region: Option<u8>,

  #[builder(setter(into), default)]
  pub super_circuit: Option<bool>,

  #[builder(setter(into), default)]
  #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
  pub timeline: Vec<TimelineItem>,

  /// This is only filled in for scheduled events before they're
  /// live on usafencing, replacing the events.
  #[builder(setter(into, strip_option), default)]
  #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "null_as_default")]
  pub categories: Vec<EventCategory>,
}

impl HasIdDetail for TournamentFields {
  fn id_detail(&self) -> &IdDetail {
    &self.id_detail
  }
}

impl TournamentFields {
  pub fn in_date_range(&self, start: NaiveDate, end: NaiveDate) -> bool {
    if let (Some(my_start), Some(my_end)) = (self.start_date, self.end_date) {
      return my_start >= start && my_end <= end;
    }
    false
  }

  pub fn starts_after(&self, start: NaiveDate) -> bool {
    if let Some(my_start) = self.start_date {
      return my_start >= start;
    }
    false
  }

  fn get_timeline_time(&self, kind: TimelineKind) -> Option<DateTime<Utc>> {
    self
      .timeline
      .iter()
      .find(|tl| tl.kind == kind)
      .map(|tl| tl.date)
  }

  /// Returns true if now is >= the registration open date for this tournament,
  /// based on its timeline.
  pub fn is_registration_open(&self, now: DateTime<Utc>) -> bool {
    let open_date = self.get_timeline_time(TimelineKind::RegistrationOpens);
    open_date.map(|d| now >= d).unwrap_or_default()
  }

  /// The timestamp registration opened for this tournament, per its cached
  /// timeline, or `None` if that timeline entry hasn't been observed.
  pub fn registration_opened_at(&self) -> Option<DateTime<Utc>> {
    self.get_timeline_time(TimelineKind::RegistrationOpens)
  }

  pub fn get_weapons(&self) -> Vec<String> {
    self
      .events
      .iter()
      .filter_map(|e| e.fields.classifier.get_weapon())
      .map(|w| w.to_string())
      .collect_vec()
  }

  pub fn get_classifiers(&self) -> HashSet<EventClassifier> {
    self
      .events
      .iter()
      .map(|e| e.fields.classifier.clone())
      .collect::<HashSet<_>>()
  }

  pub fn find_event(&self, classifier: &EventClassifier) -> Option<&Event> {
    self
      .events
      .iter()
      .find(|e| e.fields.classifier == *classifier)
  }

  pub fn get_event(&self, event_id: &str) -> Option<&Event> {
    self.events.iter().find(|e| e.id == event_id)
  }
}

pub type Fencer = Identified<FencerFields>;

#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq, Builder)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct FencerFields {
  #[builder(default)]
  pub id_detail: IdDetail,
  pub name: String,

  #[builder(default, setter(strip_option))]
  #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
  pub birth_year: Option<u16>,

  #[builder(default, setter(strip_option))]
  #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
  pub first_competition_year: Option<u16>,

  #[builder(default, setter(strip_option))]
  #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
  pub country: Option<String>,

  #[builder(default, setter(strip_option))]
  #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
  pub current_club_name: Option<String>,

  #[builder(default)]
  #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
  pub gender: Option<String>,

  #[builder(default, setter(strip_option))]
  #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
  pub current_ratings: Option<Ratings>,

  #[builder(default, setter(strip_option))]
  #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
  pub standing: Option<Vec<Standing>>,

  #[builder(default)]
  #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
  pub match_stats: Option<FencerMatchStats>,

  /// USAF-confirmed registrations for in-progress events, written by the daily
  /// `reconcile_inprogress_registrations` admin task. When computing registrations for
  /// in-progress saber events, this data supersedes FencingTracker as the authoritative source.
  #[builder(default)]
  #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
  pub confirmed_usaf_registrations: Vec<ConfirmedUsafRegistration>,
}

/// A registration confirmed by the USA Fencing API for an in-progress event.
/// Written by the daily `reconcile_inprogress_registrations` admin task.
#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct ConfirmedUsafRegistration {
  /// USA Fencing tournament ID (numeric, stored as string).
  pub tournament_id: String,
  /// USA Fencing event ID (numeric, stored as string).
  pub event_id: String,
  /// Date this registration was last confirmed by the reconciliation task.
  pub last_confirmed_date: NaiveDate,
}

impl HasIdDetail for FencerFields {
  fn id_detail(&self) -> &IdDetail {
    &self.id_detail
  }
}

pub type Event = Identified<EventFields>;

#[derive(Serialize, Clone, Debug, Deserialize, Hash, PartialEq, Eq, Builder)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct EventFields {
  pub id_detail: Option<IdDetail>,
  /// The category of this event
  pub classifier: EventClassifier,
  #[builder(default)]
  pub date: Option<NaiveDate>,
  #[builder(default)]
  pub matches: Option<Vec<Match>>,
  #[builder(default)]
  pub start_time: Option<NaiveTime>,
  #[builder(default)]
  pub end_time: Option<NaiveTime>,
  #[builder(default)]
  pub status: Option<EventStatus>,
  #[builder(default)]
  pub live: Option<LiveEvent>,
  #[builder(default)]
  pub rating: Option<EventRating>,
  #[builder(default)]
  pub registered_fencers: Option<u16>,
  #[builder(default)]
  pub total_spots: Option<u16>,

  /// The id of the timezone the event occurs in (e.g. "America/Los_Angeles"). You can
  /// use this along with the date + start_time to get the actual start time of the event.
  #[builder(default)]
  pub time_zone_id: Option<String>,
}

impl HasIdDetail for EventFields {
  fn id_detail(&self) -> &IdDetail {
    self.id_detail.as_ref().unwrap_or(&DEFAULT_ID_DETAIL)
  }
}

impl EventFields {
  /// Gets the start of this event as a NaiveDateTime. If there's no start time yet, this
  /// will return None.
  pub fn get_start(&self) -> Option<NaiveDateTime> {
    if let (Some(start_date), Some(start_time)) = (self.date, self.start_time) {
      Some(NaiveDateTime::new(start_date, start_time))
    } else {
      None
    }
  }

  pub fn set_ftl_id(&mut self, id: &str) {
    match self.id_detail {
      None => {
        self.id_detail = Some(
          IdDetailBuilder::default()
            .ftl_id(Some(id.to_string()))
            .build()
            .unwrap(),
        )
      }
      Some(ref mut id_detail) => {
        id_detail.ftl_id = Some(id.to_string());
      }
    }
  }

  fn has_match(&self, other: &Match) -> bool {
    if let Some(matches) = &self.matches {
      for m in matches {
        if m.left == other.left && m.right == other.right && m.stage == other.stage {
          return true;
        }
      }
    }
    false
  }

  /// Adds a match, but only if it's not already present, based on the left & right participant and
  /// stage.
  pub fn add_match(&mut self, m: Match) {
    if self.has_match(&m) {
      return;
    }
    match self.matches {
      None => {
        self.matches = Some(vec![m]);
      }
      Some(ref mut matches) => {
        matches.push(m);
      }
    }
  }
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]

    completed_pools: u8,

#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]

}

#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct EliminationDetails {
  pub round_of: u16,
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase", tag = "type")]
pub enum Stage {
  Pool(PoolDetails),
  Elimination(EliminationDetails),
  Unknown,
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct Match {
  pub stage: Stage,
  pub left: Participant,
  pub right: Participant,
  pub video_link: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Participant {
  pub seed: Option<u16>,
  pub individual: Option<Individual>,
  pub is_bye: bool,
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(untagged)]
pub enum MatchFencer {
  Fencer(Box<Fencer>),
  FencerId(String),
  FencerName(String),
}

impl MatchFencer {
  pub fn get_id(&self) -> String {
    match self {
      Self::Fencer(f) => f.id.clone(),
      Self::FencerId(id) => id.clone(),
      Self::FencerName(_) => panic!("Can't get id from this fencer"),
    }
  }
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Individual {
  pub fencer: MatchFencer,
  pub score: Option<u8>,
  pub outcome: Option<MatchOutcome>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub enum MatchOutcome {
  Withdraw,
  Win,
  Lose,
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Registration {
  pub tournament_id: String,
  pub event_ids: Vec<String>,

  /// This flag is used to indicate that the registration is in the past. It may no longer be used.
  pub historical: Option<bool>,
}

pub type User = Identified<UserFields>;

/// User capabilities for feature flags and permissions.
#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "PascalCase")]
pub enum UserCapability {
  Administrator,
  Developer,
  /// Access to the Plan tab (tournament schedule view).
  TabPlan,
  /// Access to the Results tab (match results view).
  TabResults,
  /// Access to the Fencers tab (opponent statistics view).
  TabFencers,
  /// Access to the Standings tab (rankings view).
  TabStandings,
  /// Access to the Live tab (live bout tracking view).
  TabLive,
  /// Access to Family Groups feature (creating/joining family groups, invitations).
  FamilyGroups,
  #[serde(other)]
  Unknown,
}

impl UserCapability {
  /// Returns true if this is a known capability (not Unknown).
  pub fn is_known(&self) -> bool {
    !matches!(self, UserCapability::Unknown)
  }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod model_behavior_tests {
  use super::*;
  use crate::usafencing::model::{TimelineItem, TimelineKind};
  use chrono::{DateTime, NaiveDate, NaiveTime, Utc};
  use ids::Identified;
  use model_common::{EventCategory, EventGender, RecognizedClassifier, Weapon};

  fn test_event(classifier: EventClassifier, id: &str) -> Event {
    let fields = EventFieldsBuilder::default()
      .id_detail(None)
      .classifier(classifier)
      .build()
      .unwrap();
    Identified::new(id, fields)
  }

  fn test_match() -> Match {
    Match {
      stage: Stage::Pool(PoolDetails { sequence: 1 }),
      left: Participant {
        seed: Some(1),
        individual: Some(Individual {
          fencer: MatchFencer::FencerId("left-id".to_string()),
          score: Some(5),
          outcome: Some(MatchOutcome::Win),
        }),
        is_bye: false,
      },
      right: Participant {
        seed: Some(2),
        individual: Some(Individual {
          fencer: MatchFencer::FencerId("right-id".to_string()),
          score: Some(3),
          outcome: Some(MatchOutcome::Lose),
        }),
        is_bye: false,
      },
      video_link: None,
    }
  }

  #[test]
  fn tournament_date_range_methods_require_dates() {
    let with_dates = TournamentFieldsBuilder::default()
      .id_detail(IdDetailBuilder::default().build().unwrap())
      .name("Tournament".to_string())
      .start_date(Some(NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 3, 1).unwrap()))
      .end_date(Some(NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 3, 3).unwrap()))
      .build()
      .unwrap();
    let without_dates = TournamentFieldsBuilder::default()
      .id_detail(IdDetailBuilder::default().build().unwrap())
      .name("Tournament".to_string())
      .build()
      .unwrap();

    assert!(with_dates.in_date_range(
      NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 2, 28).unwrap(),
      NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 3, 5).unwrap()
    ));
    assert!(with_dates.starts_after(NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 2, 28).unwrap()));
    assert!(!without_dates.in_date_range(
      NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 2, 28).unwrap(),
      NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 3, 5).unwrap()
    ));
    assert!(!without_dates.starts_after(NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 2, 28).unwrap()));
  }

  #[test]
  fn tournament_registration_open_uses_timeline_registration_open_event() {
    let open_date = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339("2026-01-10T12:00:00Z")
      .unwrap()
      .with_timezone(&Utc);
    let before = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339("2026-01-10T11:59:59Z")
      .unwrap()
      .with_timezone(&Utc);
    let after = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339("2026-01-10T12:00:01Z")
      .unwrap()
      .with_timezone(&Utc);

    let tournament = TournamentFieldsBuilder::default()
      .id_detail(IdDetailBuilder::default().build().unwrap())
      .name("Tournament".to_string())
      .timeline(vec![TimelineItem {
        kind: TimelineKind::RegistrationOpens,
        date: open_date,
      }])
      .build()
      .unwrap();

    assert!(!tournament.is_registration_open(before));
    assert!(tournament.is_registration_open(after));
  }

  #[test]
  fn tournament_event_lookup_and_classifier_aggregation_work() {
    let recognized = EventClassifier::Recognized(RecognizedClassifier {
      weapon: Weapon::Foil,
      gender: EventGender::Mens,
      category: EventCategory::Junior,
      team: false,
    });
    let unrecognized = EventClassifier::Unrecognized("OPEN".to_string());

    let event1 = test_event(recognized.clone(), "event-1");
    let event2 = test_event(unrecognized.clone(), "event-2");

    let tournament = TournamentFieldsBuilder::default()
      .id_detail(IdDetailBuilder::default().build().unwrap())
      .name("Tournament".to_string())
      .events(vec![event1.clone(), event2.clone()])
      .build()
      .unwrap();

    assert_eq!(tournament.get_weapons(), vec!["Foil".to_string()]);
    assert!(tournament.get_classifiers().contains(&recognized));
    assert!(tournament.get_classifiers().contains(&unrecognized));
    assert_eq!(
      tournament.find_event(&recognized).map(|e| e.id.clone()),
      Some(event1.id)
    );
    assert_eq!(
      tournament.get_event("event-2").map(|e| e.id.clone()),
      Some(event2.id)
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn event_fields_get_start_combines_date_and_time() {
    let fields = EventFieldsBuilder::default()
      .id_detail(None)
      .classifier(EventClassifier::Unrecognized("OPEN".to_string()))
      .date(Some(NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 4, 3).unwrap()))
      .start_time(Some(NaiveTime::from_hms_opt(9, 30, 0).unwrap()))
      .build()
      .unwrap();

    assert_eq!(
      fields.get_start(),
      Some(
        NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2026, 4, 3)
          .unwrap()
          .and_hms_opt(9, 30, 0)
          .unwrap()
      )
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn event_fields_add_match_deduplicates_same_match() {
    let mut fields = EventFieldsBuilder::default()
      .id_detail(None)
      .classifier(EventClassifier::Unrecognized("OPEN".to_string()))
      .build()
      .unwrap();
    let m = test_match();

    fields.add_match(m.clone());
    fields.add_match(m);

    assert_eq!(fields.matches.as_ref().map(|ms| ms.len()), Some(1));
  }

  #[test]
  fn event_fields_set_ftl_id_creates_or_updates_id_detail() {
    let mut fields = EventFieldsBuilder::default()
      .id_detail(None)
      .classifier(EventClassifier::Unrecognized("OPEN".to_string()))
      .build()
      .unwrap();
    fields.set_ftl_id("ftl-1");
    assert_eq!(
      fields.id_detail.as_ref().and_then(|d| d.ftl_id.clone()),
      Some("ftl-1".to_string())
    );

    fields.set_ftl_id("ftl-2");
    assert_eq!(
      fields.id_detail.as_ref().and_then(|d| d.ftl_id.clone()),
      Some("ftl-2".to_string())
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn user_capability_is_known_returns_false_only_for_unknown() {
    assert!(UserCapability::Developer.is_known());
    assert!(!UserCapability::Unknown.is_known());
  }
}

/// Configuration for capability rollout.
/// This is stored as a single document in Cosmos DB with id "capability-config".
pub type CapabilityConfigDoc = Identified<CapabilityConfigFields>;

/// The fields of the capability configuration document.
#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct CapabilityConfigFields {
  /// Configuration for each capability.
  #[serde(default)]
  pub capabilities: Vec<CapabilityRollout>,
}

impl HasIdDetail for CapabilityConfigFields {
  fn id_detail(&self) -> &IdDetail {
    &DEFAULT_ID_DETAIL
  }
}

/// Rollout configuration for a single capability.
#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct CapabilityRollout {
  /// The capability this configuration applies to.
  pub capability: UserCapability,

  /// Percentage of users to roll out to (0-100).
  /// Uses a hash of user ID for consistent assignment.
  #[serde(default)]
  pub rollout_percentage: u8,

  /// Groups that always get this capability.
  #[serde(default)]
  pub enabled_groups: Vec<String>,

  /// Groups that never get this capability (overrides percentage rollout).
  #[serde(default)]
  pub disabled_groups: Vec<String>,

  /// If true, capability is enabled for all users (overrides percentage).
  #[serde(default)]
  pub enabled_for_all: bool,
}

/// A UserAccount is a primary user of flunge.

#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ServiceConnection {
  GoogleCalendar,
  YouTubeUpload,
  YouTubeMetadata,
  Unknown,
}

impl From<&str> for ServiceConnection {
  fn from(value: &str) -> Self {
    match value {
      "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.events.owned" => Self::GoogleCalendar,
      "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.upload" => Self::YouTubeUpload,
      "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube" => Self::YouTubeMetadata,
      _ => Self::Unknown,
    }
  }
}

impl UserFields {
  pub fn get_notification_emails(&self) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut result = vec![];
    result.push(self.primary_user.email.clone());
    for o in &self.observers {
      result.push(o.email.clone());
    }
    result
  }
}

/// A tracked fencer reference. All tracked fencers use USAF IDs in view format (f.u.xxx).
#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct TrackedFencer {
  pub fencer_id: ViewTypedId<FencerId>,
  #[serde(default)]
  pub results_backfill: ResultsBackfillStatus,
  /// British Fencing membership id (their "Licence"), hydrated onto GET
  /// `/user/me` from the shared fencer-licence record. Not a stored
  /// per-user assertion: writes go to the sidecar collection, and a fencer
  /// refresh cannot touch that collection. See
  /// docs/design-docs/british-fencing-rankings-as-a-standings-source.md,
  /// "Where the membership id lives". Still deserialized so the one-shot
  /// migration can read historical per-user values.
  #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
  pub british_fencing_licence: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Default, Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub enum ResultsBackfillState {
  #[default]
  LegacyComplete,
  BlockedOnCapability,
  Queued,
  Running,
  Complete,
  Failed,
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct ResultsBackfillStatus {
  pub state: ResultsBackfillState,
  pub requested_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
  pub started_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
  pub completed_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
  pub attempts: u32,
  pub events_total: Option<u32>,
  pub events_processed: u32,
  pub bouts_upserted: u32,
  pub unresolved_event_ids: u32,
  pub last_error: Option<String>,
}

impl Default for ResultsBackfillStatus {
  fn default() -> Self {
    Self {
      state: ResultsBackfillState::LegacyComplete,
      requested_at: None,
      started_at: None,
      completed_at: None,
      attempts: 0,
      events_total: None,
      events_processed: 0,
      bouts_upserted: 0,
      unresolved_event_ids: 0,
      last_error: None,
    }
  }
}

impl ResultsBackfillStatus {
  pub fn blocked_on_capability() -> Self {
    Self {
      state: ResultsBackfillState::BlockedOnCapability,
      ..Default::default()
    }
  }

  pub fn queued(requested_at: DateTime<Utc>) -> Self {
    Self {
      state: ResultsBackfillState::Queued,
      requested_at: Some(requested_at),
      ..Default::default()
    }
  }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tracked_fencer_tests {
  use super::*;

  #[test]
  fn test_deserialize_usaf_id() {
    let json = r#"{"fencerId": "f.u.12345678"}"#;
    let tf: TrackedFencer = serde_json::from_str(json).unwrap();
    assert!(tf.fencer_id.is_usaf());
    assert_eq!(tf.fencer_id.as_str(), "12345678");
    assert_eq!(tf.fencer_id.to_view_string(), "f.u.12345678");
    assert_eq!(
      tf.results_backfill.state,
      ResultsBackfillState::LegacyComplete
    );
    assert_eq!(tf.british_fencing_licence, None);
  }

  #[test]
  fn test_british_fencing_licence_round_trips_and_is_omitted_when_absent() {
    let json = r#"{"fencerId": "f.u.12345678"}"#;
    let tf: TrackedFencer = serde_json::from_str(json).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tf.british_fencing_licence, None);
    let serialized = serde_json::to_string(&tf).unwrap();
    assert!(!serialized.contains("britishFencingLicence"));

    let json = r#"{"fencerId": "f.u.12345678", "britishFencingLicence": "142013"}"#;
    let tf: TrackedFencer = serde_json::from_str(json).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tf.british_fencing_licence, Some("142013".to_string()));
    let serialized = serde_json::to_string(&tf).unwrap();
    assert!(serialized.contains(r#""britishFencingLicence":"142013""#));
  }

  #[test]
  fn test_deserialize_with_backfill_status() {
    let json = r#"{
      "fencerId": "f.u.12345678",
      "resultsBackfill": {
        "state": "queued",
        "attempts": 1,
        "eventsProcessed": 2,
        "boutsUpserted": 3,
        "unresolvedEventIds": 4
      }
    }"#;
    let tf: TrackedFencer = serde_json::from_str(json).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tf.results_backfill.state, ResultsBackfillState::Queued);
    assert_eq!(tf.results_backfill.attempts, 1);
    assert_eq!(tf.results_backfill.events_processed, 2);
    assert_eq!(tf.results_backfill.bouts_upserted, 3);
    assert_eq!(tf.results_backfill.unresolved_event_ids, 4);
  }

  #[test]
  fn test_deserialize_with_blocked_state() {
    let json = r#"{
      "fencerId": "f.u.12345678",
      "resultsBackfill": {
        "state": "blockedOnCapability",
        "attempts": 0,
        "eventsProcessed": 0,
        "boutsUpserted": 0,
        "unresolvedEventIds": 0
      }
    }"#;
    let tf: TrackedFencer = serde_json::from_str(json).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
      tf.results_backfill.state,
      ResultsBackfillState::BlockedOnCapability
    );
  }
}

  name = "user_by_id",
  key = String,
  value = User,
  map_err = |e| anyhow::anyhow!("Cache error: {}", e),
  // Preserve the existing sliding TTL-on-read policy.

  /// Gets a user by ID, using Redis cache to avoid repeated DB lookups.

  pub async fn get_user_cached(id: String) -> Result<User> {

/// Invalidates all cached user data for a user given their User object.
/// This is the preferred method when you already have the user data.
///
/// This function directly deletes from Redis rather than going through the
/// OnceCell-based cache clients, ensuring invalidation works even if the
/// cached functions haven't been called yet on this server instance.
pub async fn invalidate_all_user_caches(user: &User) {
  let cache = RedisCache::get().await;

  // Invalidate by ID
  cache.invalidate_io_cached_key("user_by_id", &user.id).await;

  // Invalidate by clerk_id if present
  if let Some(clerk_id) = &user.fields.clerk_user_id {
    cache
      .invalidate_io_cached_key("user_by_clerk_id", clerk_id)
      .await;
  }

  // Invalidate by email
  cache
    .invalidate_io_cached_key("user_by_email", &user.fields.primary_user.email)
    .await;
}

/// Invalidates all cached user data for a user by ID.
/// This fetches the user first to get clerk_id and email for full invalidation.
pub async fn invalidate_user_cache(id: &str) {
  // First, try to get the user to find their clerk_id and email for cache invalidation
  // We fetch from DB directly to avoid using stale cached data
  if let Ok(Some(user)) = get_user(id).await {
    invalidate_all_user_caches(&user).await;
  } else {
    // At minimum, invalidate by ID even if we can't find the user
    let cache = RedisCache::get().await;
    cache.invalidate_io_cached_key("user_by_id", &id).await;
  }
}

redis_cached! {
  name = "user_by_clerk_id",
  key = String,
  value = Option<User>,
  map_err = |e| anyhow::anyhow!("Cache error: {}", e),
  // Preserve the existing sliding TTL-on-read policy.
  refresh = true,
  /// Gets a user by Clerk ID, using Redis cache to avoid repeated DB lookups.
  pub async fn get_user_by_clerk_id_cached(clerk_id: String) -> Result<Option<User>> {
    DB.users
      .first_document_where(&eq!("c.clerkUserId", &clerk_id))
      .await
  }
}

redis_cached! {
  name = "user_by_email",
  key = String,
  value = Option<User>,
  map_err = |e| anyhow::anyhow!("Cache error: {}", e),
  // Preserve the existing sliding TTL-on-read policy.
  refresh = true,
  /// Gets a user by email, using Redis cache to avoid repeated DB lookups.
  pub async fn get_user_by_email_cached(email: String) -> Result<Option<User>> {
    DB.users
      .first_document_where(&eq!("c.primaryUser.email", &email))
      .await
  }
}

pub async fn get_all_users() -> Result<Vec<User>> {
  DB.users.list_documents().await
}

pub async fn set_user_capabilities(
  id: &str,
  capabilities: Vec<super::model::UserCapability>,
) -> Result<User> {
  let original = get_user(id).await?;
  if let Some(mut original) = original {
    let had_results_capability = has_results_capability(&original.fields.capabilities);
    let has_results_capability = has_results_capability(&capabilities);

    // Update the capabilities field
    original.fields.capabilities = capabilities;

    if !had_results_capability && has_results_capability {
      enqueue_blocked_backfills(&mut original.fields.tracked_fencers, Utc::now());
    }

    // Use upsert to replace the entire document - this avoids all the PATCH issues
    // with missing fields in legacy documents
    let result = DB.users.upsert_document(original).await?;
    invalidate_user_cache(id).await;
    return Ok(result);
  }
  Err(anyhow!("Can't find user"))
}

/// Adds a tracked fencer to the user's tracked_fencers list.
/// Returns error if the fencer is already being tracked.
/// The fencer_id should be a ViewTypedId - either f.u.{usaf_id} for USAF IDs or f.d.{db_id} for database IDs.
pub async fn add_tracked_fencer(user_id: &str, fencer_id: ViewTypedId<FencerId>) -> Result<()> {
  let user = get_user(user_id)
    .await?
    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("User not found: {}", user_id))?;

  // Check if already tracking this fencer (compare raw ID part)
  if user
    .fields
    .tracked_fencers
    .iter()
    .any(|tf| tf.fencer_id.as_str() == fencer_id.as_str())
  {
    return Err(anyhow!("Already tracking fencer: {}", fencer_id.as_str()));
  }

  let mut updated_user = user.clone();
  let results_backfill =
    initial_backfill_status_for_capabilities(&user.fields.capabilities, Utc::now());
  updated_user.fields.tracked_fencers.push(TrackedFencer {
    fencer_id,
    results_backfill,
    british_fencing_licence: None,
  });

  DB.users.patch_document(&user, &updated_user).await?;
  invalidate_user_cache(user_id).await;
  Ok(())
}

fn has_results_capability(capabilities: &[UserCapability]) -> bool {
  capabilities.contains(&UserCapability::TabResults)
}

fn initial_backfill_status_for_capabilities(
  capabilities: &[UserCapability],
  requested_at: chrono::DateTime<Utc>,
) -> ResultsBackfillStatus {
  if has_results_capability(capabilities) {
    ResultsBackfillStatus::queued(requested_at)
  } else {
    ResultsBackfillStatus::blocked_on_capability()
  }
}

fn enqueue_blocked_backfills(
  tracked_fencers: &mut [TrackedFencer],
  requested_at: chrono::DateTime<Utc>,
) {
  for tracked in tracked_fencers.iter_mut() {
    if tracked.results_backfill.state == ResultsBackfillState::BlockedOnCapability {
      tracked.results_backfill = ResultsBackfillStatus::queued(requested_at);
    }
  }
}

/// Removes a tracked fencer from the user's tracked_fencers list.
/// The fencer_id should be in view format: "f.u.12345"
pub async fn remove_tracked_fencer(user_id: &str, fencer_id: &str) -> Result<()> {
  let user = get_user(user_id)
    .await?
    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("User not found: {}", user_id))?;

  let original_len = user.fields.tracked_fencers.len();
  let mut updated_user = user.clone();

  updated_user
    .fields
    .tracked_fencers
    .retain(|tf| tf.fencer_id.to_view_string() != fencer_id);

  if updated_user.fields.tracked_fencers.len() == original_len {
    return Err(anyhow!("Fencer not being tracked: {}", fencer_id));
  }

  DB.users.patch_document(&user, &updated_user).await?;
  invalidate_user_cache(user_id).await;
  Ok(())
}

/// Sets or clears the British Fencing membership id (their "Licence") on a
/// tracked fencer. `licence: None` clears it. Returns an error if the fencer
/// is not being tracked.
/// Returns `Ok(false)` (rather than an error) if `fencer_id` is not one of
/// the user's tracked fencers, so callers can distinguish "not tracked" (a
/// 404) from a genuine database failure (a 500) instead of matching on an
/// `anyhow` error message.
pub async fn set_tracked_fencer_british_fencing_licence(
  user_id: &str,
  fencer_id: &str,
  licence: Option<String>,
) -> Result<bool> {
  let user = get_user(user_id)
    .await?
    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("User not found: {}", user_id))?;

  let mut updated_user = user.clone();
  let Some(tracked) = updated_user
    .fields
    .tracked_fencers
    .iter_mut()
    .find(|tf| tf.fencer_id.to_view_string() == fencer_id)
  else {
    return Ok(false);
  };
  tracked.british_fencing_licence = licence;

  DB.users.patch_document(&user, &updated_user).await?;
  invalidate_user_cache(user_id).await;
  Ok(true)
}

fn same_fencer_id(left: &ViewTypedId<FencerId>, right: &ViewTypedId<FencerId>) -> bool {
  left.to_view_string() == right.to_view_string()
}

fn relationship_for_fencer_mut<'a>(
  relationships: &'a mut [FencerRelationship],
  fencer_id: &ViewTypedId<FencerId>,
) -> Option<&'a mut FencerRelationship> {
  relationships
    .iter_mut()
    .find(|relationship| same_fencer_id(&relationship.fencer_id, fencer_id))
}

fn first_rating_classification(fencer: &Fencer) -> Option<String> {
  let ratings = fencer.fields.current_ratings.as_ref()?;
  ratings
    .foil
    .as_ref()
    .or(ratings.epee.as_ref())
    .or(ratings.sabre.as_ref())
    .map(|rating| rating.classification.clone())
}

async fn lookup_fencer_for_relationship(
  fencer_id: &ViewTypedId<FencerId>,
) -> Result<Option<Fencer>> {
  match fencer_id.system() {
    System::Usaf => {
      let mut matches = DB
        .fencers
        .list_documents_where(&eq!("c.idDetail.usafId", fencer_id.as_str()))
        .await?;
      Ok(matches.pop())
    }
    System::Database => DB.fencers.get_document(fencer_id.as_str()).await,
    unsupported => {
      warn!(
        fencer_id = %fencer_id,
        ?unsupported,
        "Skipping relationship display lookup for unsupported fencer system"
      );
      Ok(None)
    }
  }
}

async fn build_relationship_display_snapshot(
  fencer_id: &ViewTypedId<FencerId>,
) -> Result<Option<FencerRelationshipDisplay>> {
  let fencer = lookup_fencer_for_relationship(fencer_id).await?;
  Ok(fencer.map(|fencer| FencerRelationshipDisplay {
    name: fencer.fields.name.clone(),
    club: fencer.fields.current_club_name.clone(),
    country: fencer.fields.country.clone(),
    rating: first_rating_classification(&fencer),
  }))
}

pub async fn follow_fencer(
  user_id: &str,
  fencer_id: ViewTypedId<FencerId>,
) -> Result<FencerRelationship> {
  let user = get_user(user_id)
    .await?
    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("User not found: {}", user_id))?;
  let mut updated_user = user.clone();

  if let Some(existing) =
    relationship_for_fencer_mut(&mut updated_user.fields.fencer_relationships, &fencer_id)
  {
    existing.following = true;
    if existing.display.is_none() {
      existing.display = build_relationship_display_snapshot(&fencer_id).await?;
    }
    let result = existing.clone();
    DB.users.patch_document_safe(&user, &updated_user).await?;
    invalidate_user_cache(user_id).await;
    return Ok(result);
  }

  let relationship = FencerRelationship {
    fencer_id: fencer_id.clone(),
    following: true,
    notify: true,
    competition_history: Vec::new(),
    display: build_relationship_display_snapshot(&fencer_id).await?,
  };
  updated_user
    .fields
    .fencer_relationships
    .push(relationship.clone());

  DB.users.patch_document_safe(&user, &updated_user).await?;
  invalidate_user_cache(user_id).await;
  Ok(relationship)
}

pub async fn unfollow_fencer(user_id: &str, fencer_id: &ViewTypedId<FencerId>) -> Result<()> {
  let user = get_user(user_id)
    .await?
    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("User not found: {}", user_id))?;
  let mut updated_user = user.clone();

  let idx = updated_user
    .fields
    .fencer_relationships
    .iter()
    .position(|relationship| same_fencer_id(&relationship.fencer_id, fencer_id))
    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("Fencer relationship not found: {}", fencer_id))?;

  if updated_user.fields.fencer_relationships[idx]
    .competition_history
    .is_empty()
  {
    updated_user.fields.fencer_relationships.remove(idx);
  } else {
    updated_user.fields.fencer_relationships[idx].following = false;
  }

  DB.users.patch_document_safe(&user, &updated_user).await?;
  invalidate_user_cache(user_id).await;
  Ok(())
}

pub async fn set_fencer_relationship_notify(
  user_id: &str,
  fencer_id: &ViewTypedId<FencerId>,
  notify: bool,
) -> Result<FencerRelationship> {
  let user = get_user(user_id)
    .await?
    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("User not found: {}", user_id))?;
  let mut updated_user = user.clone();

  let relationship =
    relationship_for_fencer_mut(&mut updated_user.fields.fencer_relationships, fencer_id)
      .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("Fencer relationship not found: {}", fencer_id))?;

  if !relationship.following {
    return Err(anyhow!(
      "Cannot update notify setting for unfollowed fencer: {}",
      fencer_id
    ));
  }

  relationship.notify = notify;
  let result = relationship.clone();

  DB.users.patch_document_safe(&user, &updated_user).await?;
  invalidate_user_cache(user_id).await;
  Ok(result)
}

pub async fn patch_user(id: &str, patch: &Patch) -> Result<User> {
  let original = get_user(id).await?;
  if let Some(original) = original {
    let tracked_fencer_patch_lockdown_enabled = load_tracked_fencer_patch_lockdown_enabled().await;
    validate_user_patch_paths(patch, tracked_fencer_patch_lockdown_enabled)?;

    // Apply the user's patch to the fields portion
    let mut fields_json = serde_json::to_value(&original.fields)?;
    json_patch::patch(&mut fields_json, patch)?;
    let updated_fields = serde_json::from_value(fields_json)?;

    let mut updated_user = original.clone();
    updated_user.fields = updated_fields;

    // Use patch_document_safe to handle Cosmos DB quirks with empty arrays
    // and missing parent paths (e.g., preferences.events.weapons)
    let result = DB
      .users
      .patch_document_safe(&original, &updated_user)
      .await?;
    invalidate_user_cache(id).await;
    return Ok(result);
  }
  Err(anyhow!("Can't find user"))
}

async fn load_tracked_fencer_patch_lockdown_enabled() -> bool {
  match crate::flags::list_flags().await {
    Ok(statuses) => crate::flag!(statuses, USER_PATCH_TRACKED_FENCERS_LOCKDOWN_ENABLED),
    Err(error) => {
      warn!(
        error = %error,
        "Failed to load runtime flags; allowing trackedFencers patch operations"
      );
      false
    }
  }
}

fn validate_user_patch_paths(
  patch: &Patch,
  tracked_fencer_patch_lockdown_enabled: bool,
) -> Result<()> {
  // Security check: prevent users from modifying their own capabilities or groups.
  // These can only be modified through admin endpoints.
  for op in patch.0.iter() {
    let path = match op {
      json_patch::PatchOperation::Add(a) => &a.path,
      json_patch::PatchOperation::Remove(r) => &r.path,
      json_patch::PatchOperation::Replace(r) => &r.path,
      json_patch::PatchOperation::Move(m) => &m.path,
      json_patch::PatchOperation::Copy(c) => &c.path,
      json_patch::PatchOperation::Test(t) => &t.path,
    };

    let path_str = path.as_str();
    if path_str.contains("capabilities") {
      return Err(anyhow!("Users cannot modify their own capabilities"));
    }
    if path_str.contains("groups") {
      return Err(anyhow!("Users cannot modify their own groups"));
    }
    if tracked_fencer_patch_lockdown_enabled
      && (path_str == "/trackedFencers" || path_str.starts_with("/trackedFencers/"))
    {
      return Err(anyhow!(
        "Users cannot modify trackedFencers via generic patch endpoint"
      ));
    }
  }

  Ok(())
}

// ============================================================================
// Capability Config functions
// ============================================================================

/// Gets the capability configuration document, creating a default one if it doesn't exist.
pub async fn get_capability_config() -> Result<CapabilityConfigDoc> {
  let result = DB.config.get_document(CAPABILITY_CONFIG_ID).await?;

  if let Some(config) = result {
    Ok(config)
  } else {
    // Create default config
    let default_config = Identified {
      id: CAPABILITY_CONFIG_ID.to_string(),
      partition: Some("flunge".to_string()),
      fields: CapabilityConfigFields::default(),
    };
    DB.config.upsert_document(default_config.clone()).await?;
    Ok(default_config)
  }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
  use super::*;

  fn parse_patch(json: &str) -> Patch {
    serde_json::from_str(json).unwrap()
  }

  #[test]
  fn validate_user_patch_paths_rejects_capabilities_changes() {
    let patch = parse_patch(r#"[{"op":"replace","path":"/capabilities","value":[]}]"#);
    let result = validate_user_patch_paths(&patch, false);
    assert!(result.is_err());
    assert!(
      result
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("cannot modify their own capabilities")
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn validate_user_patch_paths_rejects_groups_changes() {
    let patch = parse_patch(r#"[{"op":"add","path":"/groups/0","value":"beta"}]"#);
    let result = validate_user_patch_paths(&patch, false);
    assert!(result.is_err());
    assert!(
      result
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("cannot modify their own groups")
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn validate_user_patch_paths_rejects_tracked_fencer_changes_when_lockdown_enabled() {
    let patch =
      parse_patch(r#"[{"op":"add","path":"/trackedFencers/-","value":{"fencerId":"f.u.123"}}]"#);
    let result = validate_user_patch_paths(&patch, true);
    assert!(result.is_err());
    assert!(
      result
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("cannot modify trackedFencers")
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn validate_user_patch_paths_allows_tracked_fencer_changes_when_lockdown_disabled() {
    let patch =
      parse_patch(r#"[{"op":"add","path":"/trackedFencers/-","value":{"fencerId":"f.u.123"}}]"#);
    assert!(validate_user_patch_paths(&patch, false).is_ok());
  }

  #[test]
  fn validate_user_patch_paths_allows_other_profile_changes() {
    let patch = parse_patch(r#"[{"op":"replace","path":"/primaryUser/name","value":"Jane"}]"#);
    assert!(validate_user_patch_paths(&patch, true).is_ok());
  }

  #[test]
  fn initial_backfill_status_blocks_when_tab_results_missing() {
    let status = initial_backfill_status_for_capabilities(&[], Utc::now());
    assert_eq!(status.state, ResultsBackfillState::BlockedOnCapability);
    assert_eq!(status.requested_at, None);
  }

  #[test]
  fn initial_backfill_status_queues_when_tab_results_present() {
    let requested_at = Utc::now();
    let status =
      initial_backfill_status_for_capabilities(&[UserCapability::TabResults], requested_at);
    assert_eq!(status.state, ResultsBackfillState::Queued);
    assert_eq!(status.requested_at, Some(requested_at));
  }

  #[test]
  fn enqueue_blocked_backfills_transitions_only_blocked_entries() {
    let now = Utc::now();
    let preexisting_requested_at = now - chrono::Duration::minutes(10);
    let mut tracked = vec![
      TrackedFencer {
        fencer_id: ViewTypedId::<FencerId>::usaf("123"),
        results_backfill: ResultsBackfillStatus::blocked_on_capability(),
        british_fencing_licence: None,
      },
      TrackedFencer {
        fencer_id: ViewTypedId::<FencerId>::usaf("456"),
        results_backfill: ResultsBackfillStatus::queued(preexisting_requested_at),
        british_fencing_licence: None,
      },
    ];

    enqueue_blocked_backfills(&mut tracked, now);

    assert_eq!(
      tracked[0].results_backfill.state,
      ResultsBackfillState::Queued
    );
    assert_eq!(tracked[0].results_backfill.requested_at, Some(now));
    assert_eq!(
      tracked[1].results_backfill.state,
      ResultsBackfillState::Queued
    );
    assert_eq!(
      tracked[1].results_backfill.requested_at,
      Some(preexisting_requested_at)
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn same_fencer_id_matches_identical_view_ids() {
    let left = ViewTypedId::<FencerId>::usaf("12345");
    let right = ViewTypedId::<FencerId>::usaf("12345");
    assert!(same_fencer_id(&left, &right));
  }

  #[test]
  fn relationship_for_fencer_mut_finds_matching_entry() {
    let target = ViewTypedId::<FencerId>::usaf("999");
    let mut relationships = vec![
      FencerRelationship {
        fencer_id: ViewTypedId::<FencerId>::usaf("111"),
        following: true,
        notify: true,
        competition_history: Vec::new(),
        display: None,
      },
      FencerRelationship {
        fencer_id: target.clone(),
        following: false,
        notify: true,
        competition_history: Vec::new(),
        display: None,
      },
    ];

    let relationship = relationship_for_fencer_mut(&mut relationships, &target).unwrap();
    relationship.following = true;

    assert!(relationships[1].following);
  }
}

/// Updates the rollout configuration for a specific capability.
pub async fn set_capability_rollout(rollout: CapabilityRollout) -> Result<CapabilityConfigDoc> {
  let mut config = get_capability_config().await?;

  // Find and update existing, or add new
  let existing_idx = config
    .fields
    .capabilities
    .iter()
    .position(|c| c.capability == rollout.capability);

  match existing_idx {
    Some(idx) => config.fields.capabilities[idx] = rollout,
    None => config.fields.capabilities.push(rollout),
  }

  DB.config.upsert_document(config.clone()).await?;

  // Invalidate the capability config cache
  crate::v2::capabilities::invalidate_capability_config_cache().await;

  Ok(config)
}

// ============================================================================
// User Groups functions
// ============================================================================

/// Sets the groups for a user.
pub async fn set_user_groups(id: &str, groups: Vec<String>) -> Result<User> {
  let original = get_user(id).await?;
  if let Some(mut user) = original {
    let original_user = user.clone();
    user.fields.groups = groups;
    let result = DB.users.patch_document_safe(&original_user, &user).await?;
    invalidate_user_cache(id).await;
    return Ok(result);
  }
  Err(anyhow!("Can't find user"))
}

/// Gets a summary of all groups and user counts.
pub async fn get_groups_summary() -> Result<Vec<GroupSummary>> {
  let users = get_all_users().await?;
  let mut group_counts: std::collections::HashMap<String, usize> = std::collections::HashMap::new();

  for user in users {
    for group in user.fields.groups {
      *group_counts.entry(group).or_insert(0) += 1;
    }
  }

  let mut summaries: Vec<GroupSummary> = group_counts
    .into_iter()
    .map(|(name, user_count)| GroupSummary { name, user_count })
    .collect();

  summaries.sort_by(|a, b| a.name.cmp(&b.name));
  Ok(summaries)
}

/// Summary of a group including user count.
#[derive(serde::Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct GroupSummary {
  pub name: String,
  pub user_count: usize,
}

/// Sets or clears a user's family_group_id.
pub async fn set_user_family_group(
  user_id: &ViewTypedId<UserId>,
  group_id: Option<&ViewTypedId<FamilyGroupId>>,
) -> std::result::Result<(), UserError> {
  let user = DB
    .users
    .get_document(user_id.as_str())
    .await?
    .ok_or_else(|| UserError::NotFound(user_id.as_str().to_string()))?;

  let mut updated = user.clone();
  updated.fields.family_group_id = group_id.cloned();

  DB.users.patch_document(&user, &updated).await?;
  invalidate_user_cache(user_id.as_str()).await;

  Ok(())
}

// ============================================================================
// Connected Fencers functions
// ============================================================================

/// Gets all unique connected fencer USAF IDs across all users.
/// Returns a set of USAF IDs (extracted from view format `f.u.xxx`).
/// Fencers with non-USAF IDs (e.g., database IDs) are skipped.
pub async fn get_all_connected_fencer_ids() -> Result<std::collections::HashSet<u32>> {
  let users = get_all_users().await?;
  let mut fencer_ids = std::collections::HashSet::new();

  for user in users {
    for tracked in user.fields.tracked_fencers {
      if let Some(usaf_id) = tracked.fencer_id.usaf_id() {
        fencer_ids.insert(usaf_id);
      }
    }
  }

  Ok(fencer_ids)
}

/// Gets all distinct `(USAF id, British Fencing licence)` pairs asserted by
/// any household's tracked-fencer records, across every user. A licence is a
/// household's own private assertion (`TrackedFencer::british_fencing_licence`),
/// never a global fact -- see
/// docs/design-docs/british-fencing-rankings-as-a-standings-source.md,
/// "Where the membership id lives". Two households can assert *different*
/// licences for the same fencer; this enumeration keeps both pairs so the
/// standings-history capture task can detect that disagreement and refuse to
/// capture British standings for that fencer rather than guessing. Unlike
/// [`get_all_connected_fencer_ids`], which discards the licence, this keeps
/// it -- the two exist side by side because most callers of the former have
/// no use for a licence at all.
pub async fn get_all_connected_fencer_licences() -> Result<Vec<(u32, String)>> {
  let users = get_all_users().await?;
  let mut pairs = std::collections::HashSet::new();

  for user in users {
    for tracked in user.fields.tracked_fencers {
      if let (Some(usaf_id), Some(licence)) =
        (tracked.fencer_id.usaf_id(), tracked.british_fencing_licence)
      {
        pairs.insert((usaf_id, licence));
      }
    }
  }

  Ok(pairs.into_iter().collect())
}

/// Same walk as [`get_all_connected_fencer_ids`] and
/// [`get_all_connected_fencer_licences`] combined into a single
/// `get_all_users` scan, for callers (like standings-history capture) that
/// need both the id set and the licence pairs from the same run and would
/// otherwise pay for the full users-container scan twice.
pub async fn get_all_connected_fencer_ids_and_licences()
-> Result<(std::collections::HashSet<u32>, Vec<(u32, String)>)> {
  let users = get_all_users().await?;
  let mut fencer_ids = std::collections::HashSet::new();
  let mut pairs = std::collections::HashSet::new();

  for user in users {
    for tracked in user.fields.tracked_fencers {
      if let Some(usaf_id) = tracked.fencer_id.usaf_id() {
        fencer_ids.insert(usaf_id);
        if let Some(licence) = &tracked.british_fencing_licence {
          pairs.insert((usaf_id, licence.clone()));
        }
      }
    }
  }

  Ok((fencer_ids, pairs.into_iter().collect()))
}

/// Gets one user's own connected fencer USAF IDs (their household's tracked
/// fencers only). Unlike [`get_all_connected_fencer_ids`], which unions
/// every user in the database and exists solely for admin/background jobs
/// that intentionally operate over the whole population, this is the
/// household-scoped lookup for user-facing (authenticated) request handlers.
pub fn get_connected_fencer_ids_for_user(user: &User) -> std::collections::HashSet<u32> {
  user
    .fields
    .tracked_fencers
    .iter()
    .filter_map(|tracked| tracked.fencer_id.usaf_id())
    .collect()
}

pub async fn get_user(id: &str) -> Result<Option<User>> {
  DB.users.first_document_where(&eq!("c.id", id)).await
}

redis_cached! {
  name = "user_by_id",
  key = String,
  value = User,
  map_err = |e| anyhow::anyhow!("Cache error: {}", e),
  // Preserve the existing sliding TTL-on-read policy.
  refresh = true,
  /// Gets a user by ID, using Redis cache to avoid repeated DB lookups.
  /// The cache has a 30-minute TTL (configured via `user_by_id` in cache.ttl config).
  pub async fn get_user_cached(id: String) -> Result<User> {
    get_user(&id)
      .await?
      .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("User not found: {}", id))
  }

/// Invalidates all cached user data for a user given their User object.
/// This is the preferred method when you already have the user data.
///
/// This function directly deletes from Redis rather than going through the
/// OnceCell-based cache clients, ensuring invalidation works even if the
/// cached functions haven't been called yet on this server instance.
pub async fn invalidate_all_user_caches(user: &User) {
  let cache = RedisCache::get().await;

  // Invalidate by ID
  cache.invalidate_io_cached_key("user_by_id", &user.id).await;

  // Invalidate by clerk_id if present
  if let Some(clerk_id) = &user.fields.clerk_user_id {
    cache
      .invalidate_io_cached_key("user_by_clerk_id", clerk_id)
      .await;
  }

  // Invalidate by email
  cache
    .invalidate_io_cached_key("user_by_email", &user.fields.primary_user.email)
    .await;
}

/// Invalidates all cached user data for a user by ID.
/// This fetches the user first to get clerk_id and email for full invalidation.
pub async fn invalidate_user_cache(id: &str) {
  // First, try to get the user to find their clerk_id and email for cache invalidation
  // We fetch from DB directly to avoid using stale cached data
  if let Ok(Some(user)) = get_user(id).await {
    invalidate_all_user_caches(&user).await;
  } else {
    // At minimum, invalidate by ID even if we can't find the user
    let cache = RedisCache::get().await;
    cache.invalidate_io_cached_key("user_by_id", &id).await;
  }
}

  name = "user_by_clerk_id",
  key = String,
  value = Option<User>,

pub async fn get_all_users() -> Result<Vec<User>> {
  DB.users.list_documents().await
}

pub async fn set_user_capabilities(
  id: &str,
  capabilities: Vec<super::model::UserCapability>,
) -> Result<User> {
  let original = get_user(id).await?;
  if let Some(mut original) = original {
    let had_results_capability = has_results_capability(&original.fields.capabilities);
    let has_results_capability = has_results_capability(&capabilities);

    // Update the capabilities field
    original.fields.capabilities = capabilities;

    if !had_results_capability && has_results_capability {
      enqueue_blocked_backfills(&mut original.fields.tracked_fencers, Utc::now());
    }

    // Use upsert to replace the entire document - this avoids all the PATCH issues
    // with missing fields in legacy documents
    let result = DB.users.upsert_document(original).await?;
    invalidate_user_cache(id).await;
    return Ok(result);
  }
  Err(anyhow!("Can't find user"))
}

/// Adds a tracked fencer to the user's tracked_fencers list.
/// Returns error if the fencer is already being tracked.
/// The fencer_id should be a ViewTypedId - either f.u.{usaf_id} for USAF IDs or f.d.{db_id} for database IDs.
pub async fn add_tracked_fencer(user_id: &str, fencer_id: ViewTypedId<FencerId>) -> Result<()> {
  let user = get_user(user_id)
    .await?
    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("User not found: {}", user_id))?;

  // Check if already tracking this fencer (compare raw ID part)
  if user
    .fields
    .tracked_fencers
    .iter()
    .any(|tf| tf.fencer_id.as_str() == fencer_id.as_str())
  {
    return Err(anyhow!("Already tracking fencer: {}", fencer_id.as_str()));
  }

  let mut updated_user = user.clone();
  let results_backfill =
    initial_backfill_status_for_capabilities(&user.fields.capabilities, Utc::now());
  updated_user.fields.tracked_fencers.push(TrackedFencer {
    fencer_id,
    results_backfill,
    british_fencing_licence: None,
  });

  DB.users.patch_document(&user, &updated_user).await?;
  invalidate_user_cache(user_id).await;
  Ok(())
}

fn has_results_capability(capabilities: &[UserCapability]) -> bool {
  capabilities.contains(&UserCapability::TabResults)
}

fn initial_backfill_status_for_capabilities(
  capabilities: &[UserCapability],
  requested_at: chrono::DateTime<Utc>,
) -> ResultsBackfillStatus {
  if has_results_capability(capabilities) {
    ResultsBackfillStatus::queued(requested_at)
  } else {
    ResultsBackfillStatus::blocked_on_capability()
  }
}

fn enqueue_blocked_backfills(
  tracked_fencers: &mut [TrackedFencer],
  requested_at: chrono::DateTime<Utc>,
) {
  for tracked in tracked_fencers.iter_mut() {
    if tracked.results_backfill.state == ResultsBackfillState::BlockedOnCapability {
      tracked.results_backfill = ResultsBackfillStatus::queued(requested_at);
    }
  }
}

/// Removes a tracked fencer from the user's tracked_fencers list.
/// The fencer_id should be in view format: "f.u.12345"
pub async fn remove_tracked_fencer(user_id: &str, fencer_id: &str) -> Result<()> {
  let user = get_user(user_id)
    .await?
    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("User not found: {}", user_id))?;

  let original_len = user.fields.tracked_fencers.len();
  let mut updated_user = user.clone();

  updated_user
    .fields
    .tracked_fencers
    .retain(|tf| tf.fencer_id.to_view_string() != fencer_id);

  if updated_user.fields.tracked_fencers.len() == original_len {
    return Err(anyhow!("Fencer not being tracked: {}", fencer_id));
  }

  DB.users.patch_document(&user, &updated_user).await?;
  invalidate_user_cache(user_id).await;
  Ok(())
}

/// Sets or clears the shared British Fencing membership id (their "Licence")
/// for a fencer this user tracks. Last write wins; the value is a property
/// of the fencer, visible to every user who tracks them. `licence: None`
/// clears it.
/// Returns `Ok(false)` (rather than an error) if `fencer_id` is not one of
/// the user's tracked fencers, so callers can distinguish "not tracked" (a
/// 404) from a genuine database failure (a 500) instead of matching on an
/// `anyhow` error message.
pub async fn set_tracked_fencer_british_fencing_licence(
  user_id: &str,
  fencer_id: &str,
  licence: Option<String>,
) -> Result<bool> {
  let user = get_user(user_id)
    .await?
    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("User not found: {}", user_id))?;

  if !user
    .fields
    .tracked_fencers
    .iter()
    .any(|tf| tf.fencer_id.to_view_string() == fencer_id)
  {
    return Ok(false);
  }

  let typed_fencer_id = ViewTypedId::<FencerId>::from_str(fencer_id)
    .map_err(|e| anyhow!("Invalid fencer id {fencer_id}: {e}"))?;
  crate::fencer_licence::set_licence(
    &typed_fencer_id,
    licence,
    &ViewTypedId::<UserId>::database(user_id),
  )
  .await?;
  Ok(true)
}

fn same_fencer_id(left: &ViewTypedId<FencerId>, right: &ViewTypedId<FencerId>) -> bool {
  left.to_view_string() == right.to_view_string()
}

fn relationship_for_fencer_mut<'a>(
  relationships: &'a mut [FencerRelationship],
  fencer_id: &ViewTypedId<FencerId>,
) -> Option<&'a mut FencerRelationship> {
  relationships
    .iter_mut()
    .find(|relationship| same_fencer_id(&relationship.fencer_id, fencer_id))
}

fn first_rating_classification(fencer: &Fencer) -> Option<String> {
  let ratings = fencer.fields.current_ratings.as_ref()?;
  ratings
    .foil
    .as_ref()
    .or(ratings.epee.as_ref())
    .or(ratings.sabre.as_ref())
    .map(|rating| rating.classification.clone())
}

async fn lookup_fencer_for_relationship(
  fencer_id: &ViewTypedId<FencerId>,
) -> Result<Option<Fencer>> {
  match fencer_id.system() {
    System::Usaf => {
      let mut matches = DB
        .fencers
        .list_documents_where(&eq!("c.idDetail.usafId", fencer_id.as_str()))
        .await?;
      Ok(matches.pop())
    }
    System::Database => DB.fencers.get_document(fencer_id.as_str()).await,
    unsupported => {
      warn!(
        fencer_id = %fencer_id,
        ?unsupported,
        "Skipping relationship display lookup for unsupported fencer system"
      );
      Ok(None)
    }
  }
}

async fn build_relationship_display_snapshot(
  fencer_id: &ViewTypedId<FencerId>,
) -> Result<Option<FencerRelationshipDisplay>> {
  let fencer = lookup_fencer_for_relationship(fencer_id).await?;
  Ok(fencer.map(|fencer| FencerRelationshipDisplay {
    name: fencer.fields.name.clone(),
    club: fencer.fields.current_club_name.clone(),
    country: fencer.fields.country.clone(),
    rating: first_rating_classification(&fencer),
  }))
}

pub async fn follow_fencer(
  user_id: &str,
  fencer_id: ViewTypedId<FencerId>,
) -> Result<FencerRelationship> {
  let user = get_user(user_id)
    .await?
    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("User not found: {}", user_id))?;
  let mut updated_user = user.clone();

  if let Some(existing) =
    relationship_for_fencer_mut(&mut updated_user.fields.fencer_relationships, &fencer_id)
  {
    existing.following = true;
    if existing.display.is_none() {
      existing.display = build_relationship_display_snapshot(&fencer_id).await?;
    }
    let result = existing.clone();
    DB.users.patch_document_safe(&user, &updated_user).await?;
    invalidate_user_cache(user_id).await;
    return Ok(result);
  }

  let relationship = FencerRelationship {
    fencer_id: fencer_id.clone(),
    following: true,
    notify: true,
    competition_history: Vec::new(),
    display: build_relationship_display_snapshot(&fencer_id).await?,
  };
  updated_user
    .fields
    .fencer_relationships
    .push(relationship.clone());

  DB.users.patch_document_safe(&user, &updated_user).await?;
  invalidate_user_cache(user_id).await;
  Ok(relationship)
}

pub async fn unfollow_fencer(user_id: &str, fencer_id: &ViewTypedId<FencerId>) -> Result<()> {
  let user = get_user(user_id)
    .await?
    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("User not found: {}", user_id))?;
  let mut updated_user = user.clone();

  let idx = updated_user
    .fields
    .fencer_relationships
    .iter()
    .position(|relationship| same_fencer_id(&relationship.fencer_id, fencer_id))
    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("Fencer relationship not found: {}", fencer_id))?;

  if updated_user.fields.fencer_relationships[idx]
    .competition_history
    .is_empty()
  {
    updated_user.fields.fencer_relationships.remove(idx);
  } else {
    updated_user.fields.fencer_relationships[idx].following = false;
  }

  DB.users.patch_document_safe(&user, &updated_user).await?;
  invalidate_user_cache(user_id).await;
  Ok(())
}

pub async fn set_fencer_relationship_notify(
  user_id: &str,
  fencer_id: &ViewTypedId<FencerId>,
  notify: bool,
) -> Result<FencerRelationship> {
  let user = get_user(user_id)
    .await?
    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("User not found: {}", user_id))?;
  let mut updated_user = user.clone();

  let relationship =
    relationship_for_fencer_mut(&mut updated_user.fields.fencer_relationships, fencer_id)
      .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("Fencer relationship not found: {}", fencer_id))?;

  if !relationship.following {
    return Err(anyhow!(
      "Cannot update notify setting for unfollowed fencer: {}",
      fencer_id
    ));
  }

  relationship.notify = notify;
  let result = relationship.clone();

  DB.users.patch_document_safe(&user, &updated_user).await?;
  invalidate_user_cache(user_id).await;
  Ok(result)
}

pub async fn patch_user(id: &str, patch: &Patch) -> Result<User> {
  let original = get_user(id).await?;
  if let Some(original) = original {
    let tracked_fencer_patch_lockdown_enabled = load_tracked_fencer_patch_lockdown_enabled().await;
    validate_user_patch_paths(patch, tracked_fencer_patch_lockdown_enabled)?;

    // Apply the user's patch to the fields portion
    let mut fields_json = serde_json::to_value(&original.fields)?;
    json_patch::patch(&mut fields_json, patch)?;
    let updated_fields = serde_json::from_value(fields_json)?;

    let mut updated_user = original.clone();
    updated_user.fields = updated_fields;

    // Use patch_document_safe to handle Cosmos DB quirks with empty arrays
    // and missing parent paths (e.g., preferences.events.weapons)
    let result = DB
      .users
      .patch_document_safe(&original, &updated_user)
      .await?;
    invalidate_user_cache(id).await;
    return Ok(result);
  }
  Err(anyhow!("Can't find user"))
}

async fn load_tracked_fencer_patch_lockdown_enabled() -> bool {
  match crate::flags::list_flags().await {
    Ok(statuses) => crate::flag!(statuses, USER_PATCH_TRACKED_FENCERS_LOCKDOWN_ENABLED),
    Err(error) => {
      warn!(
        error = %error,
        "Failed to load runtime flags; allowing trackedFencers patch operations"
      );
      false
    }
  }
}

fn validate_user_patch_paths(
  patch: &Patch,
  tracked_fencer_patch_lockdown_enabled: bool,
) -> Result<()> {
  // Security check: prevent users from modifying their own capabilities or groups.
  // These can only be modified through admin endpoints.
  for op in patch.0.iter() {
    let path = match op {
      json_patch::PatchOperation::Add(a) => &a.path,
      json_patch::PatchOperation::Remove(r) => &r.path,
      json_patch::PatchOperation::Replace(r) => &r.path,
      json_patch::PatchOperation::Move(m) => &m.path,
      json_patch::PatchOperation::Copy(c) => &c.path,
      json_patch::PatchOperation::Test(t) => &t.path,
    };

    let path_str = path.as_str();
    if path_str.contains("capabilities") {
      return Err(anyhow!("Users cannot modify their own capabilities"));
    }
    if path_str.contains("groups") {
      return Err(anyhow!("Users cannot modify their own groups"));
    }
    if tracked_fencer_patch_lockdown_enabled
      && (path_str == "/trackedFencers" || path_str.starts_with("/trackedFencers/"))
    {
      return Err(anyhow!(
        "Users cannot modify trackedFencers via generic patch endpoint"
      ));
    }
    // britishFencingLicence is a vestigial field, retired in favour of the shared
    // fencer_british_licences collection: it is unconditionally rejected here
    // (independent of the lockdown flag above) so the generic patch endpoint can
    // never re-introduce a per-user value that a later migration run would adopt
    // as the shared licence.
    if path_str.contains("britishFencingLicence") {
      return Err(anyhow!(
        "Users cannot set britishFencingLicence via generic patch endpoint"
      ));
    }
  }

  Ok(())
}

// ============================================================================
// Capability Config functions
// ============================================================================

/// Gets the capability configuration document, creating a default one if it doesn't exist.
pub async fn get_capability_config() -> Result<CapabilityConfigDoc> {
  let result = DB.config.get_document(CAPABILITY_CONFIG_ID).await?;

  if let Some(config) = result {
    Ok(config)
  } else {
    // Create default config
    let default_config = Identified {
      id: CAPABILITY_CONFIG_ID.to_string(),
      partition: Some("flunge".to_string()),
      fields: CapabilityConfigFields::default(),
    };
    DB.config.upsert_document(default_config.clone()).await?;
    Ok(default_config)
  }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
  use super::*;

  fn parse_patch(json: &str) -> Patch {
    serde_json::from_str(json).unwrap()
  }

  #[test]
  fn validate_user_patch_paths_rejects_capabilities_changes() {
    let patch = parse_patch(r#"[{"op":"replace","path":"/capabilities","value":[]}]"#);
    let result = validate_user_patch_paths(&patch, false);
    assert!(result.is_err());
    assert!(
      result
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("cannot modify their own capabilities")
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn validate_user_patch_paths_rejects_groups_changes() {
    let patch = parse_patch(r#"[{"op":"add","path":"/groups/0","value":"beta"}]"#);
    let result = validate_user_patch_paths(&patch, false);
    assert!(result.is_err());
    assert!(
      result
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("cannot modify their own groups")
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn validate_user_patch_paths_rejects_tracked_fencer_changes_when_lockdown_enabled() {
    let patch =
      parse_patch(r#"[{"op":"add","path":"/trackedFencers/-","value":{"fencerId":"f.u.123"}}]"#);
    let result = validate_user_patch_paths(&patch, true);
    assert!(result.is_err());
    assert!(
      result
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("cannot modify trackedFencers")
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn validate_user_patch_paths_allows_tracked_fencer_changes_when_lockdown_disabled() {
    let patch =
      parse_patch(r#"[{"op":"add","path":"/trackedFencers/-","value":{"fencerId":"f.u.123"}}]"#);
    assert!(validate_user_patch_paths(&patch, false).is_ok());
  }

  #[test]
  fn validate_user_patch_paths_rejects_british_fencing_licence_changes_regardless_of_lockdown() {
    let patch = parse_patch(
      r#"[{"op":"replace","path":"/trackedFencers/0/britishFencingLicence","value":"142013"}]"#,
    );
    let result = validate_user_patch_paths(&patch, false);
    assert!(result.is_err());
    assert!(
      result
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("cannot set britishFencingLicence")
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn validate_user_patch_paths_allows_other_profile_changes() {
    let patch = parse_patch(r#"[{"op":"replace","path":"/primaryUser/name","value":"Jane"}]"#);
    assert!(validate_user_patch_paths(&patch, true).is_ok());
  }

  #[test]
  fn initial_backfill_status_blocks_when_tab_results_missing() {
    let status = initial_backfill_status_for_capabilities(&[], Utc::now());
    assert_eq!(status.state, ResultsBackfillState::BlockedOnCapability);
    assert_eq!(status.requested_at, None);
  }

  #[test]
  fn initial_backfill_status_queues_when_tab_results_present() {
    let requested_at = Utc::now();
    let status =
      initial_backfill_status_for_capabilities(&[UserCapability::TabResults], requested_at);
    assert_eq!(status.state, ResultsBackfillState::Queued);
    assert_eq!(status.requested_at, Some(requested_at));
  }

  #[test]
  fn enqueue_blocked_backfills_transitions_only_blocked_entries() {
    let now = Utc::now();
    let preexisting_requested_at = now - chrono::Duration::minutes(10);
    let mut tracked = vec![
      TrackedFencer {
        fencer_id: ViewTypedId::<FencerId>::usaf("123"),
        results_backfill: ResultsBackfillStatus::blocked_on_capability(),
        british_fencing_licence: None,
      },
      TrackedFencer {
        fencer_id: ViewTypedId::<FencerId>::usaf("456"),
        results_backfill: ResultsBackfillStatus::queued(preexisting_requested_at),
        british_fencing_licence: None,
      },
    ];

    enqueue_blocked_backfills(&mut tracked, now);

    assert_eq!(

      ResultsBackfillState::Queued
    );
    assert_eq!(tracked[0].results_backfill.requested_at, Some(now));
    assert_eq!(

      ResultsBackfillState::Queued
    );
    assert_eq!(
      tracked[1].results_backfill.requested_at,
      Some(preexisting_requested_at)
    );
  }

  #[test]
  fn same_fencer_id_matches_identical_view_ids() {
    let left = ViewTypedId::<FencerId>::usaf("12345");
    let right = ViewTypedId::<FencerId>::usaf("12345");
    assert!(same_fencer_id(&left, &right));
  }

        competition_history: Vec::new(),
        display: None,
      },

    relationship.following = true;

    assert!(relationships[1].following);
  }
