function AdminTasksPage() {
  const clerkAuth = useAuth();
  const [taskActions, setTaskActions] = useState<
    Record<
      string,
      | { status: "starting"; forceListRefresh: boolean; overrideCooldown: boolean }
      | { status: "running"; forceListRefresh: boolean; overrideCooldown: boolean }
      | { status: "error"; message: string }
    >
  >({});
  const tasks = useQuery(
    "admin_tasks",
    async () => {
      const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
      return getAdminTasks(token);
    },
    {
      refetchInterval: 1000,
    },
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tasks.data === undefined) {
      return;
    }

    setTaskActions((actions) => {
      const completedTaskIds = Object.keys(actions).filter((id) => {
        const action = actions[id];
        if (action.status !== "running") {
          return false;
        }

        return !tasks.data.some(
          (task) =>
            (task.short_name === id ||
              (action.overrideCooldown && task.short_name === UNIFIED_CATALOG_OVERRIDE_TASK)) &&
            task.running === true,
        );
      });
      if (completedTaskIds.length === 0) {
        return actions;
      }

      const nextActions = { ...actions };
      completedTaskIds.forEach((id) => delete nextActions[id]);
      return nextActions;
    });
  }, [tasks.data]);

  if (tasks.data === undefined) {
    return <div>Loading...</div>;
  }

  const runNow = async (
    id: string,
    options?: { forceListRefresh?: boolean; overrideCooldown?: boolean },
  ) => {
    const forceListRefresh = options?.forceListRefresh === true;
    const overrideCooldown = options?.overrideCooldown === true;
    setTaskActions((actions) => ({
      ...actions,
      [id]: { status: "starting", forceListRefresh, overrideCooldown },
    }));
    try {
      const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
      await startAdminTask(id, options, token);
      const refreshedTasks = await tasks.refetch();
      const taskIsRunning = refreshedTasks.data?.some(
        (task) =>
          (task.short_name === id ||
            (overrideCooldown && task.short_name === UNIFIED_CATALOG_OVERRIDE_TASK)) &&
          task.running === true,
      );
      setTaskActions((actions) => {
        const action = actions[id];
        if (action === undefined || action.status !== "starting") {
          return actions;
        }

        if (!taskIsRunning) {
          const nextActions = { ...actions };
          delete nextActions[id];
          return nextActions;
        }

        return {
          ...actions,
          [id]: { status: "running", forceListRefresh, overrideCooldown },
        };
      });
    } catch (error) {
      setTaskActions((actions) => ({
        ...actions,
        [id]: {
          status: "error",
          message: error instanceof globalThis.Error ? error.message : "Unable to start task.",
        },
      }));
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack direction="column" spacing={1}>
        <FencingTrackerStatusCard />
        <UnifiedRankingsStatusCard />
        <StandingsHistoryStatusCard />
        <Card>
          <Typography level="title-md">Background tasks</Typography>
          {tasks.data
            .filter((t) => t.short_name !== UNIFIED_CATALOG_OVERRIDE_TASK)
            .map((t) => {
              const taskAction = taskActions[t.short_name];
              const taskActionIsPending =
                taskAction?.status === "starting" || taskAction?.status === "running";
              const runNowIsRunning =
                taskActionIsPending && !taskAction.forceListRefresh && !taskAction.overrideCooldown;
              const refreshListIsRunning = taskActionIsPending && taskAction.forceListRefresh;
              const overrideIsRunning = taskActionIsPending && taskAction.overrideCooldown;

              return (
                <Accordion key={t.short_name} defaultExpanded={true}>
                  <AccordionSummary>
                    <Stack direction="row" spacing={1}>
                      <Typography level="title-sm">{t.description}</Typography>
                    </Stack>
                  </AccordionSummary>
                  <AccordionDetails>
                    <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} alignItems="center">
                      <Button
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          runNow(t.short_name);
                        }}
                        variant="plain"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={t.running === true || taskActionIsPending}
                        startDecorator={
                          runNowIsRunning ? <CircularProgress size="sm" /> : <PlayArrow />
                        }
                      >
                        Run Now
                      </Button>
                      {FORCE_LIST_REFRESH_TASKS.has(t.short_name) && (
                        <Button
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            runNow(t.short_name, { forceListRefresh: true });
                          }}
                          variant="outlined"
                          size="sm"
                          disabled={t.running === true || taskActionIsPending}
                          startDecorator={
                            refreshListIsRunning ? <CircularProgress size="sm" /> : undefined
                          }
                        >
                          Run + Refresh List
                        </Button>
                      )}
                      {t.short_name === UNIFIED_CATALOG_REFRESH_TASK && (
                        <Button
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            runNow(t.short_name, { overrideCooldown: true });
                          }}
                          variant="outlined"
                          color="warning"
                          size="sm"
                          disabled={t.running === true || taskActionIsPending}
                          startDecorator={
                            overrideIsRunning ? <CircularProgress size="sm" /> : undefined
                          }
                        >
                          Run Now (Override Cooldown)
                        </Button>
                      )}
                    </Stack>
                    {taskAction?.status === "error" && (
                      <Typography level="body-sm" color="danger">
                        Failed to start task: {taskAction.message}
                      </Typography>
                    )}
                    {t.running === true &&
                      t.running_since !== null &&
                      t.running_since !== undefined && (
                        <Typography level="body-sm">
                          Running for: {elapsedTimeFromStart(t.running_since)}
                        </Typography>
                      )}
                    {t.next_time !== null && (
                      <Typography level="body-sm">Next run: {formatDate(t.next_time)}</Typography>
                    )}
                    <Divider />
                    {t.history.length > 0 && (
                      <FlexiTable columns={[{}, {}, {}]}>
                        {t.history.flatMap((h) => [
                          <Typography key={h.started}>{formatDate(h.started)}</Typography>,
                          <Typography key={h.ended}>
                            {elapsedTimeSeconds(h.started, h.ended)}s
                          </Typography>,
                          <Typography key={h.success.toString()}>
                            {h.success === true && (
                              <Stack direction="row" alignItems="center">
                                <CheckCircle color="success" />
                                &nbsp;
                                <Typography color="success">Ran successfully</Typography>
                              </Stack>
                            )}
                            {h.success === false && (
                              <Stack direction="row" alignItems="center">
                                <Error color="error" />
                                &nbsp;
                                <Typography color="danger">Failed: {h.error_message}</Typography>
                              </Stack>
                            )}
                          </Typography>,
                        ])}
                      </FlexiTable>
                    )}
                  </AccordionDetails>
                </Accordion>
              );
            })}
        </Card>
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}

function AdminCachePage() {
  const clerkAuth = useAuth();
  const summaryQuery = useQuery<RedisCacheSummary, Error>(
    ["admin_cache_summary"],
    async () => {
      const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
      return getAdminCacheSummary(token);
    },
    { refetchOnWindowFocus: false },
  );

  const keys = summaryQuery.data?.keys ?? [];
  const errorMessage = summaryQuery.error ? summaryQuery.error.message : null;

  const flushCache = async () => {
    const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
    await flushAdminCache(token);
    summaryQuery.refetch();
  };

  return (
    <Stack spacing={2}>
      <Stack direction="row" alignItems="center" justifyContent="space-between">
        <Typography level="title-md">Redis Cache</Typography>
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1}>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="outlined"
            onClick={() => summaryQuery.refetch()}
            disabled={summaryQuery.isFetching}
          >
            Refresh
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm" color="danger" onClick={flushCache}>
            Clear Cache
          </Button>
        </Stack>
      </Stack>

      {errorMessage && (
        <ErrorStateCard
          title="Couldn't load cache"
          message={errorMessage}
          onRetry={() => summaryQuery.refetch()}
        />
      )}

      {summaryQuery.isLoading || summaryQuery.isFetching ? <LinearProgress /> : null}

      {!summaryQuery.isLoading && keys.length === 0 && !summaryQuery.error ? (
        <Typography level="body-sm">No keys found in Redis.</Typography>
      ) : null}

      {keys.map((summary) => (
        <CacheKeyAccordion key={summary.name} summary={summary} />
      ))}
    </Stack>
  );
}

function CacheKeyAccordion({ summary }: { summary: RedisCacheKeySummary }) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const clerkAuth = useAuth();
  const keyQuery = useQuery<RedisCacheKeyDetail, Error>(
    ["admin_cache_key", summary.name],
    async () => {
      const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
      return getAdminCacheKey(summary.name, token);
    },
    { enabled: expanded, refetchOnWindowFocus: false },
  );

  const kind = keyQuery.data?.kind ?? summary.kind;
  const length = keyQuery.data?.length ?? summary.length;
  const lengthLabel = formatLength(kind, length);
  const entries = keyQuery.data?.entries ?? [];

  return (
    <Accordion expanded={expanded} onChange={(_, value) => setExpanded(value)}>
      <AccordionSummary>
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} alignItems="center">
          <Typography level="title-sm">{summary.name}</Typography>
          <Chip size="sm" variant="soft" color="neutral">
            {kind}
          </Chip>
          {lengthLabel && (
            <Chip size="sm" variant="soft" color="primary">
              {lengthLabel}
            </Chip>
          )}
        </Stack>
      </AccordionSummary>
      <AccordionDetails>
        <Stack spacing={1.5}>
          {expanded && keyQuery.isFetching ? <LinearProgress /> : null}

          {expanded && keyQuery.error ? (
            <Typography level="body-sm" color="danger">
              Failed to load key: {keyQuery.error.message}
            </Typography>
          ) : null}

          {expanded && !keyQuery.isLoading && !keyQuery.error ? (
            entries.length === 0 ? (
              <Typography level="body-sm">No entries.</Typography>
            ) : (
              <Stack spacing={1}>
                {entries.map((entry, idx) => (
                  <CacheEntryCard key={entry.field ?? `${summary.name}-${idx}`} entry={entry} />
                ))}
              </Stack>
            )
          ) : null}

          {expanded && !keyQuery.isLoading ? (
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="outlined"
              onClick={() => keyQuery.refetch()}
              disabled={keyQuery.isFetching}
              sx={{ alignSelf: "flex-start" }}
            >
              Refresh key
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </Stack>
      </AccordionDetails>
    </Accordion>
  );
}

function CacheEntryCard({ entry }: { entry: RedisCacheEntry }) {
  const body =
    entry.json !== null ? (JSON.stringify(entry.json, null, 2) ?? entry.preview) : entry.preview;

  return (
    <Card variant="outlined" sx={{ p: 1 }}>
      {entry.field && (
        <Typography level="body-sm" sx={{ fontFamily: "var(--joy-fontFamily-code, monospace)" }}>
          {entry.field}
        </Typography>
      )}
      <Typography
        level="body-xs"
        component="pre"
        sx={{
          fontFamily: "var(--joy-fontFamily-code, monospace)",
          whiteSpace: "pre-wrap",
          overflowX: "auto",
          m: 0,
        }}
      >
        {body}
      </Typography>
    </Card>
  );
}

function formatLength(kind: string, length: number | null) {
  if (length === null) {
    return null;
  }

  if (kind === "string") {
    return `${length} ${length === 1 ? "byte" : "bytes"}`;
  }

  return `${length} ${length === 1 ? "entry" : "entries"}`;
}

function AdminCachesPage() {
  const clerkAuth = useAuth();
  const cachesQuery = useQuery<CacheSummaryEntry[], Error>(
    ["admin_caches"],
    async () => {
      const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
      return getAdminCaches(token);
    },
    { refetchOnWindowFocus: false },
  );

  const caches = cachesQuery.data ?? [];

  return (
    <Stack spacing={2}>
      <Stack direction="row" alignItems="center" justifyContent="space-between">
        <Typography level="title-md">Named Caches</Typography>
        <Button
          size="sm"
          variant="outlined"
          onClick={() => cachesQuery.refetch()}
          disabled={cachesQuery.isFetching}
        >
          Refresh
        </Button>
      </Stack>
      <Typography level="body-sm">
        Invalidate stale entries by cache name and key (e.g. a fencer&apos;s USA Fencing id) once
        you know a fix has landed but existing entries haven&apos;t expired yet. This only clears
        entries — reads still go through the same cache lookup and re-fetch on a miss, they are
        never bypassed.
      </Typography>

      {cachesQuery.error && (
        <ErrorStateCard
          title="Couldn't load caches"
          message={cachesQuery.error.message}
          onRetry={() => cachesQuery.refetch()}
        />
      )}
      {cachesQuery.isLoading ? <LinearProgress /> : null}

      {caches.map((cache) => (
        <CacheRegistryCard
          key={cache.name}
          cache={cache}
          onInvalidated={() => cachesQuery.refetch()}
          onRefreshCounts={async () => {
            await cachesQuery.refetch();
          }}
        />
      ))}
    </Stack>
  );
}

function CacheRegistryCard({
  cache,
  onInvalidated,
  onRefreshCounts,
}: {
  cache: CacheSummaryEntry;
  onInvalidated: () => void;
  onRefreshCounts: () => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const clerkAuth = useAuth();
  const [key, setKey] = useState("");
  const [entry, setEntry] = useState<CacheEntryDetail | null>(null);
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(false);
  const [checkError, setCheckError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [invalidating, setInvalidating] = useState(false);
  const [invalidateError, setInvalidateError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [lastResult, setLastResult] = useState<InvalidateCacheResult | null>(null);
  const [confirmingAll, setConfirmingAll] = useState(false);
  const [refreshingCount, setRefreshingCount] = useState(false);

  const startConfirmingAll = async () => {
    setRefreshingCount(true);
    try {
      await onRefreshCounts();
    } finally {
      setRefreshingCount(false);
    }
    setConfirmingAll(true);
  };

  const checkEntry = async () => {
    const trimmed = key.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return;
    setChecking(true);
    setCheckError(null);
    try {
      const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
      setEntry(await getAdminCacheEntry(cache.name, trimmed, token));
    } catch (e) {
      setCheckError((e as Error).message);
      setEntry(null);
    } finally {
      setChecking(false);
    }
  };

  const invalidateKey = async () => {
    const trimmed = key.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return;
    setInvalidating(true);
    setInvalidateError(null);
    try {
      const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
      const result = await invalidateAdminCache(cache.name, { key: trimmed }, token);
      setLastResult(result);
      setEntry(null);
      onInvalidated();
    } catch (e) {
      setInvalidateError((e as Error).message);
    } finally {
      setInvalidating(false);
    }
  };

  const invalidateAll = async () => {
    setInvalidating(true);
    setInvalidateError(null);
    try {
      const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
      const result = await invalidateAdminCache(cache.name, { confirmed: true }, token);
      setLastResult(result);
      setConfirmingAll(false);
      onInvalidated();
    } catch (e) {
      setInvalidateError((e as Error).message);
    } finally {
      setInvalidating(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card variant="outlined">
      <Stack spacing={1.5}>
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} alignItems="center" flexWrap="wrap">
          <Typography level="title-sm" sx={{ fontFamily: "var(--joy-fontFamily-code, monospace)" }}>
            {cache.name}
          </Typography>
          <Chip size="sm" variant="soft" color="neutral">
            TTL {formatTtl(cache.ttlSeconds)}
          </Chip>
          <Chip size="sm" variant="soft" color={cache.refresh ? "warning" : "success"}>
            {cache.refresh ? "sliding refresh" : "fixed TTL"}
          </Chip>
          <Chip size="sm" variant="soft" color="primary">
            {cache.entryCount} {cache.entryCount === 1 ? "entry" : "entries"}
          </Chip>
        </Stack>
        <Typography level="body-sm">{cache.description}</Typography>

        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} alignItems="center" flexWrap="wrap">
          <input
            type="text"
            value={key}
            onChange={(e) => setKey(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Key (e.g. a USA Fencing id)"
            style={{
              padding: "4px 8px",
              fontSize: "13px",
              flex: "1 1 220px",
              maxWidth: 260,
              border: "1px solid #ccc",
              borderRadius: 4,
            }}
          />
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="outlined"
            onClick={checkEntry}
            disabled={!key.trim() || checking}
          >
            {checking ? "Checking..." : "Check entry"}
          </Button>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            color="danger"
            variant="soft"
            onClick={invalidateKey}
            disabled={!key.trim() || invalidating}
          >
            Invalidate key
          </Button>
        </Stack>

        {checkError && (
          <Typography level="body-xs" color="danger">
            {checkError}
          </Typography>
        )}
        {entry && (
          <Card variant="soft" sx={{ p: 1 }}>
            {!entry.found ? (
              <Typography level="body-sm">No cached entry for this key.</Typography>
            ) : (
              <Stack spacing={0.5}>
                <Typography level="body-sm" color={entry.decodeError ? "danger" : undefined}>
                  {entry.decodeError
                    ? "Did not decode (likely a poisoned/stale value from a schema change) — showing the raw stored value:"
                    : `Age: ${entry.ageSeconds !== null ? formatAge(entry.ageSeconds) : "unknown"}`}
                </Typography>
                <Typography
                  level="body-xs"
                  component="pre"
                  sx={{
                    fontFamily: "var(--joy-fontFamily-code, monospace)",
                    whiteSpace: "pre-wrap",
                    overflowX: "auto",
                    m: 0,
                  }}
                >
                  {entry.decodeError ? String(entry.value) : JSON.stringify(entry.value, null, 2)}
                </Typography>
              </Stack>
            )}
          </Card>
        )}

        {invalidateError && (
          <Typography level="body-xs" color="danger">
            {invalidateError}
          </Typography>
        )}
        {lastResult && (
          <Chip size="sm" variant="soft" color="success">
            Invalidated {lastResult.entriesInvalidated}{" "}
            {lastResult.entriesInvalidated === 1 ? "entry" : "entries"} ({lastResult.scope})
          </Chip>
        )}

        <Divider />

        {!confirmingAll ? (
          <Button
            size="sm"
            color="danger"
            variant="outlined"
            onClick={startConfirmingAll}
            disabled={refreshingCount}
            sx={{ alignSelf: "flex-start" }}
          >
            {refreshingCount
              ? "Refreshing count..."
              : `Invalidate entire cache (${cache.entryCount})`}
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <Card color="danger" variant="soft">
            <Stack spacing={1}>
              <Typography level="body-sm">
                This drops all {cache.entryCount} cached{" "}
                {cache.entryCount === 1 ? "entry" : "entries"} for <code>{cache.name}</code> at
                once. Every one of those reads will then miss and re-fetch, bursting load against
                this cache&apos;s source — a rate-limited third party (FencingTracker, USA Fencing)
                or the primary datastore — invalidate a single key instead when you only need to fix
                one entry. Staging and production share this cache, so this also wipes both
                environments&apos; warm entries.
              </Typography>
              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1}>
                <Button size="sm" color="danger" onClick={invalidateAll} disabled={invalidating}>
                  {invalidating ? "Invalidating..." : `Yes, invalidate all ${cache.entryCount}`}
                </Button>
                <Button size="sm" variant="plain" onClick={() => setConfirmingAll(false)}>
                  Cancel
                </Button>
              </Stack>
            </Stack>
          </Card>
        )}
      </Stack>
    </Card>
  );
}

function formatTtl(seconds: number) {
  if (seconds % 86400 === 0) return `${seconds / 86400}d`;
  if (seconds % 3600 === 0) return `${seconds / 3600}h`;
  if (seconds % 60 === 0) return `${seconds / 60}m`;
  return `${seconds}s`;
}

function formatAge(seconds: number) {
  if (seconds < 60) return `${seconds}s`;
  if (seconds < 3600) return `${Math.round(seconds / 60)}m`;
  if (seconds < 86400) return `${Math.round(seconds / 3600)}h`;
  return `${Math.round(seconds / 86400)}d`;
}

function elapsedTimeSeconds(start: string, end: string) {
  return Math.round((new Date(end).getTime() - new Date(start).getTime()) / 1000);
}

function elapsedTimeFromStart(start: string) {
  const diffMs = Date.now() - new Date(start).getTime();
  const totalSeconds = Math.max(Math.floor(diffMs / 1000), 0);
  const hours = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
  const minutes = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
  const seconds = totalSeconds % 60;

  if (hours > 0) {
    return `${hours}h ${minutes}m ${seconds}s`;
  }
  if (minutes > 0) {
    return `${minutes}m ${seconds}s`;
  }
  return `${seconds}s`;
}

function formatDate(date: string) {
  const d = new Date(date);
  return d.toLocaleString();
}

function UserCapabilitiesEditor({ user, onUpdate }: { user: User; onUpdate: () => void }) {
  const clerkAuth = useAuth();
  const availableCapabilities = UserCapabilities.filter((c) => !user.capabilities.includes(c));

  const removeCapability = async (capability: UserCapability) => {
    const newCapabilities = user.capabilities.filter((c) => c !== capability);
    const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
    await setUserCapabilities(user.id, newCapabilities, token);
    onUpdate();
  };

  const addCapability = async (capability: UserCapability) => {
    const newCapabilities = [...user.capabilities, capability];
    const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
    await setUserCapabilities(user.id, newCapabilities, token);
    onUpdate();
  };

  return (
    <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} flexWrap="wrap" alignItems="center">
      {user.capabilities.map((capability) => (
        <Chip
          key={capability}
          size="sm"
          variant="soft"
          endDecorator={<ChipDelete onDelete={() => removeCapability(capability)} />}
        >
          {capability}
        </Chip>
      ))}
      {availableCapabilities.length > 0 && (
        <Dropdown>
          <MenuButton
            slots={{ root: IconButton }}
            slotProps={{ root: { size: "sm", variant: "outlined" } }}
          >
            <Add fontSize="small" />
          </MenuButton>
          <Menu size="sm">
            {availableCapabilities.map((capability) => (
              <MenuItem key={capability} onClick={() => addCapability(capability)}>
                {capability}
              </MenuItem>
            ))}
          </Menu>
        </Dropdown>
      )}
      {user.capabilities.length === 0 &&
        availableCapabilities.length === UserCapabilities.length && (
          <Typography level="body-xs" sx={{ fontStyle: "italic", mr: 0.5 }}>
            None
          </Typography>
        )}
    </Stack>
  );
}

function UserGroupsEditor({ user, onUpdate }: { user: User; onUpdate: () => void }) {
  const clerkAuth = useAuth();
  const [isAdding, setIsAdding] = useState(false);
  const [newGroup, setNewGroup] = useState("");

  const removeGroup = async (group: string) => {
    const newGroups = user.groups.filter((g) => g !== group);
    const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
    await setUserGroups(user.id, newGroups, token);
    onUpdate();
  };

  const addGroup = async () => {
    if (!newGroup.trim()) return;
    const newGroups = [...user.groups, newGroup.trim()];
    const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
    await setUserGroups(user.id, newGroups, token);
    setNewGroup("");
    setIsAdding(false);
    onUpdate();
  };

  return (
    <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} flexWrap="wrap" alignItems="center">
      {user.groups.map((group) => (
        <Chip
          key={group}
          size="sm"
          variant="soft"
          color="primary"
          endDecorator={<ChipDelete onDelete={() => removeGroup(group)} />}
        >
          {group}
        </Chip>
      ))}
      {!isAdding ? (
        <IconButton size="sm" variant="outlined" onClick={() => setIsAdding(true)}>
          <Add fontSize="small" />
        </IconButton>
      ) : (
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} alignItems="center">
          <input
            type="text"
            value={newGroup}
            onChange={(e) => setNewGroup(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === "Enter") addGroup();
              if (e.key === "Escape") {
                setIsAdding(false);
                setNewGroup("");
              }
            }}
            placeholder="Group"
            style={{
              padding: "4px 8px",
              fontSize: "12px",
              width: "70px",
              border: "1px solid #ccc",
              borderRadius: "4px",
            }}
            autoFocus
          />
          <IconButton size="sm" variant="soft" color="success" onClick={addGroup}>
            ✓
          </IconButton>
          <IconButton
            size="sm"
            variant="plain"
            onClick={() => {
              setIsAdding(false);
              setNewGroup("");
            }}
          >
            ×
          </IconButton>
        </Stack>
      )}
      {user.groups.length === 0 && !isAdding && (
        <Typography level="body-xs" sx={{ fontStyle: "italic", mr: 0.5 }}>
          None
        </Typography>
      )}
    </Stack>
  );
}

function AdminGroupsPage() {
  const clerkAuth = useAuth();
  const [newGroupName, setNewGroupName] = useState("");
  const [isAddingGroup, setIsAddingGroup] = useState(false);

  const usersQuery = useQuery(
    ["admin_users"],
    async () => {
      const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
      return getAdminUsers(token);
    },
    { refetchOnWindowFocus: false },
  );

  if (usersQuery.isLoading) {
    return (
      <Stack spacing={2}>
        <Typography level="title-md">Groups</Typography>
        <LinearProgress />
      </Stack>
    );
  }

  if (usersQuery.error) {
    return (
      <Stack spacing={2}>
        <Typography level="title-md">Groups</Typography>
        <ErrorStateCard
          title="Couldn't load groups"
          message={(usersQuery.error as Error).message}
          onRetry={() => usersQuery.refetch()}
        />
      </Stack>
    );
  }

  const users = usersQuery.data || [];

  // Build a map of group name -> users in that group
  const groupsMap = new Map<string, User[]>();
  for (const user of users) {
    for (const group of user.groups) {
      if (!groupsMap.has(group)) {
        groupsMap.set(group, []);
      }
      groupsMap.get(group)!.push(user);
    }
  }

  // Sort groups alphabetically
  const groupNames = Array.from(groupsMap.keys()).sort();

  // Users not in any group (for adding to new groups)
  const getUsersNotInGroup = (groupName: string) =>
    users.filter((u) => !u.groups.includes(groupName));

  const addUserToGroup = async (userId: string, groupName: string) => {
    const user = users.find((u) => u.id === userId);
    if (!user) return;
    const newGroups = [...user.groups, groupName];
    const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
    await setUserGroups(userId, newGroups, token);
    usersQuery.refetch();
  };

  const removeUserFromGroup = async (userId: string, groupName: string) => {
    const user = users.find((u) => u.id === userId);
    if (!user) return;
    const newGroups = user.groups.filter((g) => g !== groupName);
    const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
    await setUserGroups(userId, newGroups, token);
    usersQuery.refetch();
  };

  const createGroup = () => {
    if (!newGroupName.trim()) return;
    // Group is created implicitly when we add the first user
    // For now, just add it to the UI - it will show as empty
    setNewGroupName("");
    setIsAddingGroup(false);
  };

  return (
    <Stack spacing={2}>
      <Stack direction="row" alignItems="center" justifyContent="space-between">
        <Typography level="title-md">Groups</Typography>
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1}>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="outlined"
            onClick={() => usersQuery.refetch()}
            disabled={usersQuery.isFetching}
          >
            Refresh
          </Button>
        </Stack>
      </Stack>

      {groupNames.length === 0 && !isAddingGroup ? (
        <Card>
          <Stack spacing={2}>
            <Typography level="body-sm">No groups found. Create a group to get started.</Typography>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="soft"
              startDecorator={<Add />}
              onClick={() => setIsAddingGroup(true)}
              sx={{ alignSelf: "flex-start" }}
            >
              Create Group
            </Button>
          </Stack>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <>
          {groupNames.map((groupName) => (
            <GroupAccordion
              key={groupName}
              groupName={groupName}
              usersInGroup={groupsMap.get(groupName) || []}
              usersNotInGroup={getUsersNotInGroup(groupName)}
              onAddUser={(userId) => addUserToGroup(userId, groupName)}
              onRemoveUser={(userId) => removeUserFromGroup(userId, groupName)}
            />
          ))}

          {isAddingGroup ? (
            <Card variant="outlined">
              <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} alignItems="center">
                <Typography level="body-sm">New group name:</Typography>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newGroupName}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewGroupName(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === "Enter" && newGroupName.trim()) {
                      // Add group by showing it in accordion (empty)
                      groupsMap.set(newGroupName.trim(), []);
                      setNewGroupName("");
                      setIsAddingGroup(false);
                      // Force re-render
                      usersQuery.refetch();
                    }
                    if (e.key === "Escape") {
                      setIsAddingGroup(false);
                      setNewGroupName("");
                    }
                  }}
                  placeholder="Group name"
                  style={{
                    padding: "4px 8px",
                    fontSize: "14px",
                    width: "150px",
                    border: "1px solid #ccc",
                    borderRadius: "4px",
                  }}
                  autoFocus
                />
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="soft"
                  color="success"
                  disabled={!newGroupName.trim()}
                  onClick={createGroup}
                >
                  Create
                </Button>
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="plain"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setIsAddingGroup(false);
                    setNewGroupName("");
                  }}
                >
                  Cancel
                </Button>
              </Stack>
            </Card>
          ) : (
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="soft"
              startDecorator={<Add />}
              onClick={() => setIsAddingGroup(true)}
              sx={{ alignSelf: "flex-start" }}
            >
              Create Group
            </Button>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </Stack>
  );
}

function GroupAccordion({
  groupName,
  usersInGroup,
  usersNotInGroup,
  onAddUser,
  onRemoveUser,
}: {
  groupName: string;
  usersInGroup: User[];
  usersNotInGroup: User[];
  onAddUser: (userId: string) => void;
  onRemoveUser: (userId: string) => void;
}) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);

  return (
    <Accordion expanded={expanded} onChange={(_, value) => setExpanded(value)}>
      <AccordionSummary>
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} alignItems="center">
          <Chip size="sm" variant="soft" color="primary">
            {groupName}
          </Chip>
          <Typography level="body-sm">
            {usersInGroup.length} {usersInGroup.length === 1 ? "user" : "users"}
          </Typography>
        </Stack>
      </AccordionSummary>
      <AccordionDetails>
        <Stack spacing={1}>
          {usersInGroup.length === 0 ? (
            <Typography level="body-sm" sx={{ fontStyle: "italic" }}>
              No users in this group
            </Typography>
          ) : (
            <Stack spacing={0.5}>
              {usersInGroup.map((user) => (
                <Stack key={user.id} direction="row" spacing={1} alignItems="center">
                  <Chip
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outlined"
                    endDecorator={<ChipDelete onDelete={() => onRemoveUser(user.id)} />}
                  >
                    {user.primaryUser.name || user.primaryUser.email}
                  </Chip>
                </Stack>
              ))}
            </Stack>
          )}

          {usersNotInGroup.length > 0 && (
            <Dropdown>
              <MenuButton size="sm" variant="soft" startDecorator={<Add fontSize="small" />}>
                Add User
              </MenuButton>
              <Menu size="sm" sx={{ maxHeight: "300px", overflow: "auto" }}>
                {usersNotInGroup.map((user) => (
                  <MenuItem key={user.id} onClick={() => onAddUser(user.id)}>
                    {user.primaryUser.name || user.primaryUser.email}
                  </MenuItem>
                ))}
              </Menu>
            </Dropdown>
          )}
        </Stack>
      </AccordionDetails>
    </Accordion>
  );
}

function AdminCapabilitiesPage() {
  const clerkAuth = useAuth();
  const configQuery = useQuery(
    ["admin_capability_config"],
    async () => {
      const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
      return getCapabilityConfig(token);
    },
    { refetchOnWindowFocus: false },
  );

  const groupsQuery = useQuery(
    ["admin_groups"],
    async () => {
      const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
      return getAdminGroups(token);
    },
    { refetchOnWindowFocus: false },
  );

  if (configQuery.isLoading) {
    return (
      <Stack spacing={2}>
        <Typography level="title-md">Capability Configuration</Typography>
        <LinearProgress />
      </Stack>
    );
  }

  if (configQuery.error) {
    return (
      <Stack spacing={2}>
        <Typography level="title-md">Capability Configuration</Typography>
        <ErrorStateCard
          title="Couldn't load capability configuration"
          message={(configQuery.error as Error).message}
          onRetry={() => configQuery.refetch()}
        />
      </Stack>
    );
  }

  const rollouts = configQuery.data?.capabilities || [];
  const availableGroups = groupsQuery.data?.map((g) => g.name) || [];

  const allCapabilities = [...UserCapabilities];

  return (
    <Stack spacing={2}>
      <Stack direction="row" alignItems="center" justifyContent="space-between">
        <Typography level="title-md">Capability Configuration</Typography>
        <Button
          size="sm"
          variant="outlined"
          onClick={() => configQuery.refetch()}
          disabled={configQuery.isFetching}
        >
          Refresh
        </Button>
      </Stack>
      <Typography level="body-sm">
        Configure how capabilities are rolled out to users. Explicit user capabilities always take
        priority over rollout configuration.
      </Typography>
      {allCapabilities.map((capability) => {
        const rollout = rollouts.find((r) => r.capability === capability);
        return (
          <CapabilityRolloutEditor
            key={capability}
            capability={capability}
            rollout={rollout}
            availableGroups={availableGroups}
            onUpdate={() => configQuery.refetch()}
          />
        );
      })}
    </Stack>
  );
}

function CapabilityRolloutEditor({
  capability,
  rollout,
  availableGroups,
  onUpdate,
}: {
  capability: UserCapability;
  rollout?: CapabilityRollout;
  availableGroups: string[];
  onUpdate: () => void;
}) {
  const clerkAuth = useAuth();
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [percentage, setPercentage] = useState(rollout?.rolloutPercentage ?? 0);
  const [enabledForAll, setEnabledForAll] = useState(rollout?.enabledForAll ?? false);
  const [enabledGroups, setEnabledGroups] = useState<string[]>(rollout?.enabledGroups ?? []);
  const [disabledGroups, setDisabledGroups] = useState<string[]>(rollout?.disabledGroups ?? []);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saveSuccess, setSaveSuccess] = useState(false);

  // Administrator and Developer cannot have rollout percentage or enabled_for_all
  const isPrivileged = capability === "Administrator" || capability === "Developer";

  const hasChanges =
    percentage !== (rollout?.rolloutPercentage ?? 0) ||
    enabledForAll !== (rollout?.enabledForAll ?? false) ||
    JSON.stringify(enabledGroups) !== JSON.stringify(rollout?.enabledGroups ?? []) ||
    JSON.stringify(disabledGroups) !== JSON.stringify(rollout?.disabledGroups ?? []);

  const save = async () => {
    setIsSaving(true);
    setSaveSuccess(false);
    try {
      const token = await clerkAuth.getToken();
      await setCapabilityRollout(
        capability,
        {
          rolloutPercentage: percentage,
          enabledForAll,
          enabledGroups,
          disabledGroups,
        },
        token,
      );
      onUpdate();
      setSaveSuccess(true);
      setTimeout(() => setSaveSuccess(false), 2000);
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const resetChanges = () => {
    setPercentage(rollout?.rolloutPercentage ?? 0);
    setEnabledForAll(rollout?.enabledForAll ?? false);
    setEnabledGroups(rollout?.enabledGroups ?? []);
    setDisabledGroups(rollout?.disabledGroups ?? []);
  };

  const getStatusLabel = () => {
    if (enabledForAll) return "Enabled for all";
    if (percentage === 100) return "100% rollout";
    if (percentage > 0) return `${percentage}% rollout`;
    if (enabledGroups.length > 0) return `Groups: ${enabledGroups.join(", ")}`;
    return "Not configured";
  };

  return (
    <Accordion expanded={expanded} onChange={(_, value) => setExpanded(value)}>
      <AccordionSummary>
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} alignItems="center" sx={{ width: "100%" }}>
          <Typography level="title-sm" sx={{ flex: 1 }}>
            {capability}
          </Typography>
          <Chip
            size="sm"
            variant="soft"
            color={
              enabledForAll || percentage === 100
                ? "success"
                : percentage > 0 || enabledGroups.length > 0
                  ? "warning"
                  : "neutral"
            }
          >
            {getStatusLabel()}
          </Chip>
        </Stack>
      </AccordionSummary>
      <AccordionDetails>
        <Stack spacing={2}>
          {isPrivileged && (
            <Typography level="body-xs" sx={{ fontStyle: "italic" }}>
              This capability can only be assigned to specific users or groups.
            </Typography>
          )}

          {!isPrivileged && (
            <>
              <Stack direction="row" alignItems="center" spacing={2}>
                <Typography level="body-sm" sx={{ minWidth: "120px" }}>
                  Enabled for all:
                </Typography>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={enabledForAll}
                  onChange={(e) => setEnabledForAll(e.target.checked)}
                />
              </Stack>

              <Stack direction="row" alignItems="center" spacing={2}>
                <Typography level="body-sm" sx={{ minWidth: "120px" }}>
                  Rollout percentage:
                </Typography>
                <input
                  type="range"
                  min="0"
                  max="100"
                  value={percentage}
                  onChange={(e) => setPercentage(parseInt(e.target.value))}
                  style={{ flex: 1 }}
                />
                <Typography level="body-sm" sx={{ minWidth: "40px" }}>
                  {percentage}%
                </Typography>
              </Stack>
            </>
          )}

          <Stack direction="row" alignItems="flex-start" spacing={2}>
            <Typography level="body-sm" sx={{ minWidth: "120px" }}>
              Enabled groups:
            </Typography>
            <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} flexWrap="wrap" alignItems="center">
              {enabledGroups.length === 0 && (
                <Typography level="body-xs" sx={{ fontStyle: "italic", mr: 0.5 }}>
                  None
                </Typography>
              )}
              {enabledGroups.map((group) => (
                <Chip
                  key={group}
                  size="sm"
                  variant="soft"
                  color="success"
                  endDecorator={
                    <ChipDelete
                      onDelete={() => setEnabledGroups(enabledGroups.filter((g) => g !== group))}
                    />
                  }
                >
                  {group}
                </Chip>
              ))}
              {availableGroups.filter(
                (g) => !enabledGroups.includes(g) && !disabledGroups.includes(g),
              ).length > 0 && (
                <Dropdown>
                  <MenuButton
                    slots={{ root: IconButton }}
                    slotProps={{ root: { size: "sm", variant: "outlined" } }}
                  >
                    <Add fontSize="small" />
                  </MenuButton>
                  <Menu size="sm">
                    {availableGroups
                      .filter((g) => !enabledGroups.includes(g) && !disabledGroups.includes(g))
                      .map((group) => (
                        <MenuItem
                          key={group}
                          onClick={() => setEnabledGroups([...enabledGroups, group])}
                        >
                          {group}
                        </MenuItem>
                      ))}
                  </Menu>
                </Dropdown>
              )}
            </Stack>
          </Stack>

          <Stack direction="row" alignItems="flex-start" spacing={2}>
            <Typography level="body-sm" sx={{ minWidth: "120px" }}>
              Disabled groups:
            </Typography>
            <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} flexWrap="wrap" alignItems="center">
              {disabledGroups.length === 0 && (
                <Typography level="body-xs" sx={{ fontStyle: "italic", mr: 0.5 }}>
                  None
                </Typography>
              )}
              {disabledGroups.map((group) => (
                <Chip
                  key={group}
                  size="sm"
                  variant="soft"
                  color="danger"
                  endDecorator={
                    <ChipDelete
                      onDelete={() => setDisabledGroups(disabledGroups.filter((g) => g !== group))}
                    />
                  }
                >
                  {group}
                </Chip>
              ))}
              {availableGroups.filter(
                (g) => !enabledGroups.includes(g) && !disabledGroups.includes(g),
              ).length > 0 && (
                <Dropdown>
                  <MenuButton
                    slots={{ root: IconButton }}
                    slotProps={{ root: { size: "sm", variant: "outlined" } }}
                  >
                    <Add fontSize="small" />
                  </MenuButton>
                  <Menu size="sm">
                    {availableGroups
                      .filter((g) => !enabledGroups.includes(g) && !disabledGroups.includes(g))
                      .map((group) => (
                        <MenuItem
                          key={group}
                          onClick={() => setDisabledGroups([...disabledGroups, group])}
                        >
                          {group}
                        </MenuItem>
                      ))}
                  </Menu>
                </Dropdown>
              )}
            </Stack>
          </Stack>

          {(hasChanges || saveSuccess) && (
            <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} alignItems="center">
              {saveSuccess ? (
                <Chip size="sm" variant="soft" color="success" startDecorator={<CheckCircle />}>
                  Saved
                </Chip>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Button size="sm" variant="solid" onClick={save} disabled={isSaving}>
                    {isSaving ? "Saving..." : "Save Changes"}
                  </Button>
                  <Button size="sm" variant="outlined" onClick={resetChanges} disabled={isSaving}>
                    Reset
                  </Button>
                </>
              )}
            </Stack>
          )}
        </Stack>
      </AccordionDetails>
    </Accordion>
  );
}

export function getEventDescription(e: Event) {
  let title = "";
  if (typeof e.classifier === "string") {
    title = e.classifier;
  } else {
    switch (e.classifier.category) {
      case "y8":
        title += "Y-8 ";
        break;
      case "y10":
        title += "Y-10 ";
        break;
      case "y12":
        title += "Y-12 ";
        break;
      case "y14":
        title += "Y-14 ";
        break;
      case "junior":
        title += "Junior ";
        break;
      case "cadet":
        title += "Cadet ";
        break;
      case "veteran":
        title += "Veteran ";
        break;
      case "division1":
        title += "Division I ";
        break;
      case "division1A":
        title += "Division IA ";
        break;
      case "division2":
        title += "Division II ";
        break;
      case "division3":
        title += "Division III ";
        break;
      default:
        title += e.classifier.category;
    }
    switch (e.classifier.gender) {
      case "mens":
        title += "Men's ";
        break;
      case "womens":
        title += "Women's ";
        break;
      case "mixed":
        title += "Mixed ";
        break;
    }
    switch (e.classifier.weapon) {
      case "sabre":
        title += "Sabre";
        break;
      case "foil":
        title += "Foil";
        break;
      case "epee":
        title += "Épée";
        break;
    }
  }
  return title;

export function getWins(trackedId: string, fencer: Fencer | FencerWithMatchStats) {
  if (fencer.matchStats !== undefined && fencer.matchStats !== null) {
    for (const s of fencer.matchStats.wins) {
      if (s[0] === trackedId) {
        return s[1] as number;
      }
    }
  }
  return 0;
}

export function getLosses(trackedId: string, fencer: Fencer | FencerWithMatchStats) {
  if (fencer.matchStats !== undefined && fencer.matchStats !== null) {
    for (const s of fencer.matchStats.losses) {
      if (s[0] === trackedId) {
        return s[1] as number;
      }
    }
  }
  return 0;
}

export function getFencerRating(fencer: Fencer | FencerWithMatchStats, weapon: Weapon) {
  if ("currentRatings" in fencer) {
    if (fencer.currentRatings != null) {
      let rating: Rating | null | undefined;
      switch (weapon) {
        case "epee":
          rating = fencer.currentRatings.epee;
          break;
        case "foil":
          rating = fencer.currentRatings.foil;
          break;
        case "sabre":
          rating = fencer.currentRatings.sabre;
          break;
      }

      const classification = rating?.classification;
      if (classification === undefined) {
        return null;
      }
      return classification;
    }
  }
  // TODO(@backend,2026-03-01): handle non-database fencers with rating metadata
  return null;
}

export interface EventPreferences {
  weapons: Weapon[];
  categories: EventCategory[];
  genders: Gender[];
  usaRegions: number[];
  /** Explicit event type codes (e.g., "Y14MS", "CDTWS"). When non-empty, takes precedence over legacy fields. */
  eventTypes?: string[];
}

interface UserPreferences {
  events: EventPreferences;
}

export function getClassifiersFromPreferences(preferences: EventPreferences | null | undefined) {
  const classifiers = [];
  if (preferences) {
    // If eventTypes is non-empty, use it as the source of truth
    if (preferences.eventTypes && preferences.eventTypes.length > 0) {
      for (const code of preferences.eventTypes) {
        const parsed = parseEventTypeCode(code);
        if (parsed) {
          classifiers.push({
            category: parsed.category,
            weapon: parsed.weapon,
            gender: parsed.gender,
            team: false,
          });
        }
      }
      return classifiers;
    }

    // Fall back to legacy Cartesian product behavior
    for (const category of preferences.categories) {
      for (const weapon of preferences.weapons) {
        for (const gender of preferences.genders) {
          classifiers.push({
            category,
            weapon,
            gender,
            team: false,
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return classifiers;
}

const weapons = ["sabre", "foil", "epee"] as const;
export type Weapon = (typeof weapons)[number];
export const Weapons = weapons;

const eventCategories = [
  "y8",
  "y10",
  "y12",
  "y14",
  "cadet",
  "junior",
  "senior",
  "adult",
  "veteran",
  "division1",
  "division1A",
  "division2",
  "division3",
] as const;
export type EventCategory = (typeof eventCategories)[number];
export const EventCategories = eventCategories;

const genders = ["mens", "womens", "mixed"] as const;
export type Gender = (typeof genders)[number];
export const Genders = genders;

const EventCategoryCodes: { [key: string]: EventCategory } = {
  Y8: "y8",
  Y10: "y10",
  Y12: "y12",
  Y14: "y14",
  CDT: "cadet",
  JNR: "junior",
  SNR: "senior",
  ADT: "adult",
  VET: "veteran",
  D1A: "division1A",
  DV1: "division1",
  DV2: "division2",
  DV3: "division3",
};

const GenderCodes: { [key: string]: Gender } = {
  M: "mens",
  W: "womens",
  X: "mixed",
};

const WeaponCodes: { [key: string]: Weapon } = {
  S: "sabre",
  F: "foil",
  E: "epee",
};
// Reverse mappings
const EventCategoryCodesReverse = Object.fromEntries(
  Object.entries(EventCategoryCodes).map(([code, category]) => [category, code]),
);

const GenderCodesReverse = Object.fromEntries(
  Object.entries(GenderCodes).map(([code, gender]) => [gender, code]),
);

const WeaponCodesReverse = Object.fromEntries(
  Object.entries(WeaponCodes).map(([code, weapon]) => [weapon, code]),
);

function parseEventString(s: string): [EventCategory, Gender, Weapon, number | null] {
  // List of event category codes sorted by length (longest first)
  const EventCategoryCodesList = Object.keys(EventCategoryCodes).sort(
    (a, b) => b.length - a.length,
  );

  let eventCategory: EventCategory | undefined;

  // Find the event category code at the start of the string
  for (const code of EventCategoryCodesList) {
    if (s.startsWith(code)) {
      eventCategory = EventCategoryCodes[code];
      s = s.slice(code.length);
      break;
    }
  }

  if (!eventCategory) {
    throw new Error("Invalid Event Category Code");
  }

  // Parse gender code
  const genderCode = s.charAt(0);
  const gender = GenderCodes[genderCode];
  if (!gender) {
    throw new Error("Invalid Gender Code");
  }
  s = s.slice(1);

  // Parse weapon code
  const weaponCode = s.charAt(0);
  const weapon = WeaponCodes[weaponCode];
  if (!weapon) {
    throw new Error("Invalid Weapon Code");
  }
  s = s.slice(1);

  // Parse region number if present
  let region: number | null = null;
  if (s.startsWith("R")) {
    s = s.slice(1);
    const match = s.match(/^(\d+)/);
    if (match) {
      region = parseInt(match[1], 10);
      s = s.slice(match[1].length);
    } else {
      throw new Error("Invalid Region Number");
    }
  }

  // Check for any extra characters
  if (s.length > 0) {
    throw new Error("Extra characters at the end of the string");
  }

  return [eventCategory, gender, weapon, region];
}

function buildEventString(
  eventCategory: EventCategory,
  gender: Gender,
  weapon: Weapon,
  region: number | null,
): string {
  // Get the codes from the reverse mappings
  const eventCategoryCode = EventCategoryCodesReverse[eventCategory];
  if (!eventCategoryCode) {
    throw new Error("Invalid Event Category");
  }

  const genderCode = GenderCodesReverse[gender];
  if (!genderCode) {
    throw new Error("Invalid Gender");
  }

  const weaponCode = WeaponCodesReverse[weapon];
  if (!weaponCode) {
    throw new Error("Invalid Weapon");
  }

  // Build the event string
  let eventString = eventCategoryCode + genderCode + weaponCode;

  // Append region if present
  if (region !== null) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(region) || region <= 0) {
      throw new Error("Invalid Region Number");
    }
    eventString += "R" + region;
  }

  return eventString;
}

/** Parses an event type code like "Y14MS" into its components. Returns null if invalid. */
export function parseEventTypeCode(
  code: string,
): { category: EventCategory; gender: Gender; weapon: Weapon } | null {
  try {
    const [category, gender, weapon] = parseEventString(code);
    return { category, gender, weapon };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Builds an event type code from components (without region). */
function buildEventTypeCode(category: EventCategory, gender: Gender, weapon: Weapon): string {
  return buildEventString(category, gender, weapon, null);
}

/** Display names for categories */
const CategoryDisplayNames: Record<EventCategory, string> = {
  y8: "Y8",
  y10: "Y10",
  y12: "Y12",
  y14: "Y14",
  cadet: "Cadet",
  junior: "Junior",
  senior: "Senior",
  adult: "Adult",
  veteran: "Veteran",
  division1: "Division I",
  division1A: "Division IA",
  division2: "Division II",
  division3: "Division III",
};

/** Display names for genders */
const GenderDisplayNames: Record<Gender, string> = {
  mens: "Mens",
  womens: "Womens",
  mixed: "Mixed",
};

/** Display names for weapons */
const WeaponDisplayNames: Record<Weapon, string> = {
  sabre: "Sabre",
  foil: "Foil",
  epee: "Epee",
};

/** Gets a human-readable display name for an event type code. */
export function getEventTypeDisplayName(code: string): string {
  const parsed = parseEventTypeCode(code);
  if (!parsed) {
    return code;
  }
  const categoryName = CategoryDisplayNames[parsed.category];
  const genderName = GenderDisplayNames[parsed.gender];
  const weaponName = WeaponDisplayNames[parsed.weapon];
  return `${categoryName} ${genderName} ${weaponName}`;
}

/** All valid event type codes (108 combinations: 12 categories × 3 genders × 3 weapons). */
let _allEventTypeCodes: string[] | null = null;
export function getAllEventTypeCodes(): string[] {
  if (_allEventTypeCodes === null) {
    _allEventTypeCodes = [];
    for (const category of EventCategories) {
      for (const gender of Genders) {
        for (const weapon of Weapons) {
          _allEventTypeCodes.push(buildEventTypeCode(category, gender, weapon));
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return _allEventTypeCodes;
}

export interface EventTypeSearchResult {
  code: string;
  displayName: string;
  category: EventCategory;
  gender: Gender;
  weapon: Weapon;
}

/** Normalizes text for search by lowercasing and removing punctuation */
function normalizeForSearch(text: string): string {
  return text.toLowerCase().replace(/[''`]/g, "").trim();
}

/**
 * Searches event types by query string.
 * Matches against code (e.g., "Y14MS") and display name words (e.g., "mens sabre").
 * @param query Search query
 * @param excludeCodes Codes to exclude from results (already selected)
 * @param limit Maximum number of results
 */
export function searchEventTypes(
  query: string,
  excludeCodes: Set<string> = new Set(),
  limit = 20,
): EventTypeSearchResult[] {
  const normalizedQuery = normalizeForSearch(query);
  if (!normalizedQuery) {
    return [];
  }

  const queryTerms = normalizedQuery.split(/\s+/);
  const results: Array<EventTypeSearchResult & { score: number }> = [];

  for (const code of getAllEventTypeCodes()) {
    if (excludeCodes.has(code)) {
      continue;
    }

    const parsed = parseEventTypeCode(code);
    if (!parsed) {
      continue;
    }

    const displayName = getEventTypeDisplayName(code);
    const lowerCode = code.toLowerCase();
    const normalizedDisplayName = normalizeForSearch(displayName);

    // Calculate match score
    let score = 0;

    // Exact code match (highest priority)
    if (lowerCode === normalizedQuery) {
      score = 1000;
    }
    // Code starts with query
    else if (lowerCode.startsWith(normalizedQuery)) {
      score = 500;
    }
    // Code contains query
    else if (lowerCode.includes(normalizedQuery)) {
      score = 200;
    }
    // All query terms match display name words
    else {
      const displayWords = normalizedDisplayName.split(/\s+/);
      let allTermsMatch = true;
      let termMatchCount = 0;

      for (const term of queryTerms) {
        const termMatches = displayWords.some(
          (word) => word.startsWith(term) || word.includes(term),
        );
        if (termMatches) {
          termMatchCount++;
        } else {
          allTermsMatch = false;
        }
      }

      if (allTermsMatch && termMatchCount > 0) {
        score = 100 + termMatchCount * 10;
      }
    }

    if (score > 0) {
      results.push({
        code,
        displayName,
        category: parsed.category,
        gender: parsed.gender,
        weapon: parsed.weapon,
        score,
      });
    }
  }

  // Sort by score descending, then by code
  results.sort((a, b) => {
    if (b.score !== a.score) {
      return b.score - a.score;
    }
    return a.code.localeCompare(b.code);
  });

  return results.slice(0, limit).map(({ score: _score, ...rest }) => rest);
}

/// Gets the fencer for a participant, or returns null.
export function getFencerParticipant(participant: Participant | null) {
  // Historical name retained for compatibility with existing callers.
  if (participant?.individual != null) {
    if (typeof participant.individual.fencer !== "string") {
      return participant.individual.fencer as Fencer;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

export function isFencer(participant: Participant, fencerId: string) {
  return getFencerParticipant(participant)?.id === fencerId;
}

export interface Individual {
  fencer: string | Fencer;
  score: null | number;
  outcome: null | "win" | "lose" | "withdraw";
}

function getCategoryCode(category: EventCategory) {
  switch (category) {
    case "y8":
    case "y10":
    case "y12":
    case "y14":
      return category.toUpperCase();
    case "cadet":
      return "CDT";
    case "junior":
      return "JNR";
    case "senior":
      return "SNR";
    case "adult":
      return "ADT";
    case "veteran":
      return "VET";
    case "division1":
      return "DV1";
    case "division1A":
      return "D1A";
    case "division2":
      return "DV2";
    case "division3":
      return "DV3";
    default:
      return category;
  }
}

export function getEventCategoryCode(event: Event) {
  if (typeof event.classifier === "string") {
    return event.classifier as string;
  }
  return getCategoryCode((event.classifier as Classifier).category);
}

export function getCode(classifier: string | Classifier) {
  if (typeof classifier === "string") {
    return classifier;
  }
  const recognized = classifier as Classifier;
  let code = "";
  code += getCategoryCode(recognized.category);
  switch (recognized.gender) {
    case "mens":
      code += "M";
      break;
    case "womens":
      code += "W";
      break;
    case "mixed":
      code += "X";
      break;
  }

  switch (recognized.weapon) {
    case "epee":
      code += "E";
      break;
    case "foil":
      code += "F";
      break;
    case "sabre":
      code += "S";
      break;
  }

  return code;
}

export async function searchFencers(query: string, clerkToken?: string | null) {
  const rawResults = await get<
    (Omit<FencerSearchResult, "usafId"> & {
      usaf_id?: number;
      usafId?: number;
    })[]
  >(`/api/v2/fencingtracker/fencers?query=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`, clerkToken);

  return rawResults
    .map((result) => ({
      ...result,
      usafId: normalizeUsafId(result.usafId ?? result.usaf_id),
    }))
    .filter((result): result is FencerSearchResult => result.usafId !== null);
}

function normalizeUsafId(id: number | string | undefined | null) {
  if (id == null) {
    return null;
  }

  const numeric = typeof id === "string" ? Number.parseInt(id, 10) : id;
  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
}

/**
 * Progress of the incremental identity sweep, which resolves Unified ranking
 * rows to Flunge memberships against FencingTracker *outside* the publish
 * path. A successful catalog refresh no longer implies complete identity
 * resolution — that takes hours and publishing does not wait for it — so this
 * is the half of the status that answers "how complete is what we are
 * serving".
 */
export interface UnifiedIdentitySweepStatus {
  lastRunAt: string | null;
  lastRunStopReason: "passComplete" | "lookupBudget" | "timeBudget" | "egressPaused" | null;
  lastRunLookups: number;
  lastRunResolved: number;
  lastRunSeconds: number;
  /** Null until the sweep has resolved everything it can for the active catalog. */
  lastPassCompletedAt: string | null;
  catalogRows: number;
  resolvedRows: number;
  pendingRows: number;
  bindings: number;
}

  lastSuccessAt: string | null;
  lastSuccessSnapshotId: string | null;

  lastFailureReason: string | null;
  identitySweep: UnifiedIdentitySweepStatus;
}

export async function startAdminTask(
  id: string,
  options?: { forceListRefresh?: boolean; overrideCooldown?: boolean },
  clerkToken?: string | null,
) {
  const query = new URLSearchParams();
  if (options?.forceListRefresh) query.set("forceListRefresh", "true");
  if (options?.overrideCooldown) query.set("overrideCooldown", "true");
  const suffix = query.size === 0 ? "" : `?${query.toString()}`;
  const path = `/api/v2/admin/tasks/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/exec${suffix}`;

  return postJson<void>(path, "", clerkToken);
}

export function getClassifiersFromPreferences(preferences: EventPreferences | null | undefined) {
  const classifiers = [];
  if (preferences) {
    // If eventTypes is non-empty, use it as the source of truth
    if (preferences.eventTypes && preferences.eventTypes.length > 0) {
      for (const code of preferences.eventTypes) {
        const parsed = parseEventTypeCode(code);
        if (parsed) {
          classifiers.push({
            category: parsed.category,
            weapon: parsed.weapon,
            gender: parsed.gender,
            team: false,
          });
        }
      }
      return classifiers;
    }

    // Fall back to legacy Cartesian product behavior
    for (const category of preferences.categories) {
      for (const weapon of preferences.weapons) {
        for (const gender of preferences.genders) {
          classifiers.push({
            category,
            weapon,
            gender,
            team: false,
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return classifiers;

const eventCategories = [
  "y8",
  "y10",
  "y12",
  "y14",
  "cadet",
  "junior",
  "senior",
  "adult",
  "veteran",

] as const;
export type EventCategory = (typeof eventCategories)[number];
export const EventCategories = eventCategories;

const genders = ["mens", "womens", "mixed"] as const;
export type Gender = (typeof genders)[number];
export const Genders = genders;

const EventCategoryCodes: { [key: string]: EventCategory } = {
  Y8: "y8",
  Y10: "y10",
  Y12: "y12",
  Y14: "y14",
  CDT: "cadet",
  JNR: "junior",
  SNR: "senior",
  ADT: "adult",
  VET: "veteran",
  D1A: "division1A",
  DV1: "division1",
  DV2: "division2",
  DV3: "division3",
};

const GenderCodes: { [key: string]: Gender } = {
  M: "mens",
  W: "womens",
  X: "mixed",
};

const WeaponCodes: { [key: string]: Weapon } = {
  S: "sabre",
  F: "foil",
  E: "epee",
};
// Reverse mappings
const EventCategoryCodesReverse = Object.fromEntries(
  Object.entries(EventCategoryCodes).map(([code, category]) => [category, code]),
);

const GenderCodesReverse = Object.fromEntries(
  Object.entries(GenderCodes).map(([code, gender]) => [gender, code]),
);

const WeaponCodesReverse = Object.fromEntries(
  Object.entries(WeaponCodes).map(([code, weapon]) => [weapon, code]),
);

function parseEventString(s: string): [EventCategory, Gender, Weapon, number | null] {
  // List of event category codes sorted by length (longest first)
  const EventCategoryCodesList = Object.keys(EventCategoryCodes).sort(
    (a, b) => b.length - a.length,
  );

  let eventCategory: EventCategory | undefined;

  // Find the event category code at the start of the string
  for (const code of EventCategoryCodesList) {
    if (s.startsWith(code)) {
      eventCategory = EventCategoryCodes[code];
      s = s.slice(code.length);
      break;
    }
  }

  if (!eventCategory) {
    throw new Error("Invalid Event Category Code");
  }

  // Parse gender code
  const genderCode = s.charAt(0);
  const gender = GenderCodes[genderCode];
  if (!gender) {
    throw new Error("Invalid Gender Code");
  }
  s = s.slice(1);

  // Parse weapon code
  const weaponCode = s.charAt(0);
  const weapon = WeaponCodes[weaponCode];
  if (!weapon) {
    throw new Error("Invalid Weapon Code");
  }
  s = s.slice(1);

  // Parse region number if present
  let region: number | null = null;
  if (s.startsWith("R")) {
    s = s.slice(1);
    const match = s.match(/^(\d+)/);
    if (match) {
      region = parseInt(match[1], 10);
      s = s.slice(match[1].length);
    } else {
      throw new Error("Invalid Region Number");
    }
  }

  // Check for any extra characters
  if (s.length > 0) {
    throw new Error("Extra characters at the end of the string");
  }

  return [eventCategory, gender, weapon, region];
}

function buildEventString(
  eventCategory: EventCategory,
  gender: Gender,
  weapon: Weapon,
  region: number | null,
): string {
  // Get the codes from the reverse mappings
  const eventCategoryCode = EventCategoryCodesReverse[eventCategory];
  if (!eventCategoryCode) {
    throw new Error("Invalid Event Category");
  }

  const genderCode = GenderCodesReverse[gender];
  if (!genderCode) {
    throw new Error("Invalid Gender");
  }

  const weaponCode = WeaponCodesReverse[weapon];
  if (!weaponCode) {
    throw new Error("Invalid Weapon");
  }

  // Build the event string
  let eventString = eventCategoryCode + genderCode + weaponCode;

  // Append region if present
  if (region !== null) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(region) || region <= 0) {
      throw new Error("Invalid Region Number");
    }
    eventString += "R" + region;
  }

  return eventString;
}

/** Parses an event type code like "Y14MS" into its components. Returns null if invalid. */
export function parseEventTypeCode(
  code: string,
): { category: EventCategory; gender: Gender; weapon: Weapon } | null {
  try {
    const [category, gender, weapon] = parseEventString(code);
    return { category, gender, weapon };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Builds an event type code from components (without region). */
function buildEventTypeCode(category: EventCategory, gender: Gender, weapon: Weapon): string {
  return buildEventString(category, gender, weapon, null);
}

/** Display names for categories */
const CategoryDisplayNames: Record<EventCategory, string> = {
  y8: "Y8",
  y10: "Y10",
  y12: "Y12",
  y14: "Y14",
  cadet: "Cadet",
  junior: "Junior",
  senior: "Senior",

/** Display names for genders */
const GenderDisplayNames: Record<Gender, string> = {
  mens: "Mens",
  womens: "Womens",
  mixed: "Mixed",
};

/** Display names for weapons */
const WeaponDisplayNames: Record<Weapon, string> = {
  sabre: "Sabre",
  foil: "Foil",
  epee: "Epee",
};

/** Gets a human-readable display name for an event type code. */
export function getEventTypeDisplayName(code: string): string {
  const parsed = parseEventTypeCode(code);
  if (!parsed) {
    return code;
  }
  const categoryName = CategoryDisplayNames[parsed.category];
  const genderName = GenderDisplayNames[parsed.gender];
  const weaponName = WeaponDisplayNames[parsed.weapon];
  return `${categoryName} ${genderName} ${weaponName}`;
}

/** All valid event type codes (108 combinations: 12 categories × 3 genders × 3 weapons). */
let _allEventTypeCodes: string[] | null = null;
export function getAllEventTypeCodes(): string[] {
  if (_allEventTypeCodes === null) {
    _allEventTypeCodes = [];
    for (const category of EventCategories) {
      for (const gender of Genders) {
        for (const weapon of Weapons) {
          _allEventTypeCodes.push(buildEventTypeCode(category, gender, weapon));
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return _allEventTypeCodes;
}

export interface EventTypeSearchResult {
  code: string;
  displayName: string;
  category: EventCategory;
  gender: Gender;
  weapon: Weapon;
}

/** Normalizes text for search by lowercasing and removing punctuation */
function normalizeForSearch(text: string): string {
  return text.toLowerCase().replace(/[''`]/g, "").trim();
}

/**
 * Searches event types by query string.
 * Matches against code (e.g., "Y14MS") and display name words (e.g., "mens sabre").
 * @param query Search query
 * @param excludeCodes Codes to exclude from results (already selected)
 * @param limit Maximum number of results
 */
export function searchEventTypes(
  query: string,
  excludeCodes: Set<string> = new Set(),
  limit = 20,
): EventTypeSearchResult[] {
  const normalizedQuery = normalizeForSearch(query);
  if (!normalizedQuery) {
    return [];
  }

  const queryTerms = normalizedQuery.split(/\s+/);
  const results: Array<EventTypeSearchResult & { score: number }> = [];

  for (const code of getAllEventTypeCodes()) {
    if (excludeCodes.has(code)) {
      continue;
    }

    const parsed = parseEventTypeCode(code);
    if (!parsed) {
      continue;
    }

    const displayName = getEventTypeDisplayName(code);
    const lowerCode = code.toLowerCase();
    const normalizedDisplayName = normalizeForSearch(displayName);

    // Calculate match score
    let score = 0;

    // Exact code match (highest priority)
    if (lowerCode === normalizedQuery) {
      score = 1000;
    }
    // Code starts with query
    else if (lowerCode.startsWith(normalizedQuery)) {
      score = 500;
    }
    // Code contains query
    else if (lowerCode.includes(normalizedQuery)) {
      score = 200;
    }
    // All query terms match display name words
    else {
      const displayWords = normalizedDisplayName.split(/\s+/);
      let allTermsMatch = true;
      let termMatchCount = 0;

      for (const term of queryTerms) {
        const termMatches = displayWords.some(
          (word) => word.startsWith(term) || word.includes(term),
        );
        if (termMatches) {
          termMatchCount++;
        } else {
          allTermsMatch = false;
        }
      }

      if (allTermsMatch && termMatchCount > 0) {
        score = 100 + termMatchCount * 10;
      }
    }

    if (score > 0) {
      results.push({
        code,
        displayName,
        category: parsed.category,
        gender: parsed.gender,
        weapon: parsed.weapon,
        score,
      });
    }
  }

  // Sort by score descending, then by code
  results.sort((a, b) => {
    if (b.score !== a.score) {
      return b.score - a.score;
    }
    return a.code.localeCompare(b.code);
  });

  return results.slice(0, limit).map(({ score: _score, ...rest }) => rest);
}

function getCategoryCode(category: EventCategory) {

export function getCode(classifier: string | Classifier) {
  if (typeof classifier === "string") {
    return classifier;
  }
  const recognized = classifier as Classifier;
  let code = "";
  code += getCategoryCode(recognized.category);
  switch (recognized.gender) {
    case "mens":
      code += "M";
      break;
    case "womens":
      code += "W";
      break;
    case "mixed":
      code += "X";
      break;
  }

  switch (recognized.weapon) {
    case "epee":
      code += "E";
      break;
    case "foil":
      code += "F";
      break;
    case "sabre":
      code += "S";
      break;
  }

  return code;
}

const serviceConnections = ["GoogleCalendar", "YouTubeUpload", "YouTubeMetadata"] as const;

export function getServiceConnectionDescription(serviceConnection: ServiceConnection) {
  switch (serviceConnection) {
    case "GoogleCalendar":
      return "Synchronize Google Calendar events";
    case "YouTubeMetadata":
      return "Update metadata of YouTube videos";
    case "YouTubeUpload":
      return "Upload YouTube videos";
  }
  return "";
}

export async function searchFencers(query: string, clerkToken?: string | null) {
  const rawResults = await get<
    (Omit<FencerSearchResult, "usafId"> & {
      usaf_id?: number;
      usafId?: number;
    })[]
  >(`/api/v2/fencingtracker/fencers?query=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`, clerkToken);

  return rawResults
    .map((result) => ({
      ...result,
      usafId: normalizeUsafId(result.usafId ?? result.usaf_id),
    }))
    .filter((result): result is FencerSearchResult => result.usafId !== null);
}

function normalizeUsafId(id: number | string | undefined | null) {
  if (id == null) {
    return null;
  }

  const numeric = typeof id === "string" ? Number.parseInt(id, 10) : id;
  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
}

/**
 * Progress of the incremental identity sweep, which resolves Unified ranking
 * rows to Flunge memberships against FencingTracker *outside* the publish
 * path. A successful catalog refresh no longer implies complete identity
 * resolution — that takes hours and publishing does not wait for it — so this
 * is the half of the status that answers "how complete is what we are
 * serving".
 */
export interface UnifiedIdentitySweepStatus {
  lastRunAt: string | null;
  lastRunStopReason: "passComplete" | "lookupBudget" | "timeBudget" | "egressPaused" | null;
  lastRunLookups: number;
  lastRunResolved: number;
  lastRunSeconds: number;
  /** Null until the sweep has resolved everything it can for the active catalog. */
  lastPassCompletedAt: string | null;
  catalogRows: number;
  resolvedRows: number;
  pendingRows: number;
  bindings: number;
}

export interface UnifiedRankingsRefreshStatus {
  lastAttemptAt: string | null;
  lastAttemptUsedCooldownOverride: boolean | null;
  lastSuccessAt: string | null;
  lastSuccessSnapshotId: string | null;
  lastFailureAt: string | null;
  lastFailureReason: string | null;
  identitySweep: UnifiedIdentitySweepStatus;
}

export async function startAdminTask(
  id: string,
  options?: { forceListRefresh?: boolean; overrideCooldown?: boolean },
  clerkToken?: string | null,
) {
  const query = new URLSearchParams();
  if (options?.forceListRefresh) query.set("forceListRefresh", "true");
  if (options?.overrideCooldown) query.set("overrideCooldown", "true");
  const suffix = query.size === 0 ? "" : `?${query.toString()}`;
  const path = `/api/v2/admin/tasks/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/exec${suffix}`;

  return postJson<void>(path, "", clerkToken);
}

}
